translated: Молим вас, узмите сир од Мираје и донесите ми га док сам у Port Hope. Све јасно и разумљиво?

translated: Grazie per la tua offerta Adesso puoi oltrepassare il Portale per i Poteri della Morte.

translated: Такође треба да будете у стању да транспортујете тешку робу, слабићи овде неће далеко стићи. Наручио сам посебан пакет од Edron. ...

en: Pick it up from Willard and bring it back to me while I'm in Liberty Bay. Everything clear and understood?
translated: Узми га од Виларда и врати ми га док сам у Liberty Bay. Све јасно и разумљиво?

en: Okay, all I want from you is one of these rare deer trophies. I have a customer here in Svargrond who ordered one, so I'd like you to deliver it tome while I'm in Svargrond. ...
translated: Ок, све што желим од тебе је један од ових ретких трофеја јелена. Имам купца овде у Svargrond који је наручио један, па бих желео да ми га испоручите док сам ја у Svargrond. ...

en: Dwarves are said to be the most stubborn of all traders. Travel to Kazordoon and try to get the smith Uzgod to sell a crimson sword to you. ...
translated: За патуљке се каже да су најтврдоглавији од свих трговаца. Путујте до Kazordoon и покушајте да натерате ковача Узгода да вам прода гримизни мач. ...

en: Ah, right. <ahem> I hereby declare you - one of my recognised traders! Feel free to offer me your wares!
translated: Ах, тачно. <ahem> Овим вас проглашавам једним од мојих признатих трговаца! Слободно ми понудите своју робу!

en: Fine. Then get a hold of that deer trophy and bring it to me while I'm in Svargrond. Just ask me about your mission.
translated: У реду. Онда узми тај трофеј јелена и донеси ми га док сам у Svargrond. Само ме питај о својој мисији.

en: Well done! I'll take that from you. <snags it> Come see me another day, I'll be busy for a while now.
translated: Браво! Узећу то од тебе. <snags it> Дођите да ме видите неки други дан, бићу заузет неко време.

en: Fine. Then off you go, just ask Willard about the 'package for Rashid'.
translated: У реду. Онда идите, само питајте Виларда за 'package for ⟨0⟩'.

en: Okay, I'm curious how you will do with {Uzgod}. Good luck!
translated: У реду, радознао сам како ћеш са {Uzgod}. Срећно!

en: I feel uncomfortable and rather unsafe in Thais, so I don't really travel there.
translated: Осећам се непријатно и прилично несигурно у Thais, тако да заправо не путујем тамо.

en: I am Rashid, son of the desert.
Although it's the flourishing trade centre of Tibia, I don't like going there. Too much competition for my taste.
translated: Иако је то цветајући трговачки центар Tibia, не волим да идем тамо. Превише конкуренције за мој укус.

en: Elves... I don't really trust them. All this talk about nature and flowers and treehugging... I'm sure there's some wicked scheme behind all this.
translated: Elves... Не верујем им баш. Сва ова прича о природи и цвећу и грљењу дрвећа... Сигуран сам да иза свега овога стоји нека зла шема.

en: I have to go to Carlin once in a while, since the queen wishes to see my exclusive wares in regular intervals.
translated: Морам с времена на време да одем до Carlin, пошто краљица жели да види моју ексклузивну робу у редовним интервалима.

en: Cormaya? Not a good place to make business, it's way too far and small.
translated: Cormaya? Није добро место за пословање, предалеко је и мало је.

en: Ah yes, Edron! Such a lovely and quiet island! I usually make some nice business there.
translated: Ах да, Edron! Тако лепо и тихо острво! Обично тамо направим добар посао.

en: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Ci sono cinque benedizioni disponibili in cinque luoghi sacri: lo scudo {spiritual}, la scintilla del {phoenix}, il {embrace} di Tibia, il fuoco del {suns} e la saggezza di {solitude}. Inoltre, puoi ricevere il {twist of fate} qui.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Sento che i druidi a nord di Carlin ti hanno fornito l'Abbraccio di Tibia.

en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la benedizione dei due soli nella torre del sole vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Sento che la scintilla della fenice ti è già stata donata dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
translated: Sento che hai già parlato con l'eremita Eremo sull'isola di Cormaya e hai ricevuto questa benedizione.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione della protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
translated: I druidi a nord di Carlin ti forniranno l'abbraccio di Tibia.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione dei due soli nella torre solare vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: La scintilla della fenice è data dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: She knows more about the wolf. Seek her out in the north-west of Edron, near a circle of standing stones.
translated: Lei sa di più sul lupo. Cercala a nord-ovest di Edron, vicino a un cerchio di pietre erette.

en: I'm very happy that you could help fae and animals alike. You earned our trust and may now visit our secret realm. I marked you with an arcane fae seal. Hereby you will be able to use the elemental shrines strewn about Tibia. ...
translated: Sono molto felice che tu possa aiutare le fate e gli animali allo stesso modo. Hai guadagnato la nostra fiducia e ora puoi visitare il nostro regno segreto. Ti ho marchiato con un sigillo arcano delle fate. In questo modo potrai utilizzare i santuari elementali sparsi per Tibia. ...

en: There are fire, ice, energy and earth shrines. If you don't know their locations you can also reach them by most temples in this world. The elemental shrines will transport you to Feyrist now that you bear the magical seal.
translated: Ci sono santuari del fuoco, del ghiaccio, dell'energia e della terra. Se non conosci la loro posizione, puoi raggiungerli anche dalla maggior parte dei templi di questo mondo. I santuari elementali ti trasporteranno a Feyrist ora che porti il ​​sigillo magico.

en: Meep? I mean - hello! Sorry, |PLAYERNAME|... Being a {rat} has kind of grown on me.
translated: Мееп? Мислим - здраво! Извини, |PLAYERNAME|... То што сам {rat} некако ми је порасло.

en: Meep? I mean - hello! Sorry, |PLAYERNAME|... Being a {rat} has kind of grown on me.
translated: Мееп? Мислим - здраво! Извини, |PLAYERNAME|... То што сам {rat} некако ми је порасло.

en: Uhmn.. Maybe Ahmet in Ankrahmun can help we to fake this book.
translated: Uhm... forse Ahmet in Ankrahmun può aiutarci a falsificare questo libro.

en: We call it Feyrist and it is a secret, hidden place. Just few mortals get permission to enter it. A long time ago, we learned how to hide our realm from the outside world. Only if you gain our trust I will tell you how to reach it.
translated: Lo chiamiamo Feyrist ed è un luogo segreto e nascosto. Solo pochi mortali ottengono il permesso di entrarvi. Molto tempo fa, abbiamo imparato come nascondere il nostro regno al mondo esterno. Solo se otterrai la nostra fiducia ti dirò come raggiungerla.

en:
Some call us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the term fae. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to protect our home. ... \z
	We tend to be secretive about our true nature, but I guess there was once an elven sage who visited our realm and put his experiences down on paper. There might be a book about the fae in the library of Ab'Dendriel.
translated:
Alcuni ci chiamano spiriti della natura o peri, ma noi preferiamo il termine fae. La maggior parte di noi è piuttosto solitaria e vive una vita pacifica nel nostro regno segreto. Lo lasciamo solo per proteggere la nostra casa. ...\z
	Tendiamo a essere riservati riguardo alla nostra vera natura, ma immagino che una volta ci fosse un elfo saggio che visitò il nostro regno e mise nero su bianco le sue esperienze. Potrebbe esserci un libro sulle fate nella biblioteca di Ab'Dendriel.

en: Be greeted. Is there anything I can {do for you}?
translated: Будите поздрављени. Могу ли нешто {do for you}?

en: So you went into the leaders' hideout? I hope you were successful and got what you were looking for! Thank you, my friend. Pirates still keep coming here, unfortunately. ...
translated: Дакле, отишао си у скровиште вођа? Надам се да сте били успешни и добили оно што сте тражили! Хвала ти, пријатељу. Pirates и даље долазите овде, нажалост. ...

en: So receive my prayer: 'Wicked curses shall be broken'. Now, bring your stake to Kasmir in Darashia for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
translated: Accogli quindi la mia preghiera: 'Wicked curses shall be broken'. Ora porta la tua puntata a Kasmir in Darashia per la riga successiva della preghiera. Lo informerò cosa fare.

en: You should visit Kasmir in Darashia now, my child.
translated: Dovresti visitare il Kasmir a Darashia adesso, figlia mia.

en: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Ci sono cinque benedizioni disponibili in cinque luoghi sacri: lo scudo {spiritual}, la scintilla del {phoenix}, il {embrace} di Tibia, il fuoco del {suns} e la saggezza di {solitude}. Inoltre, puoi ricevere il {twist of fate} qui.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Sento che i druidi a nord di Carlin ti hanno fornito l'Abbraccio di Tibia.

en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la benedizione dei due soli nella torre del sole vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Sento che la scintilla della fenice ti è già stata donata dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
translated: Sento che hai già parlato con l'eremita Eremo sull'isola di Cormaya e hai ricevuto questa benedizione.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione della protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
translated: I druidi a nord di Carlin ti forniranno l'abbraccio di Tibia.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione dei due soli nella torre solare vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: La scintilla della fenice è data dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: Your mission here on Tibia is to be polite and friendly. The gods will reward you, I promise!
translated: La tua missione qui su Tibia è essere gentile e amichevole. Gli dei ti ricompenseranno, te lo prometto!

en: What a beautiful palace. The Kilmareshians are highly skilful architects.
translated: Che bel palazzo. I Kilmareshian sono architetti molto abili.

en: The new treaty of amity and commerce with Kilmaresh is of utmost importance.
translated: Il nuovo trattato di amicizia e commercio con Kilmaresh è della massima importanza.

en: I wish I could eat some salmon right now... best prepared in Liberty Bay style... yummy.
translated: Vorrei poter mangiare del salmone in questo momento... meglio preparato in stile Liberty Bay... buonissimo.

en: Get a fire bug - you can buy them in Liberty Bay - and set this catapult on fire. ...
translated: Узмите ватрену бубу - можете је купити за Liberty Bay - и запалити овај катапулт. ...

en: I'm trying to explore each spot of Tibia, and one day I'll have seen it all.
translated: Sto cercando di esplorare ogni punto di Tibia e un giorno lo avrò visto tutto.

en: If you travel to Thais, you really should visit the marvelous castle there.
translated: Se viaggi verso Thais, dovresti davvero visitare il meraviglioso castello lì.

en: What was that word again in Orcish language... hmm.
translated: Cos'era quella parola nella lingua degli Orchi... hmm.

en: Indeed, I could use some help. The evil pirates of Nargor have convinced an alchemist from Edron to supply them with a substance called Fafnar's Fire ...
translated: Заиста, добро би ми дошла помоћ. Зли пирати из Наргора убедили су алхемичара из Edron да их снабде супстанцом која се зове Фафнарова ватра...

en: It can burn even on water and is a threat to us all. I need you to travel to Edron and pretend to the alchemist Sandra that you are the one whom the other pirates sent to get the fire ...
translated: Може да гори чак и на води и представља претњу за све нас. Требаш да отпутујеш у Edron и да се претвараш алхемичарки Сандри да си ти онај кога су други пирати послали да запали ватру...

en: When she asks for a payment, tell her 'Your continued existence is payment enough'. That should enrage any member of the Edron academy enough to refuse any further deals with the pirates.
translated: Када затражи уплату, реците јој „Ваше даље постојање је довољно плаћања“. То би требало да разбесни сваког члана Edron академије довољно да одбије било какве даље послове са пиратима.

en: You are most welcome to keep on killing pirates for us though for some bucks and experience. If you want to do so, just ask me about a {task} anytime.
translated: Веома сте добродошли да наставите да убијате пирате за нас, иако за неки новац и искуство. Ако то желите, само ме питајте за {task} било када.

en: Eleonore ... Yes, I remember her... vaguely. She is a pretty girl ... but still only a girl and now I am in love with a beautiful and passionate woman. A true {mermaid} even.
translated: Елеонора... Да, сећам је се... нејасно. Она је лепа девојка ... али још увек само девојка и сада сам заљубљен у лепу и страствену жену. Право {mermaid} чак.

en: Ahh, thank you, my friend! What would we do without you? Here, take this reward for your efforts. If you want to continue to help us killing pirates, just ask me about that {task}.
translated: Ахх, хвала ти, пријатељу! Шта бисмо ми без тебе? Ево, узмите ову награду за свој труд. Ако желите да наставите да нам помажете у убијању пирата, само ме питајте о томе {task}.

en: I speak some Orcish words, not many though, just a few basics like '{yes}' and '{no}'.
translated: Parlo alcune parole orchesche, non molte però, solo alcune nozioni di base come '{yes}' e '{no}'.

en: It's 'mok' in Orcish. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
translated: È 'mok' in orco. Ti dico di più se me ne porti un po' {food}.

en: In Orcish that's 'burp'. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
translated: In orco è 'burp'. Ti dico di più se me ne porti un po' {food}.

en: Yeah! If you give me some salmon, I'll tell you another Orcish word. Okay?
translated: Sì! Se mi dai del salmone, ti dirò un'altra parola orchesca. Va bene?
Grazie. Gli orchi chiamano le frecce 'pixo'.

en: I wish I could eat some salmon right now... best prepared in Liberty Bay style... yummy.
translated: Vorrei poter mangiare del salmone in questo momento... meglio preparato in stile Liberty Bay... buonissimo.

en: What was that word again in Orcish language... hmm.
translated: Cos'era quella parola nella lingua degli Orchi... hmm.

en: Well, a while ago powerful magic devices were used all around Tibia. These are chargeable compasses. There was but one problem: they offered the possibility to make people rich in a quite easy way. ...
translated: Bene, qualche tempo fa venivano usati potenti dispositivi magici ovunque Tibia. Queste sono bussole a pagamento. C'era solo un problema: offrivano la possibilità di arricchire le persone in modo abbastanza semplice. ...

en: It was decided to collect all of the compasses, destroy them and throw them in the fiery depths of Tibia. I still have some of them here. I {sell} them for a low price if you want.
translated: Si è deciso di raccogliere tutte le bussole, distruggerle e gettarle nelle profondità infuocate di Tibia. Ne ho ancora alcuni qui. Te li {sell} a un prezzo basso, se vuoi.

en: Don't ask about silly missions. All I can think about is this lovely {mermaid}.
translated: Не питајте за глупе мисије. Све о чему могу да размишљам је ово дивно {mermaid}.

en: I think that means 'mission accomplished'. Hehe. I guess that will put an end to their efforts to buy any alchemical substance from Edron.
translated: Мислим да то значи 'mission accomplished'. Хехе. Претпостављам да ће то ставити тачку на њихове напоре да купе било коју алхемијску супстанцу од Edron.

en: My pillow?? They know me all too well... <sigh> I've owned it since my childhood. However. Here, take it and convincehim that I am dead.
translated: Мој јастук?? Превише ме познају... <sigh> Поседујем га од детињства. Међутим. Ево, узми и убеди га да сам мртав.

en: I am deeply ashamed that I lacked the willpower to resist her spell. Thank you for your help in that matter. Now my head is once more free to think about our {mission}.
translated: Дубоко се стидим што ми је недостајала снага воље да се одупрем њеној чаролији. Хвала вам на помоћи по том питању. Сада је моја глава поново слободна да размишљам о нашим {mission}.

en: This sarcophagus seals the entrance to the caves down there. Only here you can get all the {materials} you need for a working compass of this kind. So no entrance here - no further magic compasses in Tibia. In theory.
translated: Questo sarcofago sigilla l'ingresso alle caverne laggiù. Solo qui puoi ottenere tutto il {materials} di cui hai bisogno per una bussola funzionante di questo tipo. Quindi niente ingresso qui - niente altre bussole magiche in Tibia. In teoria.

en: Ahhh, this softness! I'm impressed, |PLAYERNAME|. You're on the best way to earn that turban. Now, please retrieve 100 fish fins.
translated: Аххх, ова мекоћа! Импресиониран сам, |PLAYERNAME|. На најбољем си путу да зарадиш тај турбан. Сада, узмите 100 рибљих пераја.

en: I never thought you'd make it, |PLAYERNAME|. Now we only need two enchanted chicken wings to start our waterwalking test!
translated: Никад нисам мислио да ћеш успети, |PLAYERNAME|. Сада нам требају само два зачарана пилећа крилца да започнемо наш тест ходања по води!

en: Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
translated: La vita e la morte sono parti significative dell’equilibrio.

en: Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
translated: La vita e la morte sono parti significative dell’equilibrio.

en: Hunters live a life of freedom and closeness to nature, unlike a simple farmer or bugherder.
translated: I cacciatori vivono una vita di libertà e vicinanza alla natura, a differenza di un semplice contadino o bugherder.

en: ... over Tibia came to avenge their friends, and they killed nearly all ... <m>
translated: ... oltre Tibia vennero a vendicare i loro amici, e uccisero quasi tutti... <m>

en: ... the orcs went back to their cities. The city of Carlin was rescued. <m>
translated: ...gli orchi tornarono alle loro città. La città di Carlin è stata salvata. <m>

en: ... of our king Tibianus III wanted to build the best CITY in whole of Tibia.
translated: ... del nostro re Tibiano III volle costruire la migliore CITTÀ dell'intero Tibia.

en: Since then, a woman has always been ruling over Carlin and this statue ... <m>
translated: Da allora, su Carlin regna sempre una donna e questa statua... <m>

en: ... and the Red Legion. So that was the story of Carlin and these Fields of Glory. I hope you liked it. *He smiles*
translated: ... e la Legione Rossa. Questa era la storia di Carlin e di questi Fields of Glory. Spero che ti sia piaciuto. *Sorride*

en: I will tell you a small secret now. My friend Lynda in Thais can create a blessed wand. Greet her from me, maybe she will aid you.
translated: Adesso ti svelo un piccolo segreto. La mia amica Lynda in Thais può creare una bacchetta benedetta. Salutala da parte mia, forse ti aiuterà.

en: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a {project} that tries to find out more about this new {area}.
translated: Lo Druid di Crunor? Ti ha detto che qui è apparsa una nuova grotta? Giusto. Sono il capo di un {project} che cerca di scoprire di più su questo nuovo {area}.

en: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a project that tries to find out more about this new area.
translated: Lo Druid di Crunor? Ti ha detto che qui è apparsa una nuova grotta? Giusto. Sono a capo di un progetto che cerca di scoprire di più su questa nuova area.

en: MoTA is short for the recently founded Museum of Tibian Arts. We work together in close collaboration. New {results} are communicated to the museum instantly.
translated: MoTA è l'abbreviazione di Museum of Tibian Arts, recentemente fondato. Lavoriamo insieme in stretta collaborazione. Le novità {results} vengono comunicate immediatamente al museo.

en: I have shovels, picks, scythes, bags, ropes, backpacks, plates, scrolls, watches, some lightsources, and other stuff. Just ask me for a {trade}.
translated: Имам лопате, крампове, косе, торбе, ужад, ранчеве, тањире, свитке, сатове, неке изворе светлости и друге ствари. Само ме замоли за {trade}.

en: The mission should be simple to fulfil. For our excavations we have ordered a sturdy pickaxe in Kazordoon. You would have to seek out this trader Uzgod and get the pickaxe for us ...
translated: La missione dovrebbe essere semplice da compiere. Per i nostri scavi abbiamo ordinato un robusto piccone in Kazordoon. Dovresti cercare questo commerciante Uzgod e procurarci il piccone...

en: We would like to study some ancient runes that were used by the lizard race. We suspect some relation of the lizards to the founders of Ankrahmun ...
translated: Vorremmo studiare alcune antiche rune utilizzate dalla razza delle lucertole. Sospettiamo qualche relazione tra le lucertole e i fondatori di Ankrahmun...

en: Somewhere under the ape infested city of Banuta, one can find dungeons that were once inhabited by lizards...
translated: Da qualche parte sotto la città infestata dalle scimmie di Banuta, si possono trovare sotterranei che un tempo erano abitati da lucertole...

en: Look there for an atypical structure that would rather fit to Ankrahmun and its Ankrahmun Tombs. Copy the runes you will find on this structure...
translated: Cerca lì una struttura atipica che si adatterebbe piuttosto a Ankrahmun e alle sue Ankrahmun Tombe. Copia le rune che troverai su questa struttura...

en: As far as we know the ruins found in the north-west of Edron were once inhabited by beings who used such stones. Do you have the heart to go there and to get us such a stone?
translated: Per quanto ne sappiamo le rovine rinvenute nel nord-ovest di Edron un tempo erano abitate da esseri che utilizzavano tali pietre. Hai il coraggio di andare lì e di procurarci una pietra del genere?

en: For sure someone in Ab'Dendriel will own a copy. So you would just have to ask around there. Are you willing to accept this mission?
translated: Di sicuro qualcuno in Ab'Dendriel ne possederà una copia. Quindi non ti resta che chiedere in giro. Sei disposto ad accettare questa missione?

en: We want to learn more about the ancient race of bonelords. We believe the black pyramid north east of Darashia was originally built by them ...
translated: Vogliamo saperne di più sull'antica razza dei signori delle ossa. Crediamo che la piramide nera a nord-est di Darashia sia stata originariamente costruita da loro...

en: And remember: it's a small teleport for you, but a big teleport for all Tibians! Here is a small present for your efforts!
translated: E ricorda: è un piccolo teletrasporto per te, ma un grande teletrasporto per tutti i Tibiani! Ecco un piccolo regalo per i tuoi sforzi!

en: That is quite courageous. We know, it's much we are asking for. The queen of the banshees lives in the so called Ghostlands, south west of Carlin. It is rumoured that her lair is located in the deepest dungeons beneath that cursed place ...
translated: Questo è abbastanza coraggioso. Lo sappiamo, chiediamo molto. La regina delle banshee vive nelle cosiddette Terre Fantasma, a sud-ovest di Carlin. Si dice che la sua tana si trovi nei sotterranei più profondi sotto quel luogo maledetto...

en: Did you get the requested pickaxe from Uzgod in Kazordoon?
translated: Hai ricevuto il piccone richiesto da Uzgod in Kazordoon?

en: Thais might be a splendid town, but this is of no use to us here. The situation in our town gets worse with every ship full of foreigners that arrives here.
translated: Thais је можда сјајан град, али ово нам овде нема користи. Ситуација у нашем граду се погоршава са сваким бродом пуним странаца који овамо стигне.

en: I heard Venore will soon acquire several trade monopolies that will grant them wealth for centuries.
translated: Чуо сам да ће Venore ускоро стећи неколико трговачких монопола који ће им давати богатство вековима.

en: Hmm, but please keep Tibia litter free.
translated: Хм, али молим вас да Tibia не буде смећа.

en: In this mission we require you to get us some plant samples from Tiquandan plants. Would you like to fulfil this mission?
translated: In questa missione ti chiediamo di procurarci alcuni campioni di piante dalle piante di Tiquandan. Ti piacerebbe compiere questa missione?

en: The explorer society would like to acquire an ancient urn which is some sort of relic to the lizard people of Tiquanda. Would you like to accept this mission?
translated: La società degli esploratori vorrebbe acquisire un'antica urna che è una sorta di reliquia del popolo lucertola di Tiquanda. Vorresti accettare questa missione?

en: We will see if you can handle this simple task. Get the pickaxe from Uzgod in Kazordoon and bring it to one of our bases. Report there about the pickaxe.
translated: Vedremo se sarai in grado di gestire questo semplice compito. Prendi il piccone da Uzgod in Kazordoon e portalo in una delle nostre basi. Riferisci lì del piccone.

en: Hello there, mate. Here for a {trade}? My stock's just been refilled.
translated: Здраво, друже. Овде за {trade}? Моје залихе су управо попуњене.

en: You have indeed the spirit of an adventurer! In the south-east of Tiquanda is a small settlement of the lizard people ...
translated: Hai davvero lo spirito di un avventuriero! Nel sud-est di Tiquanda c'è un piccolo insediamento del popolo delle lucertole...

en: Excellent! So travel to the city of Darashia and then head north-east for the pyramid ...
translated: Eccellente! Quindi raggiungi la città di Darashia e poi dirigiti a nord-est verso la piramide...

en: Excellent. This mission is easy but nonetheless vital. Travel to Ab'Dendriel and get the book.
translated: Eccellente. Questa missione è facile ma comunque vitale. Viaggia verso Ab'Dendriel e prendi il libro.

en: In the ruins of north-western Edron you should be able to find a memory stone. Good luck.
translated: Nelle rovine del nord-ovest di Edron dovresti riuscire a trovare una pietra della memoria. Buona fortuna.

en: What a strange map. I wonder if any of our explorers recognises this coastal lines. However, you earned yourself another chance to convince me. Why do you think that Farmine would be interesting for us?
translated: Che strana mappa. Chissà se qualcuno dei nostri esploratori riconosce queste linee costiere. Tuttavia, ti sei guadagnato un'altra possibilità per convincermi. Perché pensi che Farmine sarebbe interessante per noi?

en: We can bring you to Thais with one of our coaches for 125 gold. Are you interested?
translated: Possiamo portarti a Thais con uno dei nostri pullman per 125 oro. Sei interessato?

en: The sailors always tell tales about the famous beer of Carlin. You must know, alcohol is forbidden in that city. ...
translated: I marinai raccontano sempre storie sulla famosa birra di Carlin. Devi sapere che in quella città l'alcol è proibito. ...

en: Now, about that rope - ask me for {equipment} to see my wares. <winks>
translated: Сада, у вези са тим конопцем - питајте ме за {equipment} да видим моју робу. <намигује>

en: <shrugs> Never been, mate. Heard it's kinda cute, though.
translated: <shrugs> Никада нисам био, друже. Чуо сам да је некако сладак.

en: Did you get a sample of the whisper beer from Carlin?
translated: Hai preso un campione della birra sussurrata di Carlin?

en: |PLAYERNAME| HEHEHEHE! Another fool visits the {tower}! Excellent!
translated: |PLAYERNAME| ХЕХЕХЕХЕ! Још једна будала посећује {tower}! Одлично!

en: FOOL! Now you're doomed! But well ... \z So be it! Let's start out with the Seal of Knowledge and the first question: \z What name did the necromant king choose for himself?
translated: БУДАЛА! Сад си осуђен на пропаст! Али добро... \з Нека буде! Почнимо са Печатом од Knowledge и првим питањем: \з Које је име за себе изабрао краљ некроманти?

en: FOOL! Now you're doomed! But well ... So be it! Let's start out with the Seal of Knowledge and the first question: What name did the necromant king choose for himself?
translated: БУДАЛА! Сад си осуђен на пропаст! Али добро... Нека буде! Почнимо са Печатом од Knowledge и првим питањем: Које је име за себе изабрао краљ некроманти?

en: I am guarding the treasures of the tower. Only those who pass the {test} of the three sigils may pass.
translated: Чувам благо куле. Само они који прођу {test} од три сигила могу проћи.

en: He should really sell some stylish gowns or something like that. We Tibians never get some clothing of the latest fashion. It's a shame.
translated: Dovrebbe davvero vendere degli abiti eleganti o qualcosa del genere. Noi Tibiani non riceviamo mai vestiti all'ultima moda. È un peccato.

en: Powerful sorcerers frighten me a little.
translated: I potenti stregoni mi spaventano un po'.

en: Druids seldom visit a town, what do you know about druids?
translated: I druidi visitano raramente una città, cosa sai dei druidi?

en: But there is a fairy who once told me about it. Perhaps she will share her knowledge. You can find her in a small fairy village in the southwest of Feyrist.
translated: Ma c'è una fata che una volta me ne parlò. Forse condividerà la sua conoscenza. Puoi trovarla in un piccolo villaggio fatato nel sud-ovest di Feyrist.

en: A long time ago a pixie knight of Maelyrra carried it with her. But when she was flying above the waves she accidentally dropped it and it sunk. I found it but now you may take it and use it to help Feyrist.
translated: Molto tempo fa un folletto cavaliere di Maelyrra lo portava con sé. Ma mentre volava sopra le onde, la lasciò cadere accidentalmente e affondò. L'ho trovato ma ora puoi prenderlo e usarlo per aiutarti Feyrist.

en: There is a fairy who once told me about this spell. Perhaps she will share her knowledge. You can find her in a small fairy village in the southwest of Feyrist.
translated: C'è una fata che una volta mi parlò di questo incantesimo. Forse condividerà la sua conoscenza. Puoi trovarla in un piccolo villaggio fatato nel sud-ovest di Feyrist.

en: I'm tired of all these young unskilled wannabe heroes. Every Tibian can show his skills or actions by wearing a special outfit. To prove oneself worthy of the demon outfit, this is how it goes: ...
translated: Sono stanco di tutti questi giovani aspiranti eroi inesperti. Ogni Tibian può mostrare le sue abilità o azioni indossando un abito speciale. Per dimostrarsi degni dell'abito da demone, ecco come funziona: ...

en: Everyone on this island has gone crazy! Except for me and you, it seems. Let's {trade} like normal people would.
translated: Сви на овом острву су полудели! Осим мене и тебе, чини се. Хајдемо {trade} као нормални људи.

en: I grant you three chests - filled to the lid with platinum coins, a house in the city in which you may reside, a set of the finest armor Zao has to offer, and a casket of never-ending mana. ...
translated: Ti concedo tre forzieri: pieni fino al coperchio di monete di platino, una casa nella città in cui potresti risiedere, un set delle migliori armature che Zao ha da offrire e uno scrigno di mana infinito. ...

en: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Ci sono cinque benedizioni disponibili in cinque luoghi sacri: lo scudo {spiritual}, la scintilla del {phoenix}, il {embrace} di Tibia, il fuoco del {suns} e la saggezza di {solitude}. Inoltre, puoi ricevere il {twist of fate} qui.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Sento che i druidi a nord di Carlin ti hanno fornito l'Abbraccio di Tibia.

en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la benedizione dei due soli nella torre del sole vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Sento che la scintilla della fenice ti è già stata donata dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
translated: Sento che hai già parlato con l'eremita Eremo sull'isola di Cormaya e hai ricevuto questa benedizione.

en: If you want anything, you should talk to Old Rock Boy over there. I do {collect} stuff, though. So just ask if you're interested in helping me.
translated: Ако желите нешто, разговарајте са Олд Роцк Бои-ом тамо. Ипак, радим ствари од {collect}. Зато само питајте да ли сте заинтересовани да ми помогнете.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione della protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
translated: I druidi a nord di Carlin ti forniranno l'abbraccio di Tibia.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione dei due soli nella torre solare vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: La scintilla della fenice è data dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Не изгледаш тако лоше. Извини, не могу ти помоћи. Али ако тражите додатну заштиту, требало би да одете на {pilgrimage} пепела или набавите заштиту од {twist of fate} овде.

en: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
translated: Кад год задобијете смртоносну рану, ваша витална снага је оштећена и постоји шанса да изгубите део опреме. Са сваким од пет {blessings} које имате, ова штета и шанса за губитак ће се смањити.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Видим да сте примили духовни штит у храму белог цвета јужно од Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Могу да осетим да су вам друиди северно од Carlin пружили Загрљај Tibia.

en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Видим да сте добили благослов два сунца у сунчаном торњу близу Ab'Dendriel.

en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Могу да осетим да су вам искру феникса већ дали патуљасти свештеници земље и ватре у Kazordoon.

en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
translated: Осећам да сте већ разговарали са пустињаком Еремом на острву Cormaya и добили овај благослов.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Можете затражити благослов духовног штита у храму белог цвета јужно од Thais.

en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
translated: Друиди северно од Carlin ће вам пружити загрљај Tibia.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Можете тражити благослов два сунца у сунчаном торњу близу Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Искру феникса дају патуљасти свештеници земље и ватре у Kazordoon.

en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
translated:
Ово је посебан благослов који вам могу дати када добијете барем један од других благослова и који функционише мало другачије. ... \з
	Ради само када вас убију други авантуристи, што значи да су најмање половину штете која је довела до ваше смрти проузроковали други, а не чудовишта или околина. ... \з
	{twist of fate} неће смањити смртну казну као други благослови, већ ће вас уместо тога спречити да изгубите своје друге благослове као и амајлију губитка, ако је носите. Кошта исто као и остали благослови. ... \з
	Да ли би желео да добијеш ту заштиту за жртву од |PVPBLESSCOST| злата, дете?

en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
translated: Да? Шта могу учинити за тебе, |PLAYERNAME|? Банкарски послови, можда?

en: His identity is still unknown but we have been told that the thief fled to the human settlement called Carlin. I want you to find him and report back to me. Nobody messes with the Efreet and lives to tell the tale! ...
translated: La sua identità è ancora sconosciuta ma ci è stato detto che il ladro è fuggito nell'insediamento umano chiamato Carlin. Voglio che tu lo trovi e me lo faccia rapporto. Nessuno scherza con l'Efreet e vive per raccontare la storia! ...

en: Now go! Travel to the northern city Carlin! Keep your eyes open and look around for something that might give you a clue!
translated: Adesso vai! Viaggio nella città del nord Carlin! Tieni gli occhi aperti e cerca qualcosa che possa darti un indizio!

en: Hmmm... I don't think so. Return to Thais and continue your search!
translated: Hmm... non credo. Torna a Thais e continua la ricerca!

en: Then go to Carlin and search for him! Look for something that might give you a clue!
translated: Allora vai su Carlin e cercalo! Cerca qualcosa che possa darti un indizio!

en: Hmmm... I don't think so. Return to Thais and continue your search!
translated: Hmm... non credo. Torna a Thais e continua la ricerca!

en: I welcome thee, |PLAYERNAME|! I suppose you are looking for a trade in fine weapons!
translated: Поздрављам те, |PLAYERNAME|! Претпостављам да тражите трговину финим оружјем!

en: I have many weapons to offer. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
translated: Имам много оружја да понудим. Ако желите да видите моје понуде, тражите од мене {trade}.

en: I sell and buy weapons. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
translated: Продајем и купујем оружје. Ако желите да видите моје понуде, тражите од мене {trade}.

en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
translated: No no no, mi servono 15 dosi di polline appena raccolto! Per favore, raccogli tu stesso quelle 15 dosi, per essere assolutamente sicuro di avere una qualità di prim'ordine. Temo che niente di meno basterà.

en: Welcome to Ab'Dendriel's store for general goods.
translated: Benvenuto nel negozio di articoli generali di Ab'Dendriel.

en: <sigh> The world has grown complicated since my youth.
translated: <sigh> Свет се закомпликовао од моје младости.

en: Hunter's greeting! I assume you want something from me since you came all the way out here on your own. This is a dangerous place to be, I doubt that all my men will accept strangers like I do. You don't seem to have any problems with that, though.
translated: Hunter поздрав! Претпостављам да желиш нешто од мене пошто си сам дошао чак овамо. Ово је опасно место, сумњам да ће сви моји људи прихватити странце као ја. Ипак, изгледа да немате никаквих проблема са тим.

en: People of Thais, bring honour to your king by fighting in the orc war!
translated: Popolo di Thais, rendi onore al tuo re combattendo nella guerra degli orchi!

en: Oh |PLAYERNAME| my good friend, good to see you! Today you will help us with a very important task. Very important indeed. ...
translated: Ох |PLAYERNAME| мој добри пријатељу, драго ми је да те видим! Данас ћете нам помоћи у веома важном задатку. Заиста веома важно. ...

en: You know, a large group of merchants is travelling from Thais to Venore and they are crossing the forest to shorten their way - can you believe it? ...
translated: Знате, велика група трговаца путује од Thais до Venore и прелазе шуму да би скратили пут – можете ли да верујете? ...

en: You'll find a lot of dungeons if you look around. One example are the {sewers} below Rookgaard.
translated: Troverai molti dungeon se ti guardi intorno. Un esempio sono i {sewers} sotto Rookgaard.

en: Good, because that is exactly what you will help us with - getting more 'lucky charms'. If we won't get our hands on new charms in time, we will surely have to starve... during the autumn. That would be a hard time for all of us. So... you in?
translated: Добро, јер управо у томе ћете нам помоћи - добити више 'lucky charms'. Ако се на време не дочепамо нових чари, сигурно ћемо морати да гладујемо... током јесени. То би било тешко време за све нас. Па... јеси у?

en: You did it!! And I assume you took only what you needed? Heh. No, I know it. Because my men took the rest. Thanks for helping us, you did a very good job. In fact I have a little 'extra' for you here, thanks again.
translated: Успео си!! И претпостављам да сте узели само оно што вам је требало? Хех. Не, знам то. Јер су моји људи узели остало. Хвала што сте нам помогли, урадили сте веома добар посао. У ствари, имам мало 'extra' за вас овде, хвала још једном.

en: Good! Listen closely. Take this bottle and go to Kazordoon. I need a sample of their very special brown ale. You may find a cask in their brewery. Come back as soon as you got it.
translated: Bene! Ascolta attentamente. Prendi questa bottiglia e vai a Kazordoon. Mi serve un assaggio della loro birra scura davvero speciale. Potresti trovare una botte nel loro birrificio. Torna appena l'hai capito.

en: Welcome to the finest weaponshop in the land, |PLAYERNAME|! Tell me if you're looking for a good {trade}.
translated: Добродошли у најбољу продавницу оружја у земљи, |PLAYERNAME|! Реци ми да ли тражите добар {trade}.

en: Oh, a customer. Hello |PLAYERNAME|. If you'd like to see my wonderful self-tailored clothes, ask me for a {trade}.
translated: Ох, муштерија. Здраво |PLAYERNAME|. Ако желите да видите моју дивну одећу коју сам сам кројио, замолите ме за {trade}.

en: The pompous hero Avar Tar in Edron, Simon the greedy beggar on Fibula, the pirate Ariella on the Shattered Isles, the dubious Lorbas next to the ruins of the Dark Cathedral, King Markwin in the underground city Mintwalin ...
translated: Il pomposo eroe Avar Tar in Edron, Simon l'avido mendicante in Fibula, il pirata Ariella sulle Shattered Isles, il dubbioso Lorbas accanto alle rovine della Cattedrale Oscura, il re Markwin nella città sotterranea Mintwalin...

en: The shaman Hjaern on the ice island Nibelor, the witch Wyda in the Green Claw Swamp, the ape Hairycles in the jungle city Banuta ...
translated: Lo sciamano Hjaern sull'isola di ghiaccio Nibelor, la strega Wyda nella palude Green Claw, la scimmia Hairycles nella città della giungla Banuta ...

en: The orc king in the orc fortress Uldrek's Rock and the last one to EITHER Yaman, the green djinn, OR, Nah'Bob, the blue djinn ...
translated: Il re degli orchi nella fortezza degli orchi Uldrek's Rock e l'ultimo di SIA Yaman, il djinn verde, OPPURE, Nah'Bob, il djinn blu ...

en: I'm making them on my own in my spare time but I need the right material. South of Thais, next to the Whiteflower Temple, you will find the ideal flowers ...
translated: Li sto realizzando da sola nel tempo libero ma mi serve il materiale giusto. A sud di Thais, accanto al Tempio del Fiore Bianco, troverai i fiori ideali...

en: Welcome to my shop, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|! I {trade} with weapons and armor.
translated: Добродошли у моју радњу, авантуристе |PLAYERNAME|! И {trade} са оружјем и оклопом.

en: Thank you very much! This brings back good old memories! Please, as a reward, travel to Kazordoon and ask my old friend Kroox to provide you a special dwarven armor. ...
translated: Хвала вам пуно! Ово враћа добра стара сећања! Молим вас, као награду, отпутујте на Kazordoon и замолите мог старог пријатеља Кроока да вам обезбеди посебан патуљасти оклоп. ...

en: I can't believe it. Finally I will be rich! I could move to Edron and enjoy my retirement! But ... wait a minute! I will not start working without a contract! Are you willing to sign one?
translated: Не могу да верујем. Коначно ћу бити богат! Могао бих да пређем на Edron и уживам у пензији! Али... чекај мало! Нећу почети да радим без уговора! Да ли сте вољни да потпишете један?

en: Just in time, |PLAYERNAME|. Your helmet is finished, I hope you like it.
translated: Баш на време, |PLAYERNAME|. Ваша кацига је готова, надам се да вам се свиђа.

en: Please have some patience, |PLAYERNAME|. Forging is hard work!
translated: Имајте мало стрпљења, |PLAYERNAME|. Ковање је тежак посао!

en: My offers are weapons, armors, helmets, legs, and shields. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
translated: Моје понуде су оружје, оклопи, шлемови, ноге и штитови. Ако желите да видите моје понуде, тражите од мене {trade}.

en: Life takes many forms. Plants are a very basic form of life. Its simplicity makes them close to the core of nature.
translated: La vita assume molte forme. Le piante sono una forma di vita molto elementare. La sua semplicità li rende vicini al nucleo della natura.

en: Life takes many forms. Plants are a very basic form of life. Its simplicity makes them close to the core of nature.
translated: La vita assume molte forme. Le piante sono una forma di vita molto elementare. La sua semplicità li rende vicini al nucleo della natura.

en: So receive my prayer: 'Your hand shall be guided - your feet shall walk in <hicks> harmony'. Now, take your stake to Tyrias in <hicks> Liberty Bay for the next line of the prayer. I shall let him know what he is to do.
translated: Accogli quindi la mia preghiera: 'La tua mano sarà guidata - i tuoi piedi cammineranno in armonia'. Ora porta la tua puntata a Tyrias in <hicks> Liberty Bay per la riga successiva della preghiera. Gli farò sapere cosa deve fare.

en: You should visit Tyrias in Liberty Bay now.
translated: Dovresti visitare Tyrias tra Liberty Bay adesso.

en: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Ci sono cinque benedizioni disponibili in cinque luoghi sacri: lo scudo {spiritual}, la scintilla del {phoenix}, il {embrace} di Tibia, il fuoco del {suns} e la saggezza di {solitude}. Inoltre, puoi ricevere il {twist of fate} qui.

en: of inquisition gold - BUT we are currently short of this valuable metal so... do you want me to add this amount to my {books} for now or {trade} it for something else.
translated: инквизиционог злата - АЛИ тренутно нам недостаје овог вредног метала, па... да ли желите да додам овај износ мојим {books} за сада или {trade} за нешто друго.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Sento che i druidi a nord di Carlin ti hanno fornito l'Abbraccio di Tibia.

en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la benedizione dei due soli nella torre del sole vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Sento che la scintilla della fenice ti è già stata donata dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
translated: Sento che hai già parlato con l'eremita Eremo sull'isola di Cormaya e hai ricevuto questa benedizione.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione della protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
translated: I druidi a nord di Carlin ti forniranno l'abbraccio di Tibia.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione dei due soli nella torre solare vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: La scintilla della fenice è data dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: Rashid sent you, I suppose. Before I sell you that vase, one word of advice. ...
translated: Rashid ti ha mandato, suppongo. Prima di venderti quel vaso, un consiglio. ...

en: Come and take a look at the finest gems in the lands of Tibia.
translated: Vieni a dare un'occhiata alle gemme più belle delle terre di Tibia.

en: Do you want to purchase a weekly ticket for the ore wagons? With it you can travel freely and swiftly through Kazordoon for one week. 250 gold only. Deal?
translated: Vuoi acquistare un abbonamento settimanale per i carri minerari? Con esso puoi viaggiare liberamente e velocemente attraverso Kazordoon per una settimana. Solo 250 oro. Affare?

en: Would you like to travel to Gnomprona for |TRAVELCOST|?
translated: Ti piacerebbe viaggiare a Gnomprona per |TRAVELCOST|?

en: Do you seek a ride to Farmine for |TRAVELCOST|?
translated: Cerchi un passaggio fino a Farmine per |TRAVELCOST|?

en: Do you seek a ride to Cormaya for |TRAVELCOST|?
translated: Cerchi un passaggio fino a Cormaya per |TRAVELCOST|?

en: What we need is enough {mortar} to actually build a durable traverse. And we will need even more mortar to maintain it as it constantly gets attacked by vile critters.
translated: Оно што нам је потребно је довољно {mortar} да заправо изградимо издржљиву траверзу. И биће нам потребно још више малтера да га одржавамо јер га стално нападају подла створења.

en: Then there is this enormous wall in the distance. Once we crossed the bridge, we will have to breach this monument. As I see it, you are working for the Inquisition now, I will hear no objection. You may even earn our gratitude.
translated: Онда је у даљини овај огроман зид. Када пређемо мост, мораћемо да пробијемо овај споменик. Како видим, сада радите за Inquisition, нећу чути приговор. Можда чак и заслужите нашу захвалност.

en: Then there is this enormous wall in the distance. Once we crossed the bridge, we will have to breach this monument. As I see it, you are working for the Inquisition now, I will hear no objection. You may even earn our gratitude.
translated: Онда је у даљини овај огроман зид. Када пређемо мост, мораћемо да пробијемо овај споменик. Како видим, сада радите за Inquisition, нећу чути приговор. Можда чак и заслужите нашу захвалност.

en: Good. Ask me any time in case you want to know your current {record}. If you have time, Remember you can also {trade} your earnings into some of these... probably far more valuable, ahem... cluster... things, yes.
translated: Добро. Питајте ме у било ком тренутку ако желите да знате свој тренутни {record}. Ако имате времена, Запамтите да можете и {trade} своју зараду у неке од ових... вероватно много вреднијих, хм... кластер... ствари, да.

en: Brother Maun is a valuable member of the Inquisition. He will help you out with supplies. Provided you can actually compensate of course.
translated: Брат Маун је вредан члан Inquisition. Он ће вам помоћи са залихама. Наравно, под условом да стварно можете надокнадити.

en: The Edron academy has introduced a bonus system. Each time you deposit 100 vials without claiming the money for it, you will receive a lottery ticket. ...
translated: Академија Edron је увела бонус систем. Сваки пут када положите 100 бочица без тражења новца за то, добићете срећку. ...

en: Of course, you can leave or join the bonus system at any time by just asking me for the 'bonus'. ...
translated: Наравно, можете напустити или се придружити систему бонуса у било ком тренутку тако што ћете од мене затражити 'bonus'. ...

en: By all that is holy! You are a truly great warrior! With much patience! I have just found out the location the hideout of The Horned Fox! I have marked the spot on your map so you can find it. Go there and slay him!! ...
translated: Per tutto ciò che è santo! Sei davvero un grande guerriero! Con molta pazienza! Ho appena scoperto dove si trova il nascondiglio di The Horned Fox! Ho segnato il punto sulla tua mappa così puoi trovarlo. Vai lì e uccidilo!! ...

en: I want you to kill 5000 minotaurs - no matter where - for me and all the dwarfs of Kazordoon! Are you willing to do that?
translated: Voglio che tu uccida 5000 minotauri, non importa dove, per me e per tutti i nani di Kazordoon! Sei disposto a farlo?

en: I want you to kill 5000 minotaurs - no matter where - for me and all the dwarfs of Kazordoon! Are you willing to do that?
translated: Voglio che tu uccida 5000 minotauri, non importa dove, per me e per tutti i nani di Kazordoon! Sei disposto a farlo?

en: Funny that you are asking me for a mission! There is indeed something you can do for me. Ever heard about The Horned Fox? Anyway, yesterday his gang has stolen my mining helmet during a raid. ...
translated: È strano che tu mi chieda una missione! C'è davvero qualcosa che puoi fare per me. Hai mai sentito parlare della Horned Fox? Comunque ieri la sua banda mi ha rubato l'elmetto da minatore durante un raid. ...

en: We presume the hideout of The Horned Fox is somewhere in the south-west near the coast, good luck finding my mining helmet!
translated: Presumiamo che il nascondiglio di The Horned Fox sia da qualche parte nel sud-ovest vicino alla costa, buona fortuna con il mio elmetto da minatore!

en: Well, I could need help with that damn Horned Fox and his gang, but I guess since you are rather experienced, killing minotaurs would bore you to death. I'll wait for someone else. But thanks!
translated: Beh, potrei aver bisogno di aiuto con quel maledetto Horned Fox e la sua banda, ma immagino che, dato che sei piuttosto esperto, uccidere i minotauri ti annoierebbe a morte. Aspetterò qualcun altro. Ma grazie!

en: I knew you have the guts for that task! We presume the hideout of The Horned Fox somewhere in the south-west near the coast. Good luck!
translated: Sapevo che avevi il coraggio per questo compito! Presumiamo che il nascondiglio della Horned Fox sia da qualche parte nel sud-ovest, vicino alla costa. Buona fortuna!

en: The hideout of the Horned Fox is probably a dangerous if not lethal place for inexperienced adventurers. It is the source of all the {trouble} around here.
translated: Il nascondiglio della Horned Volpe è probabilmente un luogo pericoloso se non letale per gli avventurieri inesperti. È la fonte di tutto il {trouble} da queste parti.

en: He is a minotaur who was kicked out of Mintwallin. He must have some kind of {hideout} nearby.
translated: È un minotauro che è stato espulso da Mintwallin. Deve avere una specie di {hideout} nelle vicinanze.

en: I need a courier to deliver a parcel to the watchtower in Femor Hills. You think you can handle that??
translated: Ho bisogno di un corriere per consegnare un pacco alla torre di guardia tra Femor Hills. Pensi di poterlo gestire??

en: Our family has been serving the Carlin army since countless generations!
translated: La nostra famiglia è al servizio dell'esercito Carlin da innumerevoli generazioni!

en: Our family has been serving the Carlin army since countless generations!
translated: La nostra famiglia è al servizio dell'esercito Carlin da innumerevoli generazioni!

en: She is one of my beloved sisters and serves Carlin as a town guard.
translated: È una delle mie amate sorelle e serve Carlin come guardia cittadina.

en: Of course, just browse through my wares. By the way, if you'd like to join our bonus system for depositing flasks and vial, you have to tell me about that {deposit}.
translated: Наравно, само прегледајте моју робу. Успут, ако желите да се придружите нашем систему бонуса за депоновање бочица и бочица, морате ми рећи о томе {deposit}.

en: Not... right now, though. I am currently... on {vacation}. {Vacation}, yes. All my experiments went wrong. WRONG. Everything. I tried everything but still.
translated: Али не... тренутно. Тренутно сам... на {vacation}. {Vacation}, да. Сви моји експерименти су пошли по злу. ПОГРЕШНО. Све. Пробао сам све али ипак.

en: It's always the same, the {fungus} grows, I am EXCITED and... well... WHAAAAAM! It just EXPLODES! It spreads, covers everything.
translated: Увек је исто, {fungus} расте, ја сам УЗБУЂЕН и... па... ВХАААААМ! Само ЕКСПЛОДИРА! Шири се, покрива све.

en: Behave yourself as long as you are in Carlin, commoner!
translated: Comportati bene finché sei in Carlin, popolano!

en: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
translated: Saluti, |PLAYERNAME|! Devi essere venuto qui parecchio. Sono sempre interessato a imparare cose nuove su Zao.

en: I think in the past, the lizardmen of this country might have worshipped a snake god or goddess just like their brethren in Tiquanda if we can believe the reports from this area. The dragons replaced the snake worship at some point of history. ...
translated: Penso che in passato, gli uomini lucertola di questo paese avrebbero potuto adorare un dio o una dea serpente proprio come i loro fratelli in Tiquanda se possiamo credere ai resoconti di questa zona. I draghi hanno sostituito il culto del serpente ad un certo punto della storia. ...

en: His name was Zao and his deeds and exploits are immortalised in lizard folklore. Some of the earliest records in the tomes suggest a slightly different story though. ...
translated: Il suo nome era Zao e le sue azioni e imprese sono immortalate nel folklore delle lucertole. Alcuni dei primi documenti contenuti nei tomi suggeriscono però una storia leggermente diversa. ...

en: Many records talk about an early lizard dynasty, but I doubt that Zao was a single person born into that dynasty. ...
translated: Molti documenti parlano di un'antica dinastia di lucertole, ma dubito che Zao fosse un'unica persona nata in quella dinastia. ...

en: My guess is that several members of this dynasty are responsible for or connected to the feats that were attributed to the mythical 'Zao'. ...
translated: La mia ipotesi è che diversi membri di questa dinastia siano responsabili o collegati alle imprese attribuite al mitico 'Zao'. ...

en: The improbable lifespan of 'Zao' can thus be explained with the time the Zao dynasty reigned. On the other hand, we all know larger-than-life heroes did exist and some of them had an extremely long lifespan. ...
translated: L'improbabile durata della vita di 'Zao' può quindi essere spiegata con il tempo in cui regnò la dinastia Zao. D'altra parte, sappiamo tutti che esistevano eroi straordinari e alcuni di loro avevano una durata di vita estremamente lunga. ...

en: Most likely, he also had children which could explain the mentioning of a Zao family. I think even the lizardmen don't know for sure what happened in such distant past and so this might be one of those riddles that will never be solved. ...
translated: Molto probabilmente aveva anche dei figli, il che potrebbe spiegare la menzione di una famiglia Zao. Penso che nemmeno gli uomini lucertola sappiano con certezza cosa sia successo in un passato così lontano e quindi questo potrebbe essere uno di quegli enigmi che non verranno mai risolti. ...

en: It seems that the origin of the Zao dynasty was somewhere in the Dragonblaze Peaks, or rather under them. Legends tell of a large fortress, once erected up the highest peak, but now buried deep underground. Who knows, maybe you'll find answers there?
translated: Sembra che l'origine della dinastia Zao fosse da qualche parte nei Picchi di Fiamma del Drago, o meglio sotto di essi. Le leggende raccontano di una grande fortezza, un tempo eretta sulla vetta più alta, ma ora sepolta nelle profondità del sottosuolo. Chissà, forse troverai le risposte lì?

en: In the parts of the original text that I was able to reconstruct with the help of some alchemy, there were some references to lizard spawns that were sighted in the Tiquanda area and linked to the snake god. ...
translated: Nelle parti del testo originale che ho potuto ricostruire con l'aiuto di un po' di alchimia, c'erano alcuni riferimenti a uova di lucertola avvistate nella zona Tiquanda e legate al dio serpente. ...

en: Anyway, you know what else was mentioned in this book? A path down to a hidden cave system below the Muggy Plains. ...
translated: Comunque, sai cos'altro è stato menzionato in questo libro? Un percorso che scende verso un sistema di grotte nascoste sotto il Muggy Plains. ...

en: At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
translated: Барем имам свог поузданог {servants} који ми помаже да очистим. Они раде СВЕ послове. Уклањање СВЕ слузи. Барем раде како је предвиђено. Ја сам их дизајнирао, знаш.

en: I AM THE... I mean... I am - what is a mage, if he is not {mad}? If he isn't... raging? I am... I am just sane. A sane mage.
translated: ЈА САМ... Мислим... Ја сам - шта је маг, ако није {mad}? Ако није... бесни? Ја сам... Ја сам само разуман. Здрави маг.

en: Have you ever seen the towers of the large lizard city south-east of Zao? It's the last one south of the mountains and who knows how long they are able to hold it. ...
translated: Hai mai visto le torri della grande città lucertola a sud-est di Zao? E' l'ultimo a sud delle montagne e chissà quanto riusciranno a reggerlo. ...

en: I discovered an interesting recipe in this Tome of Knowledge. Maybe you've seen the large rice terraces in Muggy Plains - that is how the lizardmen apparently call that region. ...
translated: Ho scoperto una ricetta interessante in questo Tomo di Knowledge. Forse hai visto le grandi terrazze di riso in Muggy Plains - così gli uomini lucertola chiamano quella regione. ...

en: Did you know that most of the minotaurs you might have met by now do not originally come from Zao? The original minotaur race stood no chance against the united force of dragons and lizards. ...
translated: Sapevi che la maggior parte dei minotauri che potresti aver incontrato finora non provengono da Zao? La razza originaria dei minotauri non aveva alcuna possibilità contro la forza unita di draghi e lucertole. ...

en: The Mooh'Tah masters actually found the continent Zao and started to look for their lost brothers, but it doesn't say whether they actually found any survivors. ...
translated: I maestri Mooh'Tah effettivamente trovarono il continente Zao e iniziarono a cercare i loro fratelli perduti, ma non dice se trovarono effettivamente dei sopravvissuti. ...

en: Did you know that the lizardmen were among the first races roaming this continent? They were waging war against the orcs, minotaurs and humans on Zao and for a long time it seemed that the forces were even. ...
translated: Sapevi che gli uomini lucertola furono tra le prime razze a vagare per questo continente? Stavano dichiarando guerra agli orchi, ai minotauri e agli umani su Zao e per molto tempo sembrò che le forze fossero pari. ...

en: Dragons are of great symbolism for this land. Even before the dragons came here and took control over Zao, the lizards worshipped the dragons as strong mythical beasts. ...
translated: Dragons sono di grande simbolismo per questa terra. Ancor prima che i draghi arrivassero qui e prendessero il controllo di Zao, le lucertole adoravano i draghi come potenti bestie mitiche. ...

en: Oh! That sounds fascinating. Have you found a Tome of Knowledge for me to read?
translated: OH! Sembra affascinante. Hai trovato un Tomo di Knowledge da farmi leggere?

en: I've learnt something interesting about the Zao {steppe}.
translated: Ho imparato qualcosa di interessante sullo Zao {steppe}.

en: Oh! That sounds fascinating. Have you found a new Tome of Knowledge for me to read?
translated: OH! Sembra affascinante. Hai trovato un nuovo Tomo di Knowledge da farmi leggere?

en: This book actually IS about Zao. Not about the continent, but about the mythical {founder} of the lizard dynasty.
translated: Questo libro in realtà parla di Zao. Non del continente, ma del mitico {founder} della dinastia delle lucertole.

en: The last tome contained a lot of information about status symbols and insignia - such as {thrones} - and reveals some of the power structures in Zao.
translated: L'ultimo tomo conteneva molte informazioni su status simboli e insegne - come {thrones} - e rivela alcune delle strutture di potere a Zao.

en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|, nice to see you on Rookgaard! I saw you walking by and wondered if you could help me. Could you? Please, say {yes}!
translated: Здраво |PLAYERNAME|, драго ми је да те видим на Rookgaard! Видео сам те како пролазиш и питао сам се да ли можеш да ми помогнеш. Да ли бисте могли? Молим вас, реците {yes}!

en: Oh, |PLAYERNAME|, it's you again! It's probably impolite to disturb a busy adventurer like you, but I really need help. Please, say {yes}!
translated: Ох, |PLAYERNAME|, опет си ти! Вероватно је непристојно узнемиравати заузетог авантуристе као што сте ви, али заиста ми треба помоћ. Молим вас, реците {yes}!

en: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Ahh, you found my chest. Let me take a look at you. You put on that coat, {yes}?
translated: Добродошли назад, |PLAYERNAME|! Ахх, нашао си мој сандук. Дозволи ми да те погледам. Обукао си тај капут, {yes}?

en: Hey, I want to give you a weapon for free! You should not refuse that, in fact you should say '{yes}'!
translated: Хеј, хоћу да ти дам оружје бесплатно! Не треба то да одбијете, у ствари треба да кажете '{yes}'!

en: Good job! For that, I'll grant you 100 experience points! Oh - what was that? I think you advanced a level, {right}?
translated: Браво! За то ћу вам дати 100 поена искуства! Ох - шта је то било? Мислим да си напредовао на нивоу, {right}?

en: Welcome back! Where were we... ? Ah, right, I asked you if you saw your 'level up'! You did, {right}?
translated: Добродошли назад! Где смо били...? Ах, тачно, питао сам те да ли си видео своје 'level up'! Јесте, {right}?

en: Here, take this fish which I've caught myself. Find it in your inventory, then 'Use' it to eat it. This will slowly refill your health. ...
translated: Ево, узми ову рибу коју сам сам уловио. Пронађите га у свом инвентару, а затим 'Use' да га поједете. Ово ће полако напунити ваше здравље. ...

en: By the way: If your hitpoints are below 150, you will regenerate back to 150 hitpoints after few seconds as long as you are not hungry, outside a protection zone and do not have a battle sign. {Easy}, yes?
translated: Успут: Ако су ваши хитпоинти испод 150, вратићете се на 150 хитпоинта након неколико секунди све док нисте гладни, ван заштитне зоне и немате борбени знак. {Easy}, да?

en: Oh! That sounds fascinating. Have you found a new Tome of Knowledge for me to read?
translated: OH! Sembra affascinante. Hai trovato un nuovo Tomo di Knowledge da farmi leggere?

en: Oh! That sounds fascinating. Have you found a Tome of Knowledge for me to read? I have the feeling though that I can only share some of my experience with you now. Is that alright with you?
translated: OH! Sembra affascinante. Hai trovato un Tomo di Knowledge da farmi leggere? Ho la sensazione, però, che ora posso condividere con voi solo parte della mia esperienza. Per te va bene?

en: Thank you! I look forward to reading this interesting discovery of yours and learn a few things about {Zao}.
translated: Grazie! Non vedo l'ora di leggere questa tua interessante scoperta e di imparare alcune cose su {Zao}.

en: Thank you! I look forward to reading this interesting discovery of yours and learn a few things about {Zao}.

en: That's just great! Now you have more health points, can carry more stuff and walk faster. Talking about health, did you get {hurt} by those cockroaches?
translated: То је једноставно сјајно! Сада имате више здравствених поена, можете носити више ствари и ходати брже. Говорећи о здрављу, да ли сте добили {hurt} од оних бубашваба?

en: Really? You look fine to me, must have been just a scratch. Well, there are much more dangerous monsters than cockroaches out there. Take a look at your status bar. You have 155 Health right now. I'll show you something, {yes}?
translated: Стварно? Изгледаш ми добро, мора да је била само огреботина. Па, тамо има много опаснијих чудовишта од бубашваба. Погледајте статусну траку. Тренутно имате 155 здравља. Показаћу ти нешто, {yes}?

en: This is an important lesson from me - an experienced veteran fighter. Take this! Look at your status bar again. As you can see, you've lost health. Now I'll tell you how to heal that, {yes}?
translated: Ово је важна лекција од мене - искусног борца ветерана. Узми ово! Погледајте поново своју статусну траку. Као што видите, изгубили сте здравље. Сада ћу ти рећи како да то излечиш, {yes}?

en: I knew you'd get it right away. You can loot food from many creatures, such as deer and rabbits. You can find them in the forest nearby. By the way... have you seen {Zirella}?
translated: Знао сам да ћеш то одмах добити. Можете пљачкати храну од многих створења, као што су јелени и зечеви. Можете их наћи у оближњој шуми. Успут... да ли сте видели {Zirella}?

en: Really?? She was looking for someone to help her. Maybe you could go and see her. She lives just to the east and down the mountain. So, thank you again and {bye} for now!
translated: Стварно?? Тражила је некога да јој помогне. Можда би могао да одеш да је видиш. Она живи само на истоку и низ планину. Дакле, још једном хвала и {bye} за сада!

en: This is an important lesson from me - an experienced veteran fighter. Take this! Look at your status bar again. As you can see, you've lost health. Now I'll tell you how to heal that, {yes}?
translated: Ово је важна лекција од мене - искусног борца ветерана. Узми ово! Погледајте поново своју статусну траку. Као што видите, изгубили сте здравље. Сада ћу ти рећи како да то излечиш, {yes}?

en: I knew I could count on you. Here, take this good and sturdy weapon in your hand. Then go back to my house and down the ladder. Good luck, and {bye} for now!
translated: Знао сам да могу да рачунам на тебе. Ево, узми ово добро и чврсто оружје у своју руку. Онда се врати у моју кућу и спусти се низ мердевине. Срећно, и {bye} за сада!

en: I knew you'd get it right away. You can loot food from many creatures, such as deer and rabbits. You can find them in the forest nearby. By the way... have you seen {Zirella}?
translated: Знао сам да ћеш то одмах добити. Можете пљачкати храну од многих створења, као што су јелени и зечеви. Можете их наћи у оближњој шуми. Успут... да ли сте видели {Zirella}?

en: Great, please go to my house, just a few steps south of here. Upstairs in my room, you'll find a chest. You can keep what you find inside of it! Come back after you got it and greet me to talk to me again. {Yes}?
translated: Супер, молим те иди у моју кућу, само неколико корака јужно одавде. Горе у мојој соби, наћи ћете сандук. Можете задржати оно што нађете у њему! Вратите се након што га добијете и поздравите ме да поново разговарате са мном. {Yes}?

en: Alright! Do you see the button called 'Quest Log'? There you can check the status of quests, like this one. {Bye} for now!
translated: У реду! Да ли видите дугме под називом 'Quest Log'? Тамо можете проверити статус задатака, попут ове. {Bye} за сада!

en: Ah, no need to say anything, I can see it suits you perfectly. Now we're getting to the fun part, let's get you armed! Are you ready for some {action}?
translated: Ах, не треба ништа да говорим, видим да ти савршено одговара. Сада прелазимо на забавни део, хајде да те наоружамо! Да ли сте спремни за {action}?

en: I'm not sailing there. This route is afflicted by a ghostship! However I've heard that Captain Fearless from Venore sails there.
translated: Non navigherò lì. Questa rotta è afflitta da una nave fantasma! Comunque ho sentito che Captain Fearless di Venore salpa lì.

en: I'm not sailing there. This route is afflicted by a ghostship! However I've heard that Captain Fearless from Venore sails there.

en: Many people who sailed to Darashia never returned because they were attacked by a ghostship! I'll never sail there!
translated: Molte persone che hanno navigato verso Darashia non sono mai tornate perché sono state attaccate da una nave fantasma! Non navigherò mai lì!

translated: Mi chiamo Capitano Orsoblu della Royal Tibia Line.

translated: Questo è Svargrond. Dove vuoi andare?

translated: Con editto diretto dell'onorevole Henricus, ci viene ordinato di concedere il passaggio a tutte le reclute a Thais.

en: Do you seek a passage to Thais for |TRAVELCOST|?
translated: Cerchi un passaggio a Thais per |TRAVELCOST|?

en: By direct edict of the honorable Henricus himself... well, you know.
translated: Per editto diretto dell'onorevole Henricus stesso... beh, lo sai.

en: By edict of the honorable Henricus himself, we are ordered to give passage to all recruits of the Roshamuul mission for a small fee.
translated: Per editto dello stesso onorevole Henricus, ci è stato ordinato di concedere il passaggio a tutte le reclute della missione Roshamuul dietro pagamento di una piccola tassa.

en: By direct edict of the honorable Henricus, we are ordered to give passage for all recruits to Thais.
translated: Con editto diretto dell'onorevole Henricus, ci viene ordinato di concedere il passaggio a tutte le reclute a Thais.

en: Oh, you don't wear it properly yet. You need to drag and drop it from your bag to your armor slot. Here, let me show you again. Is it a little {clearer} now?
translated: Ох, још га не носиш како треба. Морате га превући и испустити из торбе у свој оклоп. Ево, да вам покажем поново. Да ли је сада мало {clearer}?

en: Oh no, did you lose my coat? Well, lucky you, I have a spare one here. Don't lose it again! Now we're getting to the fun part, let's get you armed! Are you ready for some {action}?
translated: Ох не, јеси ли изгубио мој капут? Па, срећом, имам један резервни овде. Немојте га поново изгубити! Сада прелазимо на забавни део, хајде да те наоружамо! Да ли сте спремни за {action}?

en: I knew I could count on you. Here, take this good and sturdy weapon in your hand. Then go back to my house and down the ladder. Good luck, and {bye} for now!
translated: Знао сам да могу да рачунам на тебе. Ево, узми ово добро и чврсто оружје у своју руку. Онда се врати у моју кућу и спусти се низ мердевине. Срећно, и {bye} за сада!

en: Hey! You over there, could you help me with a little quest? Just say 'hi' or 'hello' to talk to me!
translated: Хеј! Ти тамо, можеш ли ми помоћи у малој потрази? Само реци 'hi' или 'hello' да разговараш са мном!

en: Don't be shy, can't hurt to greet me with 'hello' or 'hi'!
translated: Не стиди се, не би шкодило да ме поздравиш са 'hello' или 'hi'!

en: Good bye traveller, and enjoy your stay on Rookgaard.
translated: Збогом путниче и уживајте у боравку на Rookgaard.

en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
translated: Ох, молим вас уђите, |PLAYERNAME|. Шта могу учинити за вас? Ако вам треба авантуристичка опрема, тражите од мене {trade}.

en: I can bring you to our base in Liberty Bay for |TRAVELCOST|. Is that what you want?
translated: Posso portarti alla nostra base tra Liberty Bay per |TRAVELCOST|. È questo che vuoi?

en: Kid, listen. Answering with a clear {yes} or {no} will get you much further in Tibia. \z Most people are not as sharp-eared as I am. Got that?
translated: Ragazzo, ascolta. Rispondere con un chiaro {yes} o {no} ti porterà molto più lontano in Tibia. \z La maggior parte delle persone non ha le orecchie acute come me. Capito?

en:
She's pretty, isn't she? Will ship you safely to any port. Though a young landlubber such as you should \z
