translated:
È carina, vero? Ti spediremo in sicurezza in qualsiasi porto. Sebbene un giovane padrone di casa come te dovrebbe \z
	considera di viaggiare prima a Thais. Il viaggio è gratuito. Solo una volta però! Devi chiedere un {passage}.

en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
translated: Наравно, само прегледајте моју робу. {Footballs} се морају купити засебно.

en: |PLAYERNAME|. I have been watching your fate for quite some time. It's about time you came here. Do you seek to enter the riven island of Quirefang or travel back from where you came?
translated: |PLAYERNAME|. Посматрао сам твоју судбину већ дуже време. Било је време да дођеш овде. Да ли желите да уђете на острво Quirefang или се вратите одакле сте дошли?

en: He travelled on the very ground to reach the hostile shores of Quirefang. He used something that turned the soil and carved a way to the island. ...
translated: Путовао је по самом тлу да би стигао до непријатељских обала Quirefang. Користио је нешто што је окренуло земљу и уклесало пут до острва. ...

en: And you will find no shelter in Quirefang's black depths, where the creatures of the deep are fulfilling a dark prophecy. ...
translated: И нећете наћи уточиште у црним дубинама Quirefang, где створења дубине испуњавају мрачно пророчанство. ...

en: It is impossible to reach it by ship or boat. However, there was one before you. A {visitor} who found a way to enter the island.
translated: До њега је немогуће доћи бродом или чамцем. Међутим, био је један пре вас. {visitor} који је пронашао начин да уђе на острво.

en: Welcome, child. Have you come to learn about {magic}? Then you are in the right place. I can teach you many useful {spells}.
translated: Добродошли, дете. Јесте ли дошли да научите о {magic}? Онда сте на правом месту. Могу те научити много корисних {spells}.

en: Once you have reached level 8, you are ready to choose a vocation and go to the Tibian Mainland.
translated: Када достигнете ниво 8, спремни сте да изаберете занимање и одете на Тибијанско копно.

en: Your choice of vocation will determine your life in Tibia, and the skills and fighting techniques you may use. ...
translated: Ваш избор занимања ће одредити ваш живот у Tibia, као и вештине и технике борбе које можете користити. ...

en: Ah, you may not have heard of me. I am Captain Gulliver, the first Oramondian for a hundred years to have sailed through the mist to your strange lands.
translated: Ah, potresti non aver sentito parlare di me. Sono il Capitano Gulliver, il primo Oramondiano dopo cento anni ad aver navigato attraverso la nebbia verso le vostre strane terre.

en: The 'Sea Goddess' is the most beautiful in Oramond, a whole new model of ship, elegant, sure and swift. There's no weather she can't take!
translated: La 'Sea Goddess' è la più bella della Oramond, un modello di nave completamente nuovo, elegante, sicura e veloce. Non c'è tempo che non possa sopportare!

en: Ah, your lands are quite a sight! I have only visited Thais so far, but I think of navigating to more cities, when the time - and public demand - comes.
translated: Ah, le tue terre sono proprio uno spettacolo! Finora ho visitato solo Thais, ma penso di spostarmi verso più città, quando arriverà il momento e la domanda del pubblico.

en: Passages to Thais and Krailos! Visit the strange lands!
translated: Passaggi a Thais e Krailos! Visita le terre strane!

en:
Oh, it's not too bad here, believe me. At least I always get young and enthusiast disciples! \z
		Though I must confess I miss the vastness of the Tibian plains. <sighs>
translated:
Ох, није лоше овде, верујте ми. Бар увек добијам младе и ентузијасте ученике! \з
		Иако морам признати да ми недостаје пространство тибијанских равница. <sighs>

en: I know Marvik in Thais. He once helped me with a furuncle I had on my ...ahh, doesn't matter. He's a nice gran'pa, though!
translated: Conosco Marvik a Thais. Una volta mi ha aiutato con un foruncolo che avevo sul...ahh, non importa. È un bravo nonno, però!

en: Welcome to my fruit and vegetable store, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a {trade} if you'd like to see my wares.
translated: Добродошли у моју продавницу воћа и поврћа, |PLAYERNAME|! Замолите ме за {trade} ако желите да видите моју робу.

en: Defeat. {Slime}. We. Will. Why. Did. You. Kill. Us? Do. You. Want. To. Rectify. And. Help?
translated: Пораз. {Slime}. Ми. Вилл. Зашто. Јесте. Ви. Убиј. нас? Уради. Ви. Желим. То. Исправите. И. Помоћ?

en: Already got enough, huh? I kind o' expected that, landlubber! Let's head for Svargrond! Ready?
translated: Ne hai già abbastanza, eh? Me lo aspettavo, marinaio! Andiamo verso Svargrond! Pronto?

en: Y' already wanna give up?? I should've known. I bring ya back to Svargrond, 'kay?
translated: Vuoi già arrenderti?? Avrei dovuto saperlo. Ti riporto a Svargrond, ok?

translated: Questo è Ab'Dendriel. Dove vuoi andare?

en: The Royal Tibia Line connects all seaside towns of Tibia.
translated: La linea Royal Tibia collega tutte le località marittime di Tibia.

en: The Royal Tibia Line connects all seaside towns of Tibia.
translated: La linea Royal Tibia collega tutte le località marittime di Tibia.

en: The Royal Tibia Line connects all seaside towns of Tibia.
translated: La linea Royal Tibia collega tutte le località marittime di Tibia.

en: This is Edron. Where do you want to go?
translated: Questo è Edron. Dove vuoi andare?

en: I'm sorry, but we don't serve this route. However, I heard that Wyrdin here in Edron is looking for adventurers to go on a trip to Yalahar for him.
translated: Mi dispiace, ma non serviamo questa rotta. Tuttavia, ho sentito che Wyrdin qui a Edron sta cercando avventurieri con cui fare un viaggio a Yalahar per lui.

en: You are pretty inexperienced. I think killing rats is a suitable challenge for you. For each fresh {dead rat} I will give you two shiny coins of gold.
translated: Прилично сте неискусни. Мислим да је убијање пацова прикладан изазов за вас. За сваки свеж {dead rat} даћу вам два сјајна златника.

en: This is an island with {vocation} teachers. You can learn all about the different vocations there once you are level 8.
translated: Ово је острво са {vocation} учитељима. Тамо можете научити све о различитим занимањима када достигнете 8. ниво.

en: It's |TIME|, so you are late. Hurry!
My name is Seymour, but for you I am 'Sir' Seymour.
translated: Моје име је Сеимоур, али за тебе сам 'Sir' Сеимоур.

en: I'm the master of this fine {academy}, giving {lessons} to my students.
translated: Ја сам господар ове казне {academy}, дајем {lessons} својим ученицима.

en: Do you seek a passage back to Liberty Bay for |TRAVELCOST|?
translated: Cerchi un passaggio per tornare a Liberty Bay per |TRAVELCOST|?

en: My father wanted me to marry a wealthy Venorean. He understood so little about love and the ways of the heart.
translated: Mio padre voleva che sposassi una ricca venereana. Capiva così poco dell'amore e delle vie del cuore.

en: We put all our hope in this far away colony. Sadly, we never made it there and I will never know what our life would have been like in Port Hope.
translated: Riponiamo tutte le nostre speranze in questa colonia lontana. Purtroppo non siamo mai arrivati ​​lì e non saprò mai come sarebbe stata la nostra vita nel Port Hope.

en: The bustling streets of Thais are all but a faint memory to me.
translated: Le affollate strade di Thais sono quasi un vago ricordo per me.

en: Carlin is a lovely and green city as far as I remember.
translated: Carlin è una città incantevole e verde per quanto ricordo.

en: Hello again, |PLAYERNAME|! What are you still doing here? You should head over the bridge to Rookgaard village now!
translated: Ciao di nuovo, |PLAYERNAME|! Cosa ci fai ancora qui? Dovresti andare oltre il ponte verso il villaggio Rookgaard adesso!

en: Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|! Well, that's how trading with NPCs like me works. I think you are ready now to cross the bridge to Rookgaard! Take care!
translated: Ehi, |PLAYERNAME|! Bene, è così che funziona il commercio con gli NPC come me. Penso che tu sia pronto ora per attraversare il ponte verso Rookgaard! Occuparsi!

en: Well, that's how trading with NPCs like me works. I think you are ready now to cross the bridge to Rookgaard, just follow the path to the northwest. Good luck, |PLAYERNAME|! ...
translated: Bene, è così che funziona il commercio con gli NPC come me. Penso che tu sia pronto ora per attraversare il ponte verso Rookgaard, segui semplicemente il percorso verso nord-ovest. Buona fortuna, |PLAYERNAME|! ...

en: Well, that's how trading with NPCs like me works. I think you are ready now to cross the bridge to Rookgaard, just follow the path to the northwest. Good luck, |PLAYERNAME|! ...
translated: Bene, è così che funziona il commercio con gli NPC come me. Penso che tu sia pronto ora per attraversare il ponte verso Rookgaard, segui semplicemente il percorso verso nord-ovest. Buona fortuna, |PLAYERNAME|! ...

en: In a bank you can deposit your earned gold coins safely. Just go downstairs to {Paulie} and ask him to {deposit} your money.
translated: У банци можете безбедно депоновати своје зарађене златнике. Само идите доле до {Paulie} и замолите га да {deposit} ваш новац.

en: Well, the {king} doesn't send troops anymore, the {academy} is dreadfully low on money, and the end of the world is pretty nigh. Apart from that I'm reasonably fine, I suppose.
translated: Па, {king} више не шаље трупе, {academy} има ужасно мало новца, а смак света је прилично близу. Осим тога, ја сам прилично добро, претпостављам.

en: Most of the citizens here are {merchants}. You can give me the name of any non-player character and I will tell you something about him or her.
translated: Већина грађана овде је {merchants}. Можете ми дати име било ког лика који није играч и рећи ћу вам нешто о њему или њој.

en: Merchants buy and sell goods. Just ask them for a {trade} to see what they offer or buy from you.
translated: Трговци купују и продају робу. Само их замолите за {trade} да видите шта нуде или купују од вас.

en: Trolls are quite nasty monsters which you shouldn't face before level 3 or 4 depending on your {equipment}. Ask the bridge {guards} for their locations!
translated: Тролови су прилично гадна чудовишта са којима се не би требало суочити пре нивоа 3 или 4 у зависности од вашег {equipment}. Питајте мост {guards} за њихове локације!

en: The guards {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus} protect our village from {monsters} trying to enter. They also mark useful {dungeon} locations on your map.
translated: Стражари {Dallheim} и {Zerbrus} штите наше село од покушаја {monsters} да уђе. Они такође означавају корисне {dungeon} локације на вашој мапи.

en: Sorcerers are talented elemental magicians. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
translated: Чаробњаци су талентовани магичари елемената. Научићете све о њима када достигнете ниво 8 и стигнете до острва {Destiny}.

en: Knights are strong melee fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
translated: Витезови су јаки борбени борци. Научићете све о њима када достигнете ниво 8 и стигнете до острва {Destiny}.

en: Druids are nature magic users and great healers. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
translated: Друиди су корисници магије природе и одлични исцелитељи. Научићете све о њима када достигнете ниво 8 и стигнете до острва {Destiny}.

en: Paladins are swift distance fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
translated: Паладини су брзи борци на даљину. Научићете све о њима када достигнете ниво 8 и стигнете до острва {Destiny}.

en: Well, that's how trading with NPCs like me works. I think you are ready now to cross the bridge to Rookgaard, just follow the path to the northwest. Good luck, |PLAYERNAME|! ...
translated: Bene, è così che funziona il commercio con gli NPC come me. Penso che tu sia pronto ora per attraversare il ponte verso Rookgaard, segui semplicemente il percorso verso nord-ovest. Buona fortuna, |PLAYERNAME|! ...

en: Good bye traveller and enjoy your stay on Rookgaard.
translated: Arrivederci viaggiatore e buon soggiorno su Rookgaard.

en: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Ci sono cinque benedizioni disponibili in cinque luoghi sacri: lo scudo {spiritual}, la scintilla del {phoenix}, il {embrace} di Tibia, il fuoco del {suns} e la saggezza di {solitude}. Inoltre, puoi ricevere il {twist of fate} qui.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Sento che i druidi a nord di Carlin ti hanno fornito l'Abbraccio di Tibia.

en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la benedizione dei due soli nella torre del sole vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Sento che la scintilla della fenice ti è già stata donata dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
translated: Sento che hai già parlato con l'eremita Eremo sull'isola di Cormaya e hai ricevuto questa benedizione.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione della protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
translated: I druidi a nord di Carlin ti forniranno l'abbraccio di Tibia.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione dei due soli nella torre solare vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: La scintilla della fenice è data dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: We have a {weapon} and an {armor} shop south of the academy. {Equipment} such as {ropes} are sold to the north-west. {Potions} can be bought to the south. And then there are the {farms}.
translated: Имамо продавницу {weapon} и {armor} јужно од академије. {Equipment} као што је {ropes} се продају на северозападу. {Potions} се може купити на југу. А ту су и {farms}.

en: The world of Tibia is very large with tons of places to explore. Vast deserts, Caribbean islands, deep jungles, green meadows and jagged mountains await you!
translated: Свет Tibia је веома велики са мноштвом места за истраживање. Очекују вас огромне пустиње, карипска острва, дубоке џунгле, зелене ливаде и назубљене планине!

en: Your current health is shown by the red bar on the right side. {Death} awaits you if it goes down to zero.
translated: Ваше тренутно здравље је приказано црвеном траком на десној страни. {Death} вас чека ако падне на нулу.

en: Dying in Tibia is painful, so try to avoid it. You will lose part of your {experience} points and also equipment. Make sure your {health} always stays up!
translated: Умирање у Tibia је болно, па покушајте да то избегнете. Изгубићете део својих {experience} поена, као и опрему. Уверите се да ваш {health} увек стоји!

en: You gain experience when fighting {monsters}. You can take a look at your skill window to check your progress.
translated: Стичете искуство када се борите {monsters}. Можете да погледате прозор своје вештине да проверите свој напредак.

en: Good monsters to start hunting are {rats}. They live in the {sewers} below the village.
translated: Добра чудовишта за почетак лова су {rats}. Живе у {sewers} испод села.

en: One entrance to the sewers is south of this {academy}. Look for a sewer grate, then use it to climb down.
translated: Један улаз у канализацију је јужно од овог {academy}. Потражите решетку за канализацију, а затим је користите да се спустите.

en: The academy is the building you are standing in. We have a {library}, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}.
translated: Академија је зграда у којој стојите. Имамо {library}, а {bank} и собу {oracle}.

en: Make money by killing {monsters} and picking up their {loot}. You can sell many of the things they carry.
translated: Зарадите новац тако што ћете убити {monsters} и покупити њихов {loot}. Можете продати многе ствари које носе.

en: I hope that I am not asking too much of you with this task. I heard of a flower which is currently unique in Tibia and can survive at only one place. ...
translated: Spero di non chiedervi troppo con questo compito. Ho sentito parlare di un fiore che attualmente è unico in Tibia e può sopravvivere in un solo posto. ...

en: In the mountains between Ankrahmun and Tiquanda are two hydra lairs. The nothern one has many waterfalls whereas the southern one has just tiny water trickles. ...
translated: Nelle montagne tra Ankrahmun e Tiquanda ci sono due tane di idra. Quella a nord ha molte cascate mentre quella a sud ha solo piccoli rivoli d'acqua. ...

en: However, these trickles are said to contain water as pure and clean as nowhere else in Tibia. ...
translated: Tuttavia, si dice che questi rivoli contengano acqua pura e pulita come in nessun altro posto in Tibia. ...

en: Unfortunately, my intrusion was discovered and I had to run for my life. During my escape, I lost my favourite wolf tooth chain.
translated: Sfortunatamente, la mia intrusione è stata scoperta e ho dovuto scappare per salvarmi la vita. Durante la mia fuga, ho perso la mia catena preferita con i denti di lupo.

en: Right, I will keep my promise. Faolan roams Tibia freely, but her favourite sleeping cave is on Cormaya. I will now enchant you so you will be able to speak the wolf language.
translated: Giusto, manterrò la mia promessa. Faolan vaga liberamente su Tibia, ma la sua grotta per dormire preferita è su Cormaya. Ora ti incanterò così potrai parlare la lingua del lupo.

en: Few ship captains would sail this route. But if you want to take the risk, I can bring you to Thais, Edron, Liberty Bay or Yalahar for less gold than usual. Interested?
translated: Pochi capitani di navi percorrerebbero questa rotta. Ma se vuoi correre il rischio, posso portarti a Thais, Edron, Liberty Bay o Yalahar per meno oro del solito. Interessato?

en: Once a monster is dead, you can select 'Open' on the {corpse} to check what's inside. Sometimes they carry {money} or other items which you can sell to {merchants}.
translated: Када је чудовиште мртво, можете да изаберете 'Open' на {corpse} да проверите шта је унутра. Понекад носе {money} или друге предмете које можете продати на {merchants}.

en: You can even sell some corpses! For example, you can sell fresh dead rats to {Tom} the tanner or me. He also buys other dead creatures, just ask him for a {trade}.
translated: Можете чак и продати неке лешеве! На пример, можете продати свеже мртве пацове {Tom} кожару или мени. Такође купује и друга мртва створења, само га замолите за {trade}.

en: You definitely need a rope to progress in dungeons, else you might end up stuck. Buy one from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
translated: Дефинитивно вам је потребан конопац да напредујете у тамницама, иначе бисте могли да заглавите. Купите један од {Al Dee} или {Lee'Delle}.

en: A shovel is needed to dig some {dungeon} entrances open. 'Use' it on a loose stone pile to make a hole large enough to enter.
translated: Потребна је лопата да би се отворили неки {dungeon} улази. 'Use' на лабавој каменој гомили да направи рупу довољно велику да уђе.

en: You should not descend into dungeons without proper {equipment}. Once you are all prepared, ask the bridge {guards} for suitable {monsters}.
translated: Не би требало да се спуштате у тамнице без одговарајућег {equipment}. Када будете спремни, тражите од моста {guards} одговарајући {monsters}.

en: A torch will provide you with light in dark {dungeons}. 'Use' it to light it. You can buy them from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
translated: Бакља ће вам пружити светлост у мраку {dungeons}. 'Use' да га упали. Можете их купити од {Al Dee} или {Lee'Delle}.

en: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
translated: Па, могао бих да вам дам драгоцено {lessons} или нешто опште {hints} о игри, или мало {quest} ако сте заинтересовани.

en: A sturdy leather helmet is a good choice for a beginner. You can either buy it from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong enough, {loot} them from {trolls}.
translated: Чврста кожна кацига је добар избор за почетнике. Можете га купити или од {Dixi} и {Lee'Delle}, или, када будете довољно јаки, {loot} њих од {trolls}.

en: I fear you have to buy your first shield by yourself. A wooden shield from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} is a good choice.
translated: Бојим се да морате сами да купите свој први штит. Дрвени штит од {Dixi} или {Lee'Delle} је добар избор.

en: Leather boots are basic shoes which will protect you well. You can either buy them from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong enough, {loot} them from {trolls}.
translated: Кожне чизме су основне ципеле које ће вас добро заштитити. Можете их купити од {Dixi} и {Lee'Delle}, или, када будете довољно јаки, {loot} их од {trolls}.

en: Passages to Thais, Darashia, Edron, Venore, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay and Yalahar.
translated: Passaggi a Thais, Darashia, Edron, Venore, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay e Yalahar.

en: Passages to Thais, Darashia, Edron, Venore, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay and Yalahar.
translated: Passaggi a Thais, Darashia, Edron, Venore, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay e Yalahar.

en: Fine. You have {} \z attunements left. What is the new city of your choice? Thais, Carlin, Ab'Dendriel, Kazordoon, Venore, \z Ankrahmun, Edron, Darashia, Liberty Bay or Port Hope?
translated: Bene. Ti restano {} \z attivazioni. Qual è la nuova città che hai scelto? Thais, Carlin, Ab'Dendriel, Kazordoon, Venore, \z Ankrahmun, Edron, Darashia, Liberty Bay o Port Hope?

en: If you can find some of the nutritious, juicy {roots} in the outskirts of Rathleton, bring them here. We will gladly take bundles of five roots each, and hey - helping us, helps you in the long term, trust me.
translated: Se riesci a trovare alcuni dei nutrienti e succosi {roots} nella periferia di Rathleton, portali qui. Prenderemo volentieri mazzi di cinque radici ciascuno e, ehi, aiutarci, ti aiuta a lungo termine, fidati di me.

en: Leather legs might be a good basic protection. You can buy them from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle}. Or, once you are strong enough, hunt {trolls}. They sometimes carry them in their {loot}.
translated: Кожне ноге могу бити добра основна заштита. Можете их купити од {Dixi} или {Lee'Delle}. Или, када будете довољно јаки, ловите {trolls}. Понекад их носе у својим {loot}.

en: Many monsters, such as rabbits or deer, are excellent food providers. You can also buy food from {Willie} or {Billy}, the farmers.
translated: Многа чудовишта, као што су зечеви или јелени, одлични су добављачи хране. Такође можете купити храну од фармера {Willie} или {Billy}.

en: Paying for your Tibia account will turn it into a premium account. This means access to more areas and functions of the game as well as other neat features.
translated: Плаћање за ваш Tibia налог ће га претворити у премиум налог. То значи приступ већем броју области и функција игре, као и другим згодним функцијама.

en: Hail to King Tibianus! Long live our king! Not that he cares for an old veteran who is stuck on this godforsaken island...
translated: Поздрав краљу Тибијану! Живео наш краљ! Није да му је стало до старог ветерана који је заглављен на овом богом заборављеном острву...

en: Use a small health potion in case of emergencies to fill up around 75 health points. You can buy them at {Lily}'s shop. She also has {antidote} potions.
translated: Користите мали напитак здравља у хитним случајевима да попуните око 75 здравствених поена. Можете их купити у продавници {Lily}. Она такође има {antidote} напитке.

en: The island is separated into a {premium} side and a non-premium side. On both sides you will find {dungeons}, but the premium side tends to be a little less crowded with other players.
translated: Острво је подељено на страну {premium} и страну која није премијум. На обе стране ћете наћи {dungeons}, али премиум страна има тенденцију да буде мало мање претрпана другим играчима.

en: The city of Thais is reigned by King Tibianus. Of course, there are many other cities but you will learn about them later.
translated: Градом Thais влада краљ Тибијан. Наравно, има много других градова, али о њима ћете сазнати касније.

en: There is a bridge to the north and one to the west which lead outside the village. You should only leave once you are well {equipped} and at least level 2.
translated: На северу и на западу има моста који воде ван села. Требало би да одете тек када оздравите {equipped} и бар на нивоу 2.

en: You can leave for mainland once you are level 8. To do so talk to the {oracle}.
translated: Можете да одете на копно када достигнете ниво 8. Да бисте то урадили, разговарајте са {oracle}.

en: Just recently we were able to secretly help our elven friends to exposure an agitator sent by Carlin to poison our connections with them. The elves' reaction wasswift and without compromise ...
translated: Proprio di recente siamo riusciti ad aiutare segretamente i nostri amici elfi a smascherare un agitatore inviato da Carlin per avvelenare le nostre connessioni con loro. La reazione degli elfi fu rapida e senza compromessi...

en: These papers can tell us much about Carlin's plans in the North. We need you to enter 'Hellgate' and to retrieve the papers for us ...
translated: Questi documenti possono dirci molto sui piani di Carlin nel Nord. Abbiamo bisogno che tu entri 'Hellgate' e recuperi i documenti per noi...

en: One of our agents is missing. He was investigating the cause for the slow growth of our colony Port Hope ...
translated: Uno dei nostri agenti è scomparso. Stava indagando sulla causa della lenta crescita della nostra colonia Port Hope ...

en: You will continue these investigations at the point where the information that the lost agent has sent us ends. Some of the traders in Port Hope must have connections to persons who are interested in sabotaging our efforts in Tiquanda ...
translated: Continuerai queste indagini nel punto in cui finiscono le informazioni che ci ha inviato l'agente scomparso. Alcuni trader in Port Hope devono avere collegamenti con persone interessate a sabotare i nostri sforzi in Tiquanda...

en: A mad dwarven technomancer that listens to the name of Blowbeard sent us a blackmailing letter. He demands to deliver all of Thais's gold to him. Else he will destroy the city with an artificial earthquake caused by one of his machines! ...
translated: Un pazzo tecnomante nano che ascolta il nome di Blowbeard ci ha inviato una lettera di ricatto. Chiede di consegnargli tutto l'oro di Thais. Altrimenti distruggerà la città con un terremoto artificiale causato da una delle sue macchine! ...

en: As he is already missing since decades it is unlikely that he is still alive. Nevertheless, we want you to find out something about the whereabouts of our agent in the ruins in the Green Claw Swamp, north west of Venore ...
translated: Poiché risulta disperso già da decenni, è improbabile che sia ancora vivo. Tuttavia, vogliamo che tu scopra qualcosa su dove si trova il nostro agente tra le rovine nella Palude di Artiglio Verde, a nord-ovest di Venore...

en: Your first task is to deliver a warning. Illegally, the Venoreans are crafting more ships than the Thaian authorities have allowed them ...
translated: Il tuo primo compito è fornire un avviso. Illegalmente, i Venoreani stanno costruendo più navi di quante le autorità tailandesi abbiano loro concesso...

en: An official note would strain the relationship between Thais and Venore too much as this would mean that we had to admit officially that we know about those activities ...
translated: Una nota ufficiale metterebbe troppo a dura prova il rapporto tra Thais e Venore poiché ciò significherebbe che dovremmo ammettere ufficialmente di essere a conoscenza di quelle attività...

en: Still, we can't allow them to continue like this. It will be your task to let them know that we do not tolerate such behaviour. Get a fire bug from Liberty Bay and set their shipyard on fire ...
translated: Tuttavia, non possiamo permettere che continuino così. Sarà tuo compito far loro sapere che non tolleriamo tale comportamento. Ottieni un fuoco da Liberty Bay e dai fuoco al loro cantiere navale...

en: We need you to find his base in Kazordoon and to kill him before he can use his infernal machine. Bring us his beard as proof of your success.
translated: Abbiamo bisogno che tu trovi la sua base in Kazordoon e uccidilo prima che possa usare la sua macchina infernale. Portaci la sua barba come prova del tuo successo.

en: You will swear allegiance to Thais alone and abandon the service of any other city. So is it really your wish to become one of our field agents?
translated: Giurerai fedeltà solo a Thais e abbandonerai il servizio di qualsiasi altra città. Quindi desideri davvero diventare uno dei nostri agenti sul campo?

en: The women of Carlin have the northern city Svargrond in the firm grip of her manicured hands. At the moment, there is little we can do about it but there is one thing that plays into our hands ...
translated: Le donne di Carlin tengono la città del nord Svargrond nella salda presa delle sue mani curate. Al momento possiamo fare poco, ma c'è una cosa che gioca a nostro favore...

en: The barbarians have surely at least heard about the fact that alcohol is outlawed in Carlin ...
translated: I barbari sicuramente hanno almeno sentito parlare del fatto che l'alcol è bandito in Carlin...

en: It's bad enough that Carlin got a solid foothold in the far North but now the Venoreans also try to move in. They try to gain influence on the barbarian raiders by bribing their leaders or making them great promises ...
translated: È già abbastanza brutto che Carlin abbia ottenuto un solido punto d'appoggio nell'estremo nord, ma ora anche i Venoreani provano a trasferirsi. Cercano di ottenere influenza sui predoni barbari corrompendo i loro leader o facendo loro grandi promesse...

en: Here is a signet ring that the Venorean emissaries use to wear. 'Lose' the ring in the north-western corner of the highest level of the tower. They will surely find it there.
translated: Ecco un anello con sigillo che gli emissari venereani usano indossare. 'Lose' l'anello nell'angolo nord-occidentale del livello più alto della torre. Lo troveranno sicuramente lì.

en: The more you fight with a weapon, the better will be your skill handling this weapon. Don't worry about that right now though, this will become important once you have a {vocation}.
translated: Што се више борите са оружјем, то ће боље бити ваше вештине руковања овим оружјем. Не брините о томе сада, ово ће постати важно када добијете {vocation}.

en: Once you gained enough experience for a level, you will advance. This means - among other things - more {health} points, a faster walking speed and more strength to carry things.
translated: Када стекнете довољно искуства за ниво, напредоваћете. То значи – између осталог – више {health} поена, већу брзину хода и више снаге за ношење ствари.

en: The farms are west of here. You can buy and sell {food} there which you need to regain {health}.
translated: Фарме су западно одавде. Тамо можете купити и продати {food} које треба да повратите {health}.

en: Now that Venore is of nearly no importance anymore, there is only Carlin left to deal with.
translated: Ora che Venore non ha quasi più alcuna importanza, rimane solo Carlin da affrontare.

en: To attack a rat, simply click on it in your battle list. Make sure that you have proper {equipment}, though! Also, I give you 2 gold coins for each {dead rat}.
translated: Да бисте напали пацова, једноставно кликните на њега у својој борбеној листи. Ипак, уверите се да имате одговарајуће {equipment}! Такође, дајем вам 2 златника за сваки {dead rat}.

en: I already heard that our little trick worked quite well. Several officials of Carlin are already on their way to repair the damage done to their diplomatic efforts. It will not only cost them much money but also quite some time.
translated: Ho già sentito che il nostro trucchetto ha funzionato abbastanza bene. Diversi funzionari di Carlin sono già in viaggio per riparare il danno arrecato ai loro sforzi diplomatici. Non solo costerà loro molti soldi ma anche parecchio tempo.

en: I personally don't have anything to trade, but you can ask {merchants} for a trade. That will open a window where you can see their offers and the things they buy from you.
translated: Ја лично немам чиме да тргујем, али можете тражити {merchants} за трговину. То ће отворити прозор у којем можете видети њихове понуде и ствари које купују од вас.

en: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
translated: Па, могао бих да вам дам драгоцено {lessons} или нешто опште {hints} о игри, или мало {quest} ако сте заинтересовани.

en: I think they understood the warning the way it was meant. If not, you will have to visit Venore soon again. But for now it's settled.
translated: Penso che abbiano capito l'avvertimento nel modo in cui era inteso. In caso contrario, dovrai visitare di nuovo Venore presto. Ma per ora è deciso.

en: Hahaha! Grarkharok take cloak from pretty girl. Then ... girl is swan. Grarkharok wants eat but flies away. Grarkharok not understand. Not need cloak, too many feathers. Give cloak to To ... Ta ... Tereban in Edron. Getting shiny coins and meat.
translated: Ahahah! Grarkharok prende il mantello dalla bella ragazza. Allora... la ragazza è un cigno. Grarkharok vuole mangiare ma vola via. Grarkharok non capisce. Non serve il mantello, troppe piume. Dai il mantello a To... Ta... Terebano in Edron. Ottenere monete e carne luccicanti.

en: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
translated: Збогом, |PLAYERNAME|! И запамтите: нема трчања горе-доле у ​​академији!

en: Obi sells and buys {weapons}. You can find his shop south of the academy.
translated: Оби продаје и купује {weapons}. Можете пронаћи његову радњу јужно од академије.

en: Al Dee has a general {equipment} store in the north-western part of the village. He sells useful stuff such as {ropes}.
translated: Ал Ди има општу продавницу {equipment} у северозападном делу села. Он продаје корисне ствари као што је {ropes}.

en: A traveller from the {main} continent. I wonder what brought her here. No one comes here of his own free will.
translated: Путник са континента {main}. Питам се шта ју је довело овде. Нико овде не долази својом вољом.

en: Billy is {Willie}'s cousin, but he has his farm on the {premium} side of the village.
translated: Били је {Willie} рођак, али има своју фарму на {premium} страни села.

en: Willie is a fine farmer, although he is short-tempered. He sells and buys {food}.
translated: Вили је добар фармер, иако је ћудљив. Он продаје и купује {food}.

en: A humble monk living in the {temple} south of here. He can heal you if you are wounded or poisoned.
translated: Скромни монах који живи у {temple} јужно одавде. Он вас може излечити ако сте рањени или отровани.

en: Secondly, the high ape magicians of Banuta use banana staves. I would love to learn more about these staves, so please bring me 5 of them also. ...
translated: In secondo luogo, gli alti maghi delle scimmie di Banuta usano bastoncini di banana. Mi piacerebbe saperne di più su questi righi, quindi per favore portamene anche 5. ...

en: The dworcs of Tiquanda like to wear certain tribal masks which I would like to take a look at. Please bring me 5 of these masks. ...
translated: Ai dworc di Tiquanda piace indossare alcune maschere tribali a cui vorrei dare un'occhiata. Per favore, portami 5 di queste maschere. ...

en: Ten prayers for a blessed stake? Don't tell me they made you travel whole Tibia for it! Listen, child, if you bring me a wooden stake, I'll bless it for you. <chuckles>
translated: Dieci preghiere per un palo benedetto? Non dirmi che ti hanno fatto viaggiare intero Tibia per questo! Ascolta, bambina, se mi porti un paletto di legno, te lo benedirò. <ridacchia>

en: Obviously he wasn't pleased with this place, because he headed for Thais the next day. ...
translated: Очигледно није био задовољан овим местом, јер је следећег дана кренуо ка Thais. ...

en: I guess my last {prisoner} forgot it there.
translated: Претпостављам да сам га задњи {prisoner} заборавио тамо.

en: What do you think? I am the sheriff of Carlin.
translated: Шта мислиш? Ја сам шериф Carlin.

en: The castle is one of the safest places in Carlin.
translated: Замак је једно од најбезбеднијих места у Carlin.

en: Only a few people live in our village, most of them are {merchants}. You can either ask them for a {trade} or about various other topics, like the names of other citizens, their {job} or Tibia in general.
translated: Solo poche persone vivono nel nostro villaggio, la maggior parte sono {merchants}. Puoi chiedere loro un {trade} o su vari altri argomenti, come i nomi di altri cittadini, il loro {job} o Tibia in generale.

en: There are four vocations in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each vocation has its unique special abilities.
translated: Ci sono quattro vocazioni in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} o {druid}. Ogni vocazione ha le sue abilità speciali uniche.

en: Knights are close combat fighters. They usually wield melee weapons such as swords, axes or clubs.
translated: I cavalieri sono combattenti da combattimento ravvicinato. Di solito brandiscono armi da mischia come spade, asce o mazze.

en: Druids are nature magicians. Their speciality is casting ice and earth magic, as well as providing healing for others.
translated: I druidi sono maghi della natura. La loro specialità è lanciare la magia del ghiaccio e della terra, oltre a fornire cure agli altri.

en: Paladins are well-trained distance fighters and can cast holy magic. You will usually see them wearing bows or crossbows.
translated: I paladini sono combattenti a distanza ben addestrati e possono lanciare magie sacre. Di solito li vedrai indossare archi o balestre.

en: Sorcerers are elemental magicians. They have mastered fire, energy and death magic.
translated: Gli stregoni sono maghi elementali. Hanno imparato la magia del fuoco, dell'energia e della morte.

en: Welcome to the temple of Rookgaard!
Welcome to the temple of Rookgaard!
Grace our home with another visit soon, |PLAYERNAME|.
translated: Ускоро улепшајте наш дом још једном посетом, |PLAYERNAME|.

en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Welcome to our humble farm.
translated: Здраво |PLAYERNAME|! Добродошли на нашу скромну фарму.

en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
translated: Ох, молим вас уђите, |PLAYERNAME|. Шта могу учинити за вас? Ако вам треба авантуристичка опрема, тражите од мене {trade}.

en: Gives newcomers hints how we do things here in Tibia. Don't know how to use something? Ask Inigo.
translated: Dà ai nuovi arrivati ​​suggerimenti su come facciamo le cose qui in Tibia. Non sai come usare qualcosa? Chiedi a Inigo.

en: Get your gear and help us defend Dawnport against the monsters!
translated: Prendi la tua attrezzatura e aiutaci a difendere Dawnport dai mostri!

en: Get your gear and help us defend Dawnport against the monsters!
translated: Prendi la tua attrezzatura e aiutaci a difendere Dawnport dai mostri!

en: Hello fighter. I guess you are here to {fight} for our noble {cause}.
translated: Здраво борац. Претпостављам да сте овде због {fight} за наш племенити {cause}.

en: We allow able champions of all races to fight for our cause against the challenges of the {arena}. So are you interested? I'm not interested in fancy'wordplay, so a simple {yes} or {no} will suffice!
translated: Дозвољавамо способним шампионима свих раса да се боре за нашу ствар против изазова {arena}. Дакле, да ли сте заинтересовани? Не занима ме фенси игра речи, тако да ће једноставно {yes} или {no} бити довољно!

en: Ahh, Amanda from Edron sent you! I hope she's doing well. So why did she send you here?
translated: Ahh, ti ha mandato Amanda di Edron! Spero che stia bene. Allora perché ti ha mandato qui?

en: Persistent little nuisance, aren't we? Well, I like your spirit so I will tell you a secret. I may not look the part but I was once a {scientist}. The academy seemed to not like my... attitude and never actually invited me.
translated: Упорна мала сметња, зар не? Па, свиђа ми се твој дух па ћу ти рећи једну тајну. Можда не изгледам као део, али сам једном био {scientist}. Чинило се да се академији не свиђа мој... став и никада ме заправо није позвала.

en:
When Carlin tried to colonize the region now known as the ghostlands, \z
				my ancestors put their fortune in that {project}.
translated:
Quando Carlin tentò di colonizzare la regione ora conosciuta come le terre fantasma, \z
				i miei antenati hanno messo la loro fortuna in quello {project}.

en:
When Carlin tried to colonize the region now known as the ghostlands, \z
				my ancestors put their fortune in that {project}.
translated:
Quando Carlin tentò di colonizzare la regione ora conosciuta come le terre fantasma, \z
				i miei antenati hanno messo la loro fortuna in quello {project}.

en: The most dangerous monsters of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.
translated: I mostri più pericolosi di Rookgaard si trovano dall'altra parte di questo ponte.

en: I'm the guard of this bridge. I defend Rookgaard against the beasts of the {wilderness} and the {dungeons}, and even of the stinking {sewers}.
translated: Sono la guardia di questo ponte. Difendo Rookgaard dalle bestie del {wilderness} e del {dungeons}, e anche dai puzzolenti {sewers}.

en: Did you know that rats are among the most dangerous animals in whole Tibia? Each day, they kill many people who are overestimating their powers. Don't be one of them!
translated: Sapevi che i ratti sono tra gli animali più pericolosi in assoluto Tibia? Ogni giorno uccidono molte persone che sopravvalutano i propri poteri. Non essere uno di loro!

en: Orcs are a constant menace. There are even stronger species of orcs on the main continent.
translated: Gli orchi sono una minaccia costante. Ci sono specie di orchi ancora più forti nel continente principale.

en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
translated: Да? Шта могу учинити за тебе, |PLAYERNAME|? Банкарски послови, можда?

en: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
translated: Не заборавите да положите свој новац овде у Тибиан Банк пре него што кренете у авантуру.

en: Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|. If you are in need of potions or magical equipment, just ask me about my {offers}.
translated: Будите поздрављени, |PLAYERNAME|. Ако су вам потребни напитци или магијска опрема, само ме питајте о мом {offers}.

en: Take this jug here and travel to the jungle of Tiquanda. There you will find a race of wood eating ants called termites. Use the jug on one of their hills to catch some of them ...
translated: Узми овај врч овде и путуј у џунглу Tiquanda. Тамо ћете наћи расу мрава који једу дрво под називом термити. Користите врч на једном од њихових брда да ухватите неке од њих...

en: Then find someone in Svargrond that brings you to Tyrsung. There, release the termites on the bottom of a mast in the hull of the hunters' ship. If you are done, report to me about your mission.
translated: Затим пронађите некога у Svargrond који ће вас довести до Тирсунга. Тамо пустите термите на дну јарбола у трупу ловачког брода. Ако сте завршили, јавите ми о својој мисији.

en: Minotaurs are very strong. You will need a group of people or at least level 6 and good equipment to be able to kill them.
translated: Minotaurs sono molto forti. Avrai bisogno di un gruppo di persone o almeno di livello 6 e di un buon equipaggiamento per poterli uccidere.

en: The most dangerous monsters of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.
translated: I mostri più pericolosi di Rookgaard si trovano dall'altra parte di questo ponte.

en: But there is a fairy who once told me about it. Perhaps she will share her knowledge. You can find her in a small fairy village in the southwest of Feyrist.
translated: Ma c'è una fata che una volta me ne parlò. Forse condividerà la sua conoscenza. Puoi trovarla in un piccolo villaggio fatato nel sud-ovest di Feyrist.

en: So, you are searching for a way to transform Aurita's fishtail into legs temporarily. As you might already have figured out you need some magic for this purpose. There is a place on Feyrist where you can find the arcane energies you need. ...
translated: Quindi stai cercando un modo per trasformare temporaneamente la coda di pesce di Aurita in gambe. Come potresti già aver capito, hai bisogno di un po' di magia per questo scopo. C'è un posto su Feyrist dove puoi trovare le energie arcane di cui hai bisogno. ...

en: Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
translated: L'alcol rende le persone troppo aggressive. Non abbiamo bisogno di queste cose in Carlin.

en: Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
translated: L'alcol rende le persone troppo aggressive. Non abbiamo bisogno di queste cose in Carlin.

en: Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
translated: L'alcol rende le persone troppo aggressive. Non abbiamo bisogno di queste cose in Carlin.

en: Thank you very much. This will help us to defend Svargrond. But I heard young Nilsor is in dire need of help. Please contact him immediately.
translated: Хвала вам пуно. Ово ће нам помоћи да одбранимо Svargrond. Али чуо сам да младом Нилсору преко треба помоћ. Молимо вас да га одмах контактирате.

en: I'm impressed with your dedication and courage. I can't show you the exact location of cyclopolis on the map though. It is somewhere north of Edron city. ...
translated: Sono impressionato dalla tua dedizione e dal tuo coraggio. Tuttavia non posso mostrarti la posizione esatta di Cyclopolis sulla mappa. È da qualche parte a nord della città Edron. ...

en: It's not only the trolls invading from the west coast. <sighs> Goblins also have a lair there where they constantly prepare for their next attack. ...
translated: Non sono solo i troll che invadono dalla costa occidentale. Anche <sighs> Goblins hanno una tana lì dove si preparano costantemente per il loro prossimo attacco. ...

en: Very well, maybe you know that the orcs here in Edron learnt to raise giant spiders. It is going to become a serious threat. ...
translated: Molto bene, forse sai che gli orchi qui in Edron hanno imparato ad allevare ragni giganti. Diventerà una seria minaccia. ...

en: We've successfully driven the minotaurs off this island, but the underground city of the cyclopes - Cyclopolis - is still standing. ...
translated: Siamo riusciti a scacciare i minotauri da quest'isola, ma la città sotterranea dei ciclopi - Cyclopolis - è ancora in piedi. ...

en: We're always looking for adventurers who'd help us decimate the number of cyclopes. Will you assist the city of Edron by killing 500 of them?
translated: Siamo sempre alla ricerca di avventurieri che ci aiutino a decimare il numero dei ciclopi. Aiuterai la città di Edron uccidendone 500?

en: Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to killing 150 goblins. Would that suit your taste better?
translated: Un'altra opzione se vuoi svolgere un compito per Edron sarebbe uccidere 150 goblin. Sarebbe più adatto ai tuoi gusti?

en: Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to repeat killing 100 trolls. Would that suit your taste better?
translated: Un'altra opzione se vuoi svolgere un'attività per Edron sarebbe ripetere l'uccisione di 100 troll. Sarebbe più adatto ai tuoi gusti?

en: Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to killing 500 cyclops. Would that suit your taste better?
translated: Un'altra opzione se vuoi svolgere un compito per Edron sarebbe uccidere 500 ciclopi. Sarebbe più adatto ai tuoi gusti?

en: Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to killing 300 rotworms. Would that suit your taste better?
translated: Un'altra opzione se vuoi svolgere un compito per Edron sarebbe uccidere 300 vermi marciumi. Sarebbe più adatto ai tuoi gusti?

en: Maybe you have noticed the numerous rotworms that burrowed under Edron. They're quite a pest. You look strong enough to be able to vanquish a few for us. Do you think you can kill 300 rotworms?
translated: Forse hai notato i numerosi vermi marciumi che si nascondevano sotto Edron. Sono piuttosto una seccatura. Sembri abbastanza forte da poterne sconfiggere alcuni per noi. Pensi di poter uccidere 300 vermi marciumi?

en: I am the governor of this isle, Edron, and grandmaster of the Knights of Banor's Blood.
translated: Sono il governatore di quest'isola, Edron, e Gran Maestro dei Cavalieri del Sangue di Banor.

en: There's a beautiful but very dangerous palace in the Tiquandan jungle. The young women who live there are actually demons and they are luring unsuspecting mortals in there. ...
translated: C'è un palazzo bellissimo ma molto pericoloso nella giungla di Tiquandan. Le giovani donne che vivono lì sono in realtà demoni e attirano lì ignari mortali. ...

en: This noble alliance of honourable knights once resided in Edron to serve the king. Legend has it they vanished practically over night. Rumor has it their disappearance is connected to a forbidden book.
translated: Questa nobile alleanza di onorevoli cavalieri un tempo risiedeva a Edron per servire il re. La leggenda narra che siano scomparsi praticamente da un giorno all'altro. Si dice che la loro scomparsa sia collegata a un libro proibito.

en: Sightings of strange fishmen in Tiquanda are stirring up the region. You should be careful when investigating this. ...
translated: Gli avvistamenti di strani uomini-pesce in Tiquanda stanno agitando la regione. Dovresti fare attenzione quando indaghi su questo. ...

en: As far as I know a scholar in Edron already dealt with fish-like creatures before.
translated: Per quanto ne so, uno studioso del Edron si è già occupato in precedenza di creature simili ai pesci.

en: Welcome to the magic store, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a trade if you need something.
translated: Добродошли у магичну продавницу, |PLAYERNAME|! Замоли ме за замену ако ти нешто треба.

en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|. I am a poor man. Please help me.
translated: Здраво |PLAYERNAME|. Ја сам сиромашан човек. Молим вас помозите ми.

en: I have heard that it was recently planned to expand the Museum of Tibian Arts. In the course of these activities unexpected difficulties occurred.
translated: Ho sentito che recentemente è stato progettato l'ampliamento del Museo delle Arti Tibiane. Nel corso di queste attività si sono verificate difficoltà inaspettate.

en: There are rumors of a mysterious statue in the desert next to Darashia. Nobody really knows the meaning of it.
translated: Si vocifera di una statua misteriosa nel deserto accanto a Darashia. Nessuno ne conosce veramente il significato.

en: Talk to Captain Charles in Port Hope. He told me that he once ran ashore on a small island where he discovered a small ruin. The architecture was like nothing he had seen before.
translated: Parla con il Capitano Charles in Port Hope. Mi raccontò che una volta sbarcò su una piccola isola dove scoprì una piccola rovina. L'architettura non assomigliava a nulla che avesse visto prima.

en:
The parts alone do them no good. To assemble the parts, great skill, immense power and forbidden knowledge are necessary. ... \z
	The skill will be supplied by the fallen Yalahari and the power by Variphor itself. ... \z
	The only thing they are still lacking is the knowledge to assemble and operate the {godbreaker}.
translated:
Le parti da sole non servono a niente. Per assemblare le parti sono necessarie grande abilità, immenso potere e conoscenza proibita. ...\z
	L'abilità sarà fornita dal caduto Yalahari e il potere dallo stesso Variphor. ...\z
	L'unica cosa che manca ancora è la conoscenza per assemblare e far funzionare il {godbreaker}.

en: I can mix a secret potion which will increase your facial hair growth enormously. I call it 'Instabeard'. However, it requires certain ingredients. ...
translated: Могу да помешам тајни напитак који ће вам значајно повећати раст длачица на лицу. Ја то зовем 'Instabeard'. Међутим, за то су потребни одређени састојци. ...

en: When I was wandering around in Tibia, I lost my favourite staff somewhere in the northern ruins in Edron. ...
translated: Када сам лутао у Tibia, изгубио сам свој омиљени штап негде у северним рушевинама у Edron. ...

en: Time is not important on Fibula.
translated: Il tempo non è importante su Fibula.

en: You are at Fibula. This isle is not very dangerous. Just the wolves bother outside the village.
translated: Sei a Fibula. Quest'isola non è molto pericolosa. Solo i lupi danno fastidio fuori dal villaggio.

en: Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of monsters. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.
translated: Dio mio. Nel dungeon di Fibula ci sono molti mostri. Ecco perché lo abbiamo sigillato con una porta solida.

en: Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of monsters. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.
translated: Dio mio. Nel dungeon di Fibula ci sono molti mostri. Ecco perché lo abbiamo sigillato con una porta solida.

en: I can mix a secret potion which increases facial hair growth enormously. I call it 'Instabeard'. However, I fear it works only for men. ...
translated: Могу да мешам тајни напитак који значајно повећава раст длачица на лицу. Ја то зовем 'Instabeard'. Међутим, бојим се да ради само за мушкарце. ...

en: The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}. {Seymore} is the teacher there.
translated: Il grande edificio nel centro di Rookgaard. Hanno una biblioteca, un centro di formazione, un {bank} e la stanza del {oracle}. {Seymore} c'è l'insegnante lì.

en: Selling the finest armors on Rookgaard!
translated: Vendi le migliori armature su Rookgaard!

en: Selling the finest armors on Rookgaard!
translated: Vendi le migliori armature su Rookgaard!

en: We'd like to ease our lives somewhat. Therefore, we would appreciate the cooperation with one of the Venore city guards. ...
translated: Vorremmo alleggerirci un po' la vita. Pertanto apprezzeremmo la collaborazione con una delle Venore guardie cittadine. ...

en: Your next job will be kidnapping. You'll get us the only creature that this scrupulous trader Theodore Loveless in Liberty Bay holds dear. ...
translated: Il tuo prossimo lavoro sarà rapire. Ci procurerai l'unica creatura cara allo scrupoloso trader Theodore Loveless di Liberty Bay. ...

en: Your next mission will lead you to Tiquanda. There is a hidden smugglers cave, north of town. ...
translated: La tua prossima missione ti porterà a Tiquanda. C'è una grotta nascosta di contrabbandieri, a nord della città. ...

en: You'll disguise yourself as the dwarven ambassador and sell that fool the old dwarven bridge, south of Kazordoon. ...
translated: Ti travestirai da ambasciatore nanico e venderai a quello stupido il vecchio ponte nanico, a sud di Kazordoon. ...

en: Secondly, you'll need a disguise. Percybald in Carlin is an eccentric actor that might help you with that. ...
translated: In secondo luogo, avrai bisogno di un travestimento. Percybald in Carlin è un attore eccentrico che potrebbe aiutarti in questo. ...

en: As soon as you got both things, travel to Venore and find the merchant Nurik. Trade the false documents for the famous painting of Mina Losa and bring it to me.
translated: Non appena avrai entrambe le cose, viaggia verso Venore e trova il commerciante Nurik. Scambia i documenti falsi con il famoso dipinto di Mina Losa e portamelo.

en: You might need some of them to get that chest open. The soon to be ex-owner of that vase is Sarina, the proprietor of Carlin's general store.
translated: Potrebbero servirtene alcuni per aprire quel baule. La futura ex proprietaria di quel vaso è Sarina, la proprietaria dell'emporio di Carlin.

en: Your first job is quite easy. The Thaian officials are unwilling to share the wealth they've accumulated in their new town Port Hope. ...
translated: Il tuo primo lavoro è abbastanza semplice. I funzionari tailandesi non sono disposti a condividere la ricchezza accumulata nella loro nuova città Port Hope. ...

en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
translated: Benvenuto, |PLAYERNAME|! Ti senti avventuroso? Vuoi un {ticket} settimanale per il sistema dei carri minerari qui? Puoi usarlo proprio qui per raggiungere il centro di Kazordoon!

en: Do you want to purchase a weekly ticket for the ore wagons? With it you can travel freely and swiftly through Kazordoon for one week. 250 gold only. Deal?
translated: Vuoi acquistare un abbonamento settimanale per i carri minerari? Con esso puoi viaggiare liberamente e velocemente attraverso Kazordoon per una settimana. Solo 250 oro. Affare?

en: Greetings |PLAYERNAME|. I have - very - little time, please make it as short as possible. I may be able to help you if you are here to help us with any of our tasks or missions.
translated: Поздрав |PLAYERNAME|. Имам - врло - мало времена, молим вас да буде што краће. Можда ћу моћи да вам помогнем ако сте овде да нам помогнете у било ком од наших задатака или мисија.

en: I heard they dwell somewhere in that new continent - Zao? Well anyway, if you feel you've got enough, just return with what you've got and we will see. Good luck! ...
translated: Чуо сам да живе негде на том новом континенту - Зао? У сваком случају, ако осећате да имате довољно, само се вратите са оним што имате па ћемо видети. Срећно! ...

en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Sento che la scintilla della fenice ti è già stata donata dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
translated: Sento che hai già parlato con l'eremita Eremo sull'isola di Cormaya e hai ricevuto questa benedizione.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione della protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
translated: I druidi a nord di Carlin ti forniranno l'abbraccio di Tibia.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: La scintilla della fenice è data dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Ci sono cinque benedizioni disponibili in cinque luoghi sacri: lo scudo {spiritual}, la scintilla del {phoenix}, il {embrace} di Tibia, il fuoco del {suns} e la saggezza di {solitude}. Inoltre, puoi ricevere il {twist of fate} qui.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Sento che i druidi a nord di Carlin ti hanno fornito l'Abbraccio di Tibia.

en: Orshabaal was out of his maze to make us suffer for many days. In Calmera, a knight with blue beard from his hideout appeared. He fought bravely supported by mages, the demon ran and is gone for ages.
translated: Orshabaal era uscito dal suo labirinto per farci soffrire per molti giorni. A Calmera apparve un cavaliere con la barba blu dal suo nascondiglio. Ha combattuto coraggiosamente supportato dai maghi, il demone è scappato ed è scomparso per secoli.

en: A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping no one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.
translated: Un cavaliere della Guardia aveva bisogno della chiave di Chayenne. Il suo amico lasciò cadere l'oggetto sul pavimento, sperando che nessuno lo vedesse. Ma, nello stesso momento, un uomo incrociò la loro strada e tutti i sogni del cavaliere svanirono.

en: Orshabaal was out of his maze to make us suffer for many days. In Calmera, a knight with blue beard from his hideout appeared. He fought bravely supported by mages, the demon ran and is gone for ages.
translated: Orshabaal era uscito dal suo labirinto per farci soffrire per molti giorni. A Calmera apparve un cavaliere con la barba blu dal suo nascondiglio. Ha combattuto coraggiosamente supportato dai maghi, il demone è scappato ed è scomparso per secoli.

en: A young sorcerer born and raised on Astera when dragons were scary, it was that kind of era. Walking all the way to the city of Venore, he stole from the dwarven bridge nothing less than an iron ore.
translated: Un giovane stregone nato e cresciuto ad Astera quando i draghi erano spaventosi, era quel tipo di epoca. Camminando fino alla città di Venore, rubò dal ponte dei nani nientemeno che un minerale di ferro.

en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
translated: Да? Шта могу учинити за тебе, |PLAYERNAME|? Банкарски послови, можда?

en: A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping no one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.
translated: Un cavaliere della Guardia aveva bisogno della chiave di Chayenne. Il suo amico lasciò cadere l'oggetto sul pavimento, sperando che nessuno lo vedesse. Ma, nello stesso momento, un uomo incrociò la loro strada e tutti i sogni del cavaliere svanirono.

en: Through Rookgaard's sewer there swarmed no fewer than a hundred screeching rats. Wading through mud, and covered in blood, two young men fought back-to-back. To Trimera's end; a knight, and a friend.
translated: Nelle fogne di Rookgaard sciamavano non meno di un centinaio di topi strillanti. Guadando nel fango e coperti di sangue, due giovani combatterono fianco a fianco. Fino alla fine di Trimera; un cavaliere e un amico.

en: During the dark and scary night, when others sleep he goes to fight, banishing demons, that feels right, purging the evil on the sight, fearlessly waiting for daylight, Zeluna's bravest elite knight.
translated: Durante la notte buia e spaventosa, quando gli altri dormono, lui va a combattere, scacciando i demoni, che sembra giusto, eliminando il male alla vista, aspettando senza paura la luce del giorno, il cavaliere d'élite più coraggioso di Zeluna.

en: I'm just an old man, but I know a lot about Tibia.
translated: Sono solo un vecchio, ma so molto di Tibia.

en: I'm just an old man, but I know a lot about Tibia.
translated: Sono solo un vecchio, ma so molto di Tibia.
Benvenuto nel negozio di mobili Edron, |PLAYERNAME|.

en: Recently, one of our members moved to Liberty Bay out of nowhere, talking about some strange cult. That is not the problem, but he took my favourite crossbow with him. ...
translated: Recentemente, uno dei nostri membri si è trasferito a Liberty Bay dal nulla, parlando di uno strano culto. Non è questo il problema, ma ha portato con sé la mia balestra preferita. ...

en: I knew it! He likes taking extended walks outside, leaving all the cleaning to me - especially when he is working on this sculpture, this... 'thing' he tries to create. ...
translated: Знао сам! Воли да шета напољу, а све чишћење препушта мени - посебно када ради на овој скулптури, овом... 'thing' он покушава да ствара. ...

en: What did he do? Since you look like a guy from the city, I bet he went to Edron in secrecy or something like that, didn't he? And you are here because of that?
translated: Шта је урадио? Пошто изгледаш као момак из града, кладим се да је отишао у Edron у тајности или тако нешто, зар не? И ви сте овде због тога?

en: Spelltolust?! That sounds awfully nasty! What was he doing there - are you telling me he lived an alternate life and he didn't even tell {mother}?
translated: Спеллтолуст?! То звучи страшно гадно! Шта је он тамо радио - хоћеш ли ми рећи да је живео алтернативним животом, а није чак ни рекао {mother}?

en: I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
translated: Sono il capo dei Paladini. Aiuto i nostri membri.

en: I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
translated: Sono il capo dei Paladini. Aiuto i nostri membri.

en: King Tibianus is a wise ruler.
translated: Il re Tibiano è un saggio sovrano.

en: I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
translated: Sono il capo dei Paladini. Aiuto i nostri membri.

en: Paladins are great warriors and magicians. Besides that we are excellent missile fighters. Many people in Tibia want to join us.
translated: I paladini sono grandi guerrieri e maghi. Oltre a ciò siamo eccellenti caccia missilistici. Molte persone in Tibia vogliono unirsi a noi.

en: Paladins are the best missile fighters in Tibia!
translated: I paladini sono i migliori combattenti missilistici in Tibia!

en: Funny thing that everyone thinks we have forgers for fake documents here. But no, we don't. The best forger is old Ahmet in Ankrahmun.
translated: Смешно што сви мисле да овде имамо фалсификаторе лажних докумената. Али не, немамо. Најбољи фалсификатор је стари Ахмет у Ankrahmun.

en: Druidic magic is too peaceful for my taste.
translated: La magia druidica è troppo pacifica per i miei gusti.

en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! You're late, do you have no concept of time? My mission is of utmost importance. If you are not interested in helping me, you might as well just leave.
translated: Здраво |PLAYERNAME|! Касниш, немаш појма о времену? Моја мисија је од највеће важности. Ако нисте заинтересовани да ми помогнете, можете једноставно отићи.

en: Ah hello again |PLAYERNAME|! I still have one or two other {missions} for you. There are also some {tasks} someone needs to attend to.
translated: Ах, здраво поново |PLAYERNAME|! Још увек имам један или два друга {missions} за тебе. Има и неких {tasks} којима неко треба да се посвети.

en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! You're late, do you have no concept of time? My mission is of utmost importance. If you are not interested in helping me, you might as well just leave.
translated: Здраво |PLAYERNAME|! Касниш, немаш појма о времену? Моја мисија је од највеће важности. Ако нисте заинтересовани да ми помогнете, можете једноставно отићи.

en: At first, take this gold for the passage by ship and return to the Gray Island from where I started my expedition many years ago. From there you should find a way to reach the Gray Beach of Quirefang as no ordinary ship can land there. ...
translated: Прво узми ово злато за пролаз бродом и врати се на Сиво острво одакле сам пре много година започео своју експедицију. Одатле би требало да нађете начин да стигнете до Gray Beach од Quirefang јер ниједан обичан брод не може да слети тамо. ...

en: Ask around in Ab'Dendriel. Many elves can teach you something about magic. The Cenath love magic most of all.
translated: Chiedi in giro a Ab'Dendriel. Molti elfi possono insegnarti qualcosa sulla magia. I Cenath amano soprattutto la magia.

en: Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
translated: Tutto è una canzone. Vita, morte, storia... tutto. Ascoltare il canto di qualcosa è il primo passo per capirlo.

en: Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
translated: Tutto è una canzone. Vita, morte, storia... tutto. Ascoltare il canto di qualcosa è il primo passo per capirlo.

issues.message: Tłumaczenie to mix EN/lang (>70% EN): '<canti> Re Ha, Omrah, Tan Ra...' (EN: '<chants> Re Ha, Omrah, Tan Ra...')

en: And this is where you come into play. Find the ship plans in the Venorean shipyard or perhaps at the harbour and bring them here immediately.
translated: Ed è qui che entri in gioco tu. Trovate i progetti della nave nel cantiere venereo o magari al porto e portateli subito qui.

en: The scheming Venoreans are a constant thorn in our side. They supply our enemies with all kind of equipment to boost the threat they pose to our freedom. It will be your task to hinder future weapon deliveries significantly ...
translated: Gli intriganti Venoreani sono una costante spina nel nostro fianco. Forniscono ai nostri nemici ogni tipo di equipaggiamento per aumentare la minaccia che rappresentano alla nostra libertà. Sarà tuo compito ostacolare in modo significativo le future consegne di armi...

en: A wandering druid has recently visited the Green Claw Swamp, located north west of that corrupted hell hole Venore. While gathering herbs, he noticed some malignant presence in the said area ...
translated: Un druido errante ha recentemente visitato la Palude dell'Artiglio Verde, situata a nord-ovest di quel buco infernale corrotto Venore. Mentre raccoglieva le erbe, notò qualche presenza maligna in detta zona...

en: After the druid's return to Carlin, divination confirmed his upsetting assumptions about the existence of these trees ...
translated: Dopo il ritorno del druido a Carlin, la divinazione confermò le sue sconvolgenti ipotesi sull'esistenza di questi alberi...

en: But be careful, the {dimensional} shift could mean that they will not even know what you're talking about since they are more closely linked to him than anyone else.
translated: Али будите опрезни, померање {dimensional} може значити да они неће ни знати о чему причате јер су с њим ближе повезани од било кога другог.

en: A rocking horse. He just loved it! Find these items, buy them if you need to and place them where {Jack} lives. Ask him about the furniture and don't forget to tell me about his reaction!
translated: Коњ за љуљање. Једноставно је волео! Пронађите ове предмете, купите их ако је потребно и поставите их тамо где живи {Jack}. Питајте га за намештај и не заборавите да ми кажете о његовој реакцији!

en: But {Jack} is not yet lost to us - if we can get him back to his former self! You have to tell him about his former life, convince him, change his environment. But at first you will need to talk to him and find out who exactly we are dealing with now. ...
translated: Али {Jack} још није изгубљено за нас - ако можемо да га вратимо у оно раније! Морате му испричати о његовом бившем животу, убедити га, променити његову средину. Али прво ћете морати да разговарате са њим и сазнате са ким тачно имамо посла. ...

en: Mh? Ah, yes yes. 'Njey' is the native-language term for a very old race of undersea creatures which ...
translated: Мх? Ах, да да. 'Njey' је израз на матерњем језику за веома стару расу подморских створења која...

en: The good news is that {Jack} is still on our world, and not even inconveniently far away. ...
translated: Добра вест је да је {Jack} још увек у нашем свету, а није ни незгодно далеко. ...

en: He has a laboratory somewhere in Kazordoon, probably somewhere near the technomancer hall. Find him and kill him! Bring me his beard as a proof!
translated: Ha un laboratorio da qualche parte in Kazordoon, probabilmente da qualche parte vicino alla sala del tecnomante. Trovalo e uccidilo! Portami la sua barba come prova!

en: Our relations with Thais can be called strained at best. Therefore, it's not really astounding that the Thaian financed Edron's academy but refuse to share some knowledge with our druids ..
translated: I nostri rapporti con Thais possono essere definiti, nella migliore delle ipotesi, tesi. Pertanto, non è davvero sorprendente che i tailandesi abbiano finanziato l'accademia di Edron ma si rifiutino di condividere parte della conoscenza con i nostri druidi..

en: As you might know, once the old aristocracy of our city shared blood-ties with the noblemen of Thais. There are many unresolved claims for titles and family heirlooms and Thais does little to help in this matter ...
translated: Come forse saprai, un tempo l'antica aristocrazia della nostra città condivideva legami di sangue con i nobili di Thais. Ci sono molte rivendicazioni irrisolte per titoli e cimeli di famiglia e Thais fa poco per aiutare in questa faccenda...

en: Ruins of some ancient cathedral are found south west of Venore. It was a project that the Thaians never finished. However, our scouts reported some suspicious activities there ...
translated: Le rovine di alcune antiche cattedrali si trovano a sud-ovest di Venore. Era un progetto che i thailandesi non portarono mai a termine. Tuttavia, i nostri esploratori hanno segnalato alcune attività sospette lì...

en: Venore has plans for a new kind of ship. It will be faster and more resilient than any other known ship. It will surely improve their dominance over the sea trade. Unless we get those plans for ourselves ...
translated: Venore ha in programma un nuovo tipo di nave. Sarà più veloce e più resistente di qualsiasi altra nave conosciuta. Migliorerà sicuramente il loro dominio sul commercio marittimo. A meno che non otteniamo quei piani per noi stessi...

en: The girls brigade is the foremost front on which we fight the numerous enemies of our city ... It's a constant race to stay ahead of our enemies. Absolute loyalty and the willingness to put ones life at stake are attributes that are vital for this brigade ... If you join, you dedicate your service to Carlin alone! Do you truly think that you are girl enough to join the brigade?
translated: La brigata femminile è il fronte principale su cui combattiamo i numerosi nemici della nostra città... È una corsa costante per stare al passo con i nostri nemici. La lealtà assoluta e la volontà di mettere in gioco la propria vita sono attributi vitali per questa brigata... Se ti unisci, dedichi il tuo servizio solo a Carlin! Pensi davvero di essere abbastanza ragazza per unirti alla brigata?

en: I hope this old book will do those researches any good. Personally I see little use to proof some bloodlines after we cut all ties to Thais.
translated: Spero che questo vecchio libro possa servire a queste ricerche. Personalmente vedo poco utile provare alcune linee di sangue dopo aver tagliato tutti i legami con Thais.

en: The girls brigade is the foremost front on which we fight the numerous enemies of our city ... It's a constant race to stay ahead of our enemies. Absolute loyalty and the willingness to put ones life at stake are attributes that are vital for this brigade ... If you join, you dedicate your service to Carlin alone! Do you truly think that you are girl enough to join the brigade?
translated: La brigata femminile è il fronte principale su cui combattiamo i numerosi nemici della nostra città... È una corsa costante per stare al passo con i nostri nemici. La lealtà assoluta e la volontà di mettere in gioco la propria vita sono attributi vitali per questa brigata... Se ti unisci, dedichi il tuo servizio solo a Carlin! Pensi davvero di essere abbastanza ragazza per unirti alla brigata?

en: Darashia never bothers about the affairs of other cities.
translated: Darashia non si preoccupa mai degli affari delle altre città.

en: It's just another Thaian puppet. Still, it is distant enough to stand a fair chance to get rid of Thais's oppression one day.
translated: È solo un altro burattino tailandese. Tuttavia, è abbastanza distante da avere una buona possibilità di liberarsi un giorno dell'oppressione di Thais.

en: The dwarfs of Kazordoon usually mind their own business. I wish all other cities would do the same.
translated: I nani di Kazordoon di solito si fanno gli affari propri. Vorrei che tutte le altre città facessero lo stesso.

en:
The elves of Ab'Dendriel are our allies. Our druids contribute most to keeping such a good relation. ... \z
	They seem to understand the elves a bit better than we ordinary people do.
translated:
Gli elfi di Ab'Dendriel sono nostri alleati. I nostri druidi contribuiscono maggiormente a mantenere un buon rapporto. ...\z
	Sembra che capiscano gli elfi un po' meglio di noi persone comuni.

en:
The name of the city is a cruel joke. The people there are oppressed by Thais and Venore who slowly bleed the isle and its people white. ... \z
	It shows what would have happened to us if our rebellion had failed.
translated:
Il nome della città è uno scherzo crudele. Le persone lì sono oppresse da Thais e Venore che dissanguano lentamente l'isola e la sua gente. ...\z
	Mostra cosa ci sarebbe successo se la nostra ribellione fosse fallita.

en: I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also known as CGB.
translated: Sono a capo della Brigata femminile di Carlin, conosciuta anche come CGB.

en: I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also known as CGB.
translated: Sono a capo della Brigata femminile di Carlin, conosciuta anche come CGB.

en: Unfortunately in the current state of time, he was never interested in attending Edron Academy, he never looked for a job to finance his studies and of course has never been one of my interns. ...
translated: Нажалост, у тренутном стању времена, никада није био заинтересован за похађање Edron Академије, никада није тражио посао да финансира своје студије и наравно никада није био један од мојих стажиста. ...

en: Since he was in the magic sphere during the launch, the time fold only affected his own {dimensional} anchoring. ...
translated: Пошто је био у магичној сфери током лансирања, временски преклоп је утицао само на његово сопствено {dimensional} сидрење. ...

en: The number of parallel {dimensions} is endless and the fold made him slip into one completely different course of time where he never was the person I once knew. ...
translated: Број паралелних {dimensions} је бесконачан, а преклоп га је натерао да склизне у један потпуно другачији ток времена у којем никада није био особа коју сам некада познавао. ...

en: As all magical calibration was done from my lab I never thought about adding some sort of control to its interior. In other words {Jack} has travelled in time, without any means to come back. ...
