en: Passages to Kazordoon! Gotta try the beer there.
translated: Passaggi a Kazordoon! Devo provare la birra lì.

en: Would you like to travel to Gnomprona for |TRAVELCOST|?
translated: Ti piacerebbe viaggiare a Gnomprona per |TRAVELCOST|?

en: Do you seek a ride to Farmine for |TRAVELCOST|?
translated: Cerchi un passaggio fino a Farmine per |TRAVELCOST|?

en: Do you want to go to Kazordoon to try the beer there? |TRAVELCOST|?
translated: Vuoi andare a Kazordoon per provare la birra lì? |TRAVELCOST|?

en: Passages to Kazordoon! Gotta try the beer there.
translated: Passaggi a Kazordoon! Devo provare la birra lì.

en: However, now that times have changed and the pressure increases, even my kin might slowly start to change in order to {adapt}.
translated: Међутим, сада када су се времена променила и притисак расте, чак би и моји рођаци могли полако да се мењају како би {adapt}.

en: Books are a wonderful {invention}. If you are ever tired of your heroic exploits, take the time to read one.
translated: Књиге су дивне {invention}. Ако сте икада уморни од својих херојских подвига, одвојите време да прочитате један.

en: Times have changed <sigh>. In the past dragons were feared and respected. Only the {demons} rivalled our notoriety.
translated: Времена су се променила <sigh>. У прошлости су се змајеви бојали и поштовали. Само {demons} био је ривал нашој озлоглашености.

en: Your lives are so short and meaningless and yet you are here! And as a race you even have your own history and remember things with the help of {books}, which amazes me.
translated: Ваши животи су тако кратки и бесмислени, а ипак сте овде! А као раса чак имате своју историју и памтите ствари уз помоћ {books}, што ме задивљује.

en: Drink it while wearing the ring in the Temple of Bastesh and say: 'Sa Katesa Tarsani na'. If the legends are true you will be able to take memories with you in the form of memory shards.
translated: Попијте га док носите прстен у храму Бастесх и реците: 'Sa Katesa Tarsani na'. Ако су легенде истините, моћи ћете да понесете успомене са собом у облику крхотина сјећања.

en: Let us hope one day whole Banuta will greet you as a friend. Perhaps you want to check me offers for special friends... or shamanic powers.
translated: Speriamo che un giorno intero Banuta ti saluterà come amico. Forse vuoi controllare le mie offerte per amici speciali... o poteri sciamanici.

en: You have proven yourself a friend, me will grant you permission to enter the deepest catacombs under Banuta which we have sealed in the past. ...
translated: Ti sei dimostrato un amico, ti concederò il permesso di entrare nelle catacombe più profonde sotto Banuta che abbiamo sigillato in passato. ...

en: Last ingredient for charm of life is thing to lure magic. Only thing me know like that is mushroom called witches' cap. Me was told it be found in isle called Fibula, where humans live. ...
translated: L'ultimo ingrediente del fascino della vita è attirare la magia. L'unica cosa che conosco è un fungo chiamato berretto delle streghe. Mi è stato detto che si trova nell'isola chiamata Fibula, dove vivono gli umani. ...

en: Hidden under Fibula is a secret dungeon. There you will find witches' cap. Are you willing to go there for good ape people?
translated: Nascosto sotto Fibula c'è un dungeon segreto. Lì troverai il berretto delle streghe. Sei disposto ad andare lì per le brave persone scimmie?

en: Bring me egg of hydra please. You may find it in lair of Hydra at little lake south east of our lovely city Banuta! You think you can do?
translated: Portami l'uovo dell'idra, per favore. Potresti trovarlo nella tana dell'Idra, presso il laghetto a sud-est della nostra adorabile città Banuta! Pensi di poterlo fare?

en: You brought Hairycles witches' cap from Fibula?
translated: Hai portato il berretto da strega di Hairycles da Fibula?

en: Please destroy three casks in the complex beneath Banuta, so my people will come to senses again.
translated: Per favore, distruggi tre botti nel complesso sottostante Banuta, così la mia gente tornerà in sé.

en: Me know its much me asked for but go into the deepest catacombs under Banuta and destroy the monument of the serpent god.
translated: So che ho chiesto molto, ma vai nelle catacombe più profonde sotto Banuta e distruggi il monumento del dio serpente.

en: Ah, a customer! Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|! I buy all kinds of loot, would you like a {trade}? I can also show you my {shop options}.
translated: Ах, муштерија! Будите поздрављени, |PLAYERNAME|! Купујем све врсте плена, да ли бисте желели {trade}? Могу вам показати и своје {shop options}.

en: Not right mushroom you have. Find me a witches' cap on Fibula!
translated: Non è il fungo giusto che hai. Trovami un berretto da strega su Fibula!

en: Please try to find me a witches' cap on Fibula.
translated: Per favore, prova a trovarmi un berretto da strega su Fibula.

en: We be {kongra}, {sibang} and {merlkin}. Strange hairless ape people live in city called Port Hope.
translated: Siamo {kongra}, {sibang} e {merlkin}. Strane scimmie senza pelo vivono nella città chiamata Port Hope.

en: I am Charkahn the Slayer! The immortal father of the {orcs} and master of this {hive}.
translated: Ја сам Цхаркахн Убица! Бесмртни отац {orcs} и господар овог {hive}.

en: Pah! Don't mock me, mortal! This shape is a curse which the evil {djinn} bestowed upon me!
translated: Пах! Не ругај ми се, смртниче! Овај облик је проклетство које ми је зло {djinn} дало!

en: This cursed djinn king! I set him free from an enchanted {lamp}, and he {cheated} me!
translated: Овај проклети краљ џина! Ослободио сам га од зачараног {lamp}, а он {cheated} мене!

en: Because I freed him he granted me three wishes. He was true to his word in the first two {wishes}.
translated: Пошто сам га ослободио, испунио ми је три жеље. Остао је веран својој речи у прва два {wishes}.

en: Dawnport is not far off from the coast of the Tibian Mainland. Lots of cities, monsters, bandits, brigands, mean folk and people of low understanding with no sense of respect towards alchemical genius. <mutters to himself>
translated: Dawnport non è lontano dalla costa della terraferma tibiana. Molte città, mostri, banditi, briganti, gente meschina e persone di scarsa comprensione senza alcun senso di rispetto verso il genio alchemico. <borbotta tra sé>

en: Ahem. Once you're level 8, you should be experienced enough to choose your definite vocation and leave Dawnport for Main - and Tibia definitely needs more skilled adventurers to keep those monsters in check which roam our lands!
translated: Ehm. Una volta raggiunto il livello 8, dovresti avere abbastanza esperienza per scegliere la tua vocazione definitiva e partire da Dawnport per Main - e Tibia ha sicuramente bisogno di avventurieri più esperti per tenere sotto controllo quei mostri che vagano per le nostre terre!

en: I wished to father more healthy and fertile children as any orc has ever done. But the djinn cheated me and made me a slime! Then he laughed at me and left for his abandoned fortress in the {Deathwish} Mountains.
translated: Пожелео сам да имам више здраве и плодне деце као што је то учинио сваки орк. Али ђин ме је преварио и направио од мене љигавца! Онда ми се насмејао и отишао у своју напуштену тврђаву у планинама {Deathwish}.

en: His ancient fortress on Darama was deserted as the evil Djinn fled this world after his imprisonment. Now the time has come for the evil Djinns to return to their master although this will certainly awaken the {good Djinn} too.
translated: Његова древна тврђава на Дарами била је напуштена јер је зли Џин побегао са овог света након његовог заточеништва. Сада је дошло време да се зли Џини врате свом господару, иако ће то сигурно пробудити и {good Djinn}.

en: I will not share anything more about that topic with you {paleskins}.
translated: Нећу делити ништа више о тој теми са вама {paleskins}.

en: I can sense the presence and the feelings of my underlings and {minions}. I embrace the rage of the horde.
translated: Могу да осетим присуство и осећања својих потчињених и {minions}. Прихватам бес хорде.

en: The Raging One blessed us with his burning hate. We are truly his children and therefore {divine}.
translated: Бесни нас је благословио својом горућом мржњом. Ми смо заиста његова деца и стога {divine}.

en: To conquer, to destroy and to dominate. Orcs are born to rule the {world}.
translated: Освојити, уништити и доминирати. Орци су рођени да владају {world}.

en: One day I will rule the world, even when turned into a {slime}.
translated: Једног дана ћу владати светом, чак и када се претворим у {slime}.

en: So you are saying you're looking for someone to take you to Vengoth?
translated: Quindi stai dicendo che stai cercando qualcuno che ti porti a Vengoth?

en: Want me to bring you to Vengoth again for 100 gold?
translated: Vuoi che ti porti di nuovo a Vengoth per 100 monete d'oro?

en: Do you seek a passage to Yalahar for |TRAVELCOST|?
translated: Cerchi un passaggio a Yalahar per |TRAVELCOST|?

en: Be greeted, dear visitor. Come and {stay} ... a while.
translated: Будите поздрављени, драги посетиоци. Дођи и {stay} ... неко време.

en: If you have passed the first six seals and entered the blue fires that lead to the chamber of the seal you might receive my {kiss} ... It will open the last seal. Do you think you are ready?
translated: Ако сте прошли првих шест печата и ушли у плаве ватре које воде до коморе печата, можда ћете добити мој {kiss} ... Отвориће последњи печат. Да ли мислите да сте спремни?

en: The Queen of the Banshee: I see! You have mastered the seal of logic. You have made the sacrifice, you have seen the unseen, you possess fortitude, you have filled yourself with power and found your path. You may ask me for my {kiss} now.
translated: Краљица Баншија: Схватам! Савладали сте печат логике. Принео си жртву, видео си невидљиво, поседујеш снагу, напунио си се снагом и нашао свој пут. Сада можете да ме питате за моје {kiss}.

en: The druids lately claim that they are serving Crunor's will and not Uman's. Such heresy could only become possible with the independence of Carlin from the Thaian kingdom. ...
translated: I druidi ultimamente affermano di servire la volontà di Crunor e non quella di Uman. Tale eresia potrebbe diventare possibile solo con l'indipendenza di Carlin dal regno tailandese. ...

en: The spiritual centre of the druids switched to Carlin where they have much influence and cannot be supervised by the inquisition.
translated: Il centro spirituale dei druidi è passato a Carlin dove hanno molta influenza e non possono essere supervisionati dall'inquisizione.

en: We've got information about something very dangerous going on on the isle of Edron. The demons are preparing something there ...
translated: Abbiamo informazioni su qualcosa di molto pericoloso che sta accadendo sull'isola di Edron. I demoni stanno preparando qualcosa lì...

en: It'll be your task to take revenge and to kill that demon. You'll find him in the depths of Edron. Good luck.
translated: Sarà tuo compito vendicarti e uccidere quel demone. Lo troverai nelle profondità di Edron. Buona fortuna.

en: Edron illustrates perfectly why the inquisition is needed and why we need more funds and manpower. ...
translated: Edron illustra perfettamente perché è necessaria l'Inquisizione e perché abbiamo bisogno di più fondi e manodopera. ...

en: We've got a report about an abandoned and haunted house in Liberty Bay. I want you to examine this house. It's the only ruin in Liberty Bay so you should have no trouble finding it. ...
translated: Abbiamo una segnalazione su una casa abbandonata e infestata in Liberty Bay. Voglio che esamini questa casa. È l'unica rovina in Liberty Bay quindi non dovresti avere problemi a trovarla. ...

en: You'll find him in his cave at the mountain outside of Kazordoon. He'll tell you about your next mission.
translated: Lo troverai nella sua grotta sulla montagna fuori Kazordoon. Ti parlerà della tua prossima missione.

en: I've arranged a flying carpet that will bring you to their hideout. Travel to Femor Hills and tell the carpet pilot the codeword 'eclipse' ...
translated: Ho preparato un tappeto volante che ti porterà al loro nascondiglio. Viaggia verso Femor Hills e dì al pilota del tappeto la parola in codice 'eclipse' ...

en: Your current mission is to exorcise an evil being from a house in Liberty Bay. Are you done with that mission?
translated: La tua missione attuale è esorcizzare un essere malvagio da una casa in Liberty Bay. Hai finito con quella missione?

en: You cannot get this blessing unless you have completed The Inquisition Quest.
translated: Non puoi ottenere questa benedizione se non hai completato la missione The Inquisition.

en: Drefia used to be a city of sin and heresy, just like Carlin nowadays. One day, the gods decided to destroy this town and to erase all evil there.
translated: Drefia era una città di peccato ed eresia, proprio come Carlin al giorno d'oggi. Un giorno, gli dei decisero di distruggere questa città e di cancellare da lì ogni male.

en: Darashia is a godless town full of mislead fools. One day, it will surely share the fate of its sister town Drefia.
translated: Darashia è una città senza Dio piena di sciocchi fuorviati. Un giorno condividerà sicuramente il destino della sua città sorella Drefia.

en: Carlin is a city of sin and heresy. After the reunion of Carlin with the kingdom, the inquisition will have much work to purify the city and its inhabitants.
translated: Carlin è una città del peccato e dell'eresia. Dopo la riunione del Carlin con il regno, l'inquisizione avrà molto lavoro per purificare la città e i suoi abitanti.

en: The druids here still follow the old rules. Sadly, the druids of Carlin have left the right path in the last years.
translated: I druidi qui seguono ancora le vecchie regole. Purtroppo, negli ultimi anni, i druidi di Carlin hanno abbandonato la strada giusta.

en: The dwarfs are allied with Thais but follow their own obscure religion. Although dwarfs keep mostly to themselves, we have to observe this alliance closely.
translated: I nani sono alleati con Thais ma seguono la loro oscura religione. Anche se i nani si tengono per lo più per conto loro, dobbiamo osservare da vicino questa alleanza.

en: The dwarfs are allied with Thais but follow their own obscure religion. Although dwarfs keep mostly to themselves, we have to observe this alliance closely.
translated: I nani sono alleati con Thais ma seguono la loro oscura religione. Anche se i nani si tengono per lo più per conto loro, dobbiamo osservare da vicino questa alleanza.

en: Venore is somewhat difficult to handle. The merchants have a close eye on our activities in their city and our authority is limited there. However, we will use all of our influence to prevent a second Carlin.
translated: Venore è un po' difficile da gestire. I mercanti tengono d'occhio le nostre attività nella loro città e lì la nostra autorità è limitata. Utilizzeremo però tutta la nostra influenza per evitare che si ripeta un secondo Carlin.

en: It's my curse to be the eternal {guardian} of this ancient {place}.
translated: Моје је проклетство да будем вечни {guardian} овог древног {place}.

en: I'm the {guardian} of the {SEVENTH} and final seal. The seal to open the last door before ... but perhaps it's better to see it with your own eyes.
translated: Ја сам {guardian} од {SEVENTH} и завршни печат. Печат за отварање последњих врата пре ... али можда је боље да то видите својим очима.

en: It served as a temple, a source of power and ... as a sender for an ancient {race} which lived a long time ago and has long been forgotten.
translated: Служио је као храм, извор моћи и ... као пошиљалац за древни {race} који је живео давно и одавно заборављен.

en: The race that built this edifice came to this place from the stars. They ran from an enemy even more horrible than themselves. But they carried the {seed} of their own destruction in them.
translated: Раса која је изградила ово здање дошла је на ово место са звезда. Побегли су од непријатеља још страшнијег од њих самих. Али они су у себи носили {seed} сопственог уништења.

en: This ancient race was annihilated by its own doings, that's all I know. Aeons have passed since then, but the sheer presence of this {complex} is still defiling and desecrating this area.
translated: Ова древна раса је уништена сопственим делима, то је све што знам. Од тада су прошли еони, али само присуство овог {complex} још увек скрнави и скрнави ову област.

en: Aaah, the northern cuisine! A catch of fresh salmon right from the coast Svargrond is the base of this extraordinary fish dish.
translated: Aaah, la cucina del nord! Una pescata di salmone fresco direttamente dalla costa Svargrond è la base di questo straordinario piatto di pesce.

en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage} back, I can help you.
translated: Добродошли, |PLAYERNAME|! Нека вас земља заштити на стеновитим теренима. Ако вам треба {passage} назад, могу вам помоћи.

en:
I can teach you {healing spells}, {attack spells} and {support spells}. \z
		What kind of spell do you wish to learn? \z
		You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
translated:
Могу да те научим {healing spells}, {attack spells} и {support spells}. \з
		Коју врсту чаролије желите да научите? \з
		Такође ми можете рећи за који ниво желите да научите чаролију, ако то више волите.

en: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. May the gods be with you to guard and guide you, my child!
translated: Збогом, |PLAYERNAME|. Нека су богови са тобом да те чувају и воде, дете моје!

en: Welcome in the name of the gods, pilgrim |PLAYERNAME|!
My name is Tibra. Your soul tells me that you are |PLAYERNAME|.
translated: Моје име је Тибра. Твоја душа ми говори да си |PLAYERNAME|.

en: There you find for sure the cause for the unrest of the spirits. Find someone in Svargrond who can give you a passage to Helheim and seek for the cause. Are you willing to do that?
translated: Lì trovi sicuramente la causa dell’inquietudine degli spiriti. Trova qualcuno in Svargrond che possa darti un passaggio per Helheim e cercare la causa. Sei disposto a farlo?

en: The problem is that the chakoyas may use the ice for a passage to the west and attack Svargrond ...
translated: Il problema è che i chakoya potrebbero sfruttare il ghiaccio per un passaggio verso ovest e attaccare Svargrond...

en: The world of Tibia is the creation of the gods.
Sorry, but I am not done with the outfit yet. Venore wasn't built in a day.
translated: Mi dispiace, ma non ho ancora finito con l'outfit. Venore non è stato costruito in un giorno.

en: Bah, Farmine here, Farmine there. Is there nothing else than Farmine to talk about these days? Hrmpf, whatever. So what do you want?
translated: Bah, Farmine qui, Farmine lì. Non c'è altro che Farmine di cui parlare in questi giorni? Hrmpf, qualunque cosa. Allora cosa vuoi?

en: Hah! Now you talk like a dwarf! That's the spirit! Of course you can have some of my worms. I'll send a bunch to Farmine as soon as possible.
translated: Ah! Adesso parli come un nano! Questo è lo spirito! Naturalmente puoi avere alcuni dei miei vermi. Ne invierò un mazzo a Farmine il prima possibile.

en: Uh, how cute! Look how he's snapping for my fingers! You really know how to make an old dwarf happy! Well, so let's try again. Why do you think I should send my precious worms to Farmine?
translated: Uh, che carino! Guarda come mi spezza le dita! Sai davvero come rendere felice un vecchio nano! Bene, allora riproviamo. Perché pensi che dovrei mandare i miei preziosi vermi a Farmine?

en: So receive the embrace of Tibia, pilgrim.
translated: Ricevi quindi l'abbraccio di Tibia, pellegrino.

en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Sento che la scintilla della fenice ti è già stata donata dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
translated: Sento che hai già parlato con l'eremita Eremo sull'isola di Cormaya e hai ricevuto questa benedizione.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione della protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione dei due soli nella torre solare vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: La scintilla della fenice è data dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: So receive the embrace of Tibia, pilgrim.
translated: Ricevi quindi l'abbraccio di Tibia, pellegrino.

en: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Ci sono cinque benedizioni disponibili in cinque luoghi sacri: lo scudo {spiritual}, la scintilla del {phoenix}, il {embrace} di Tibia, il fuoco del {suns} e la saggezza di {solitude}. Inoltre, puoi ricevere il {twist of fate} qui.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la benedizione dei due soli nella torre del sole vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: She is a bit overly concerned about that nature and balance stuff but she has a good heart. She is living in the woods between Carlin and Ab'Dendriel. I'll mark her hut on your map.
translated: È un po' eccessivamente preoccupata per quelle cose sulla natura e sull'equilibrio, ma ha un buon cuore. Vive nel bosco tra Carlin e Ab'Dendriel. Segnerò la sua capanna sulla tua mappa.

en: He has a house in the wilderness. Just between Ab'Dendriel and the orcland. I'll mark his hut on your map.
translated: Ha una casa nel deserto. Proprio tra Ab'Dendriel e l'Orcland. Segnerò la sua capanna sulla tua mappa.

en: I used to be there with my old friend Cipfried to heal adventurers. After all these years, I prefer solitude now.
translated: Ero lì con il mio vecchio amico Cipfried per curare gli avventurieri. Dopo tutti questi anni, adesso preferisco la solitudine.

en: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Не изгледаш тако лоше. Извини, не могу ти помоћи. Али ако тражите додатну заштиту, требало би да одете на {pilgrimage} пепела или набавите заштиту од {twist of fate} овде.

en:
Take this star ring. When you wear it in your ring slot, it will improve the effect of food that you have eaten for a limited time. So as long as you're not hungry, you will have increased hitpoint regeneration. ... \z
	It makes sense to undress it when you have full hitpoints, so that the effect of the ring won't be wasted. ... \z
	There are a lot of different rings in Tibia, but this one only works as long as you haven't learnt a vocation, so don't be afraid to use it. ... \z
	Anyway, thanks so much for your help. I can brew a lot of potions from these herbs. If you're in the area and find yourself in need of potions, don't hesitate to drop by and ask me for a {trade}. ... \z
	Anyway, this old man has taken enough of your time. Why don't you go back to the village and talk to Vascalir? If you stay on the path, you should be safe. Don't forget your potions!
translated:
Prendi questo anello con la stella. Quando lo indossi nello slot dell'anello, migliorerà l'effetto del cibo che hai mangiato per un tempo limitato. Quindi, finché non avrai fame, avrai una maggiore rigenerazione dei punti ferita. ...\z
	Ha senso spogliarlo quando hai tutti i punti ferita, in modo che l'effetto dell'anello non venga sprecato. ...\z
	Ci sono molti anelli diversi in Tibia, ma questo funziona solo finché non hai imparato una vocazione, quindi non aver paura di usarlo. ...\z
	Comunque, grazie mille per il tuo aiuto. Posso preparare molte pozioni con queste erbe. Se ti trovi in ​​zona e hai bisogno di pozioni, non esitare a passare a chiedermi una {trade}. ...\z
	Comunque, questo vecchio ti ha preso già abbastanza tempo. Perché non torni al villaggio e parli con Vascalir? Se rimani sul sentiero, dovresti essere al sicuro. Non dimenticare le tue pozioni!

en: Nature's blessings! You may find the desperate wolf mother in the south of Cormaya. You will know the place because there is a big stone that looks like a grumpy face. ...
translated: Le benedizioni della natura! Potresti trovare la disperata mamma lupo nel sud di Cormaya. Conoscerai il posto perché c'è una grossa pietra che sembra una faccia scontrosa. ...

en: One of my sisters, in the disguise of a nightingale, told me that Alkestios would send you. There is a problem which is not concerning me but a wolf mother on the small island Cormaya. ...
translated: Una delle mie sorelle, travestita da usignolo, mi ha detto che ti avrebbe mandato Alkestios. C'è un problema che non riguarda me ma una mamma lupo sulla piccola isola Cormaya. ...

en: Thus I can't cross the ocean to reach Cormaya. Will you help me?
translated: Quindi non posso attraversare l'oceano per raggiungere Cormaya. Mi aiuterai?

en: If he does, follow him into his own chambers. Barkless are neither allowed to go near the throne room, aside from being judged, nor can we actually enter it.
translated: Ако то уради, прати га у његове одаје. Barkless не смеју ни да се приближе престоној соби, осим да нам се суди, нити можемо да уђемо у њу.

en: You are now one of us. Learn to endure this world's suffering in every facet and take delight in the soothing eternity that waits for the {purest} of us on the other side.
translated: Сада си један од нас. Научите да издржите патњу овог света у свим аспектима и уживајте у умирујућој вечности која чека {purest} нас на другој страни.

en: Purification is but one of the difficult steps on your way to the other side. The {trial} of tar, sulphur and ice.
translated: Прочишћење је само један од тешких корака на вашем путу ка другој страни. {trial} катрана, сумпора и леда.

en: I can bring you either to the {east} end of Port Hope or to the {centre} of the town, where would you like to go?
translated: Posso portarti alla fine del {east} Port Hope o alla fine del {centre} della città, dove vorresti andare?

en: You can form a party by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. The party leader can also enable 'Shared Experience' by right-clicking on him- or herself.
translated: Puoi formare un gruppo facendo clic con il pulsante destro del mouse su un giocatore e selezionando 'Invite to ⟨0⟩'. Il leader del gruppo può anche abilitare 'Shared Experience' facendo clic con il tasto destro su se stesso.

en: You can found a party with your friends by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. If you are invited to a party, right-click on yourself and select 'Join Party'.
translated: Puoi fondare un gruppo con i tuoi amici facendo clic con il pulsante destro del mouse su un giocatore e selezionando 'Invite to ⟨0⟩'. Se sei invitato a una festa, fai clic con il pulsante destro del mouse su te stesso e seleziona 'Join ⟨1⟩'.

en: Fighting is essential in Tibia, and though Dawnport is quite safe in comparison to the mainland, be careful not to die, as {dying} HURTS. ...
translated: Il combattimento è essenziale in Tibia e, sebbene Dawnport sia abbastanza sicuro rispetto alla terraferma, fai attenzione a non morire, poiché {dying} FA MALE. ...

en: Every vocation has specific spells that can only be used if you have that vocation. Sorcerers and druids of course rely heavily on spells, while knights only have a few at their disposal. ...
translated: Ogni vocazione ha incantesimi specifici che possono essere utilizzati solo se hai quella vocazione. Gli stregoni e i druidi ovviamente fanno molto affidamento sugli incantesimi, mentre i cavalieri ne hanno solo pochi a loro disposizione. ...

en: There are four vocations in Tibia: {knight}, {druid}, {paladin} and {sorcerer}. Each one has its unique abilities, strengths and weaknesses. Just try them out to see which one suits you best. ...
translated: Ci sono quattro vocazioni in Tibia: {knight}, {druid}, {paladin} e {sorcerer}. Ognuno ha le sue abilità, punti di forza e di debolezza unici. Provateli per vedere quale si adatta meglio a voi. ...

en: Once you reached level 8 or more, you have to choose one vocation as your definite vocation before you can leave for the Tibian {mainland}, where more dangers await you. ...
translated: Una volta raggiunto il livello 8 o più, devi scegliere una vocazione come vocazione definitiva prima di poter partire per Tibian {mainland}, dove ti aspettano altri pericoli. ...

en: Yes, goodbye |PLAYERNAME|, just leave me alone.
translated: Да, збогом |PLAYERNAME|, само ме остави на миру.

en: I am... a traveler. Just leave me alone if you have nothing {interesting} to talk about.
translated: Ја сам... путник. Само ме остави на миру ако немаш о чему {interesting} да причаш.

en: I am... a traveler. Just leave me alone if you have nothing {interesting} to talk about.
translated: Ја сам... путник. Само ме остави на миру ако немаш о чему {interesting} да причаш.

en: My Name? I am To... ahm... hum... My name is {Hugo}.
translated: Моје име? Ја сам То... ахм... хм... Моје име је {Hugo}.

en: Druids and sorcerers train their magic level by using their mana through {spells} and runes. Their wand or rod damage is not affected by their magic level. If you have any other questions, tell me.
translated: Druidi e stregoni allenano il loro livello magico usando il loro mana attraverso {spells} e le rune. Il danno della bacchetta o della bacchetta non è influenzato dal livello magico. Se hai altre domande, dimmelo.

en: Every vocation has specific {spells} that can only be used if you have that vocation. Sorcerers and druids of course rely heavily on spells, while knights only have a few at their disposal. ...
translated: Ogni vocazione ha uno specifico {spells} che può essere utilizzato solo se hai quella vocazione. Gli stregoni e i druidi ovviamente fanno molto affidamento sugli incantesimi, mentre i cavalieri ne hanno solo pochi a loro disposizione. ...

en: There are four {vocations} in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each one has its unique abilities, strengths and weaknesses. Just try them out to see which one suits you best. ...
translated: Ci sono quattro {vocations} in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} o {druid}. Ognuno ha le sue abilità, punti di forza e di debolezza unici. Provateli per vedere quale si adatta meglio a voi. ...

en: Once you reached level 8 or more, you have to choose one vocation as your definite vocation before you can leave for the Tibian {mainland}, where more dangers await you. ...
translated: Una volta raggiunto il livello 8 o più, devi scegliere una vocazione come vocazione definitiva prima di poter partire per Tibian {mainland}, dove ti aspettano altri pericoli. ...

en: Careful, careful, it's a one-way ticket only! You can never come back here if you leave now, and you will loso all your Dawnport equipment and products! ...
translated: Attento, attento, è solo un biglietto di sola andata! Non potrai mai tornare qui se te ne vai adesso e perderai tutte le tue attrezzature e i tuoi prodotti Dawnport! ...

en: I know the ways and lays of Dawnport. Talk to me if you want to know more!
translated: Conosco i modi e gli schemi di Dawnport. Parla con me se vuoi saperne di più!

en: Uh .. I... I met a Todd on the road. He told me he was traveling to Venore, look there for your Todd.
translated: Ух.. ја... срео сам Тодда на путу. Рекао ми је да путује у Venore, потражи тамо свог Тода.

en: Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|. You look... exhausted. Did you run a lot? And more importantly, were you able to find some war wolf leather?
translated: Здраво, |PLAYERNAME|. Изгледаш... исцрпљено. Да ли сте много трчали? И што је још важније, да ли сте успели да пронађете кожу ратног вука?

en:
Used to be a professor at the magic academy in Edron, I believe. \z
		Likes to see different places, so he joined our illustrous little group. \z
		Sells {sorcerer} and {druid} {spells} to our trainees.
translated:
Credo che fossi professore all'accademia di magia nel Edron. \z
		Gli piace vedere posti diversi, quindi si è unito al nostro illustre piccolo gruppo. \z
		Vende {sorcerer} e {druid} {spells} ai nostri tirocinanti.

en: I know the ways and lays of Dawnport. Talk to me if you want to know more!
translated: Conosco i modi e gli schemi di Dawnport. Parla con me se vuoi saperne di più!

en: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Ci sono cinque benedizioni disponibili in cinque luoghi sacri: lo scudo {spiritual}, la scintilla del {phoenix}, il {embrace} di Tibia, il fuoco del {suns} e la saggezza di {solitude}. Inoltre, puoi ricevere il {twist of fate} qui.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Sento che i druidi a nord di Carlin ti hanno fornito l'Abbraccio di Tibia.

en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la benedizione dei due soli nella torre del sole vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Sento che la scintilla della fenice ti è già stata donata dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
translated: Sento che hai già parlato con l'eremita Eremo sull'isola di Cormaya e hai ricevuto questa benedizione.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione della protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
translated: I druidi a nord di Carlin ti forniranno l'abbraccio di Tibia.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione dei due soli nella torre solare vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: La scintilla della fenice è data dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: So receive my prayer: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
translated: Accogli quindi la mia preghiera: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Ora porta il tuo paletto a Tibra nella chiesa Carlin per la riga successiva della preghiera. La informerò cosa fare.

en: {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle} sell my leather clothes in their shops.
translated: {Dixi} и {Lee'Delle} продају моју кожну одећу у својим радњама.

en: Help? I will give you a few gold coins if you have some fresh dead {animals} for me. Note the word {fresh}.
translated: Помоћ? Даћу ти неколико златника ако имаш свеже мртве {animals} за мене. Обратите пажњу на реч {fresh}.

en: Dungeons can be dangerous without proper {equipment}.
translated: Тамнице могу бити опасне без одговарајућег {equipment}.

en: You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church now.
translated: Dovresti visitare Tibra nella chiesa Carlin adesso.

en: Nope, sorry, don't sell that. Go see {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
translated: Не, извини, немој то продати. Идите да видите {Al Dee} или {Lee'Delle}.

en: Nope, sorry, don't sell that. Ask {Obi} or {Lee'Delle}.
translated: Не, извини, немој то продати. Питајте {Obi} или {Lee'Delle}.

en: I'm buying fresh {corpses} of rats, rabbits and wolves. I don't buy half-decayed ones. If you have any for sale, {trade} with me.
translated: Купујем свеже {corpses} пацова, зечева и вукова. Не купујем полураспаднуте. Ако имате на продају, {trade} са мном.

en: He's a better cook than his cousin {Willie}, actually.
translated: Он је, заправо, бољи кувар од свог рођака {Willie}.

en: So receive my prayer: 'Unclean spirits shall be repelled'. Now, bring your stake to Amanda in Edron for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
translated: Accogli quindi la mia preghiera: 'Unclean spirits shall be repelled'. Ora porta la tua puntata ad Amanda in Edron per la riga successiva della preghiera. La informerò cosa fare.

en:
I can help you get boots, but I can't give them to you for free. Besides, you'd want good boots, not that stuff made from rat leather. The best leather you'd find on Rook is wolf leather. ... \z
	War wolf leather, to be precise. Problem is - war wolves are rare, and you can't hope to fight and defeat them. So your only chance is to find an already dead war wolf, take his skin, and escape really fast. ... \z
	What an interesting coincidence that I've seen a poacher sneak into the wolf den just a few hours ago. I'm not exactly a fan of poachers - they kill too many of our wolves. ... \z
	Sooo... what I'm suggesting is: follow his traces into the wolf den, and if you get lucky, you'll be able to take one of his illegally obtained war wolf skins. ... \z
	That's why I wouldn't call it 'stealing', what an ugly word... anyway, if you bring the skin back to me, I'll make some great war wolf boots from them. What do you say?
translated:
Могу вам помоћи да набавите чизме, али не могу вам их дати бесплатно. Осим тога, желели бисте добре чизме, а не ствари од пацовске коже. Најбоља кожа коју ћете наћи на Рооку је вучја кожа. ... \з
	Кожа ратног вука, тачније. Проблем је - ратни вукови су ретки, и не можете се надати да ћете се борити и победити их. Дакле, ваша једина шанса је да пронађете већ мртвог ратног вука, узмете његову кожу и побегнете веома брзо. ... \з
	Каква занимљива коинциденција да сам видео ловокрадице како се ушуњао у вучју јазбину пре само неколико сати. Нисам баш љубитељ ловокрадица – они убијају превише наших вукова. ... \з
	Вау... оно што предлажем је: пратите његове трагове до вучје јазбине, и ако вам се посрећи, моћи ћете да узмете једну од његових илегално стечених кожа ратног вука. ... \з
	Зато га не бих назвао 'stealing', каква ружна реч... уосталом, ако ми вратиш кожу, направићу од њих сјајне чизме од ратног вука. шта кажеш?

en: Well, then walk Rookgaard barefoot. It's up to you!
translated: Па, онда ходај Rookgaard бос. На вама је!

en: You should visit Amanda in Edron now, kid.
translated: Dovresti andare a trovare Amanda tra Edron adesso, ragazzo.

en: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Ci sono cinque benedizioni disponibili in cinque luoghi sacri: lo scudo {spiritual}, la scintilla del {phoenix}, il {embrace} di Tibia, il fuoco del {suns} e la saggezza di {solitude}. Inoltre, puoi ricevere il {twist of fate} qui.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

translated: Sento che i druidi a nord di Carlin ti hanno fornito l'Abbraccio di Tibia.

translated: Sento che hai già parlato con l'eremita Eremo sull'isola di Cormaya e hai ricevuto questa benedizione.

translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione della protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

translated: I druidi a nord di Carlin ti forniranno l'abbraccio di Tibia.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione dei due soli nella torre solare vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: La scintilla della fenice è data dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: I was told you have been killing huskies here in Svargrond! Never do that again, okay? They are precious animals for us. Give me 500 gold and I will forget that incident without telling it to Jarl Sven. Okay?
translated: Mi è stato detto che hai ucciso degli husky qui nel Svargrond! Non farlo mai più, ok? Per noi sono animali preziosi. Datemi 500 monete d'oro e dimenticherò quell'incidente senza dirlo allo Jarl Sven. Va bene?

en: HAIL to the Warlord of the arena! |PLAYERNAME|, Hero of Svargrond! What can I {do for you}?
translated: SALUTE al Signore della Guerra dell'arena! |PLAYERNAME|, Eroe di Svargrond! Cosa posso {do for you}?

en: Are you sure? I think I see some war wolf leather on you. You should reply with {yes}.
translated: Јесте ли сигурни? Мислим да видим кожу ратног вука на теби. Требало би да одговорите са {yes}.

en: I'm the local {tanner}. I buy fresh animal {corpses}, tan them, and convert them into fine leather clothes which I then sell to {merchants}.
translated: Ја сам локални {tanner}. Купујем свеже животиње {corpses}, штавим их и претварам у одећу од фине коже коју затим продајем {merchants}.

en: Sorry but I only give missions to those who are considered a true Barbarian.
translated: Mi dispiace ma do missioni solo a chi è considerato un vero Barbarian.

en: Papa- my father has recently started an adventure on his own. His name is Silus; he is a member of the Edron academy. ...
translated: Papà, mio ​​padre ha recentemente iniziato un'avventura per conto suo. Il suo nome è Silo; è membro dell'accademia Edron. ...

en: Ever since he joined what he called a 'special research division', he went on and on about Zao and how venturing there would help him get ahead. ...
translated: Da quando si è unito a quello che lui chiamava 'special research division', ha continuato a parlare di Zao e di come avventurarsi lì lo avrebbe aiutato ad andare avanti. ...

en: They called this process imbuing and perfected it throughout time. Remains of these shrines are scattered all over Tibia. ...
translated: Hanno chiamato questo processo imbuting e lo hanno perfezionato nel tempo. Resti di questi santuari sono sparsi ovunque Tibia. ...

en: The cave is said to lead to a temple complex underground which is ued as a gathering place for a race called 'draken'. He left right away and tried to enter Zao on his own. ...
translated: Si dice che la grotta conduca a un complesso di templi sotterranei che viene utilizzato come luogo di ritrovo per una razza chiamata 'draken'. Se n'è andato subito e ha cercato di entrare a Zao da solo. ...

en: I was even more worried when he explained the route he chose. he wanted to head straight through a giant steppe and through a massive mountainous ridge to reach the grassy plains of lower Zao. ...
translated: Ero ancora più preoccupato quando mi ha spiegato il percorso che aveva scelto. voleva andare dritto attraverso una steppa gigante e attraverso un massiccio crinale montuoso per raggiungere le pianure erbose del basso Zao. ...

en: If you're interested: I know that the Shapers where active in all corners of Tibia. If you happen to find Shaper ruins there, you may even be able to gather some of their lost knowledge. ...
translated: Se sei interessato: so che gli Shapers erano attivi in ​​tutti gli angoli di Tibia. Se ti capita di trovare lì le rovine dei Plasmatori, potresti anche riuscire a raccogliere parte della loro conoscenza perduta. ...

en: I can not do much to help you but I can open a portal to get you quite close to his last known location in Zao. What do you say, will you help me find my father?
translated: Non posso fare molto per aiutarti, ma posso aprire un portale per portarti abbastanza vicino alla sua ultima posizione conosciuta a Zao. Che ne dici, mi aiuterai a trovare mio padre?

en: Give me a minute or two to retrieve it. Ask me for the {scroll} or the {mission}
translated: Дај ми минут-два да га вратим. Питајте ме за {scroll} или {mission}

en: Hiho Storm Killer! Welcome to Kazordoon furniture store.
translated: Ciao Storm Killer! Benvenuti nel negozio di mobili Kazordoon.

en: D...Daraman's blessings... oh, how I m...miss my warm Darashia...
translated: D...le benedizioni di Daraman... oh, quanto mi...mi manca il mio caldo Darashia...

en: For all its m...mistakes, Thais is warm at least.
translated: Nonostante tutti i suoi m...errori, Thais almeno è caldo.

en: Even D...Drefia can't be worse than this land.
translated: Perfino D...Drefia non può essere peggio di questa terra.

en: You!! What have you told my family? They are mad at me and I don't even know why! They think I lied to them about working in Edron in secrecy! Why should I even do that!
translated: Voi!! Cos'hai detto alla mia famiglia? Sono arrabbiati con me e non so nemmeno perché! Pensano che io abbia mentito dicendo che lavoravo in Edron in segreto! Perché dovrei farlo!

en: Alright, alright you win. I am done for. You... you must be right, yes. Yes, I was working as an intern... in the academy in Edron... yes... Just... tell this Spectulus guy I want to see him. I have nothing left. I am ready.
translated: Va bene, va bene, hai vinto. Sono finito. Tu... devi avere ragione, sì. Sì, lavoravo come stagista... all'accademia nel Edron... sì... Solo... dì a questo Spectulus che voglio vederlo. Non mi è rimasto niente. Sono pronto.

en: And he does what? Hm. Here in Edron? I see. And I was - what? No way. Where? What! Why? And you say you are telling the truth?
translated: E cosa fa? Uhm. Qui a Edron? Vedo. E io ero... cosa? Non c'è modo. Dove? Che cosa! Perché? E dici che stai dicendo la verità?

en: I don't feel safe here ... I hope we can return to Ankrahmun soon.
translated: Не осећам се безбедно овде... Надам се да ћемо се ускоро моћи вратити у Ankrahmun.

en: I don't feel safe here ... I hope we can return to Ankrahmun soon.
translated: Не осећам се безбедно овде... Надам се да ћемо се ускоро моћи вратити у Ankrahmun.

en: Hello, dear |PLAYERNAME|. How can I help you? \z If you need magical equipment such as {runes} or {wands}, just ask me for a {trade}.
translated: Здраво, драги |PLAYERNAME|. Како могу да вам помогнем? \з Ако вам треба магијска опрема као што је {runes} или {wands}, само ме замолите за {trade}.

en: Passages to Edron, Thais, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Yalahar and Port Hope.
translated: Passaggi a Edron, Thais, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Yalahar e Port Hope.

en: My name is Jack Fate from the Royal Tibia Line.
translated: Mi chiamo Jack Fate della linea Royal Tibia.

en: Do you seek a passage to Thais for |TRAVELCOST|?
translated: Cerchi un passaggio a Thais per |TRAVELCOST|?

en: I have to warn you - we might get into a tropical storm on that route. I'm not sure if my ship will withstand it. Do you really want to travel to Thais?
translated: Devo avvisarti: su quella rotta potremmo imbatterci in una tempesta tropicale. Non sono sicuro che la mia nave resisterà. Vuoi davvero viaggiare verso Thais?

issues.message: Tłumaczenie to mix EN/lang (>70% EN): 'Passaggi a Edron, Thais, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahm' (EN: 'Passages to Edron, Thais, Venore, Darashia, Ankrah')

en: Passages to Edron, Thais, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Yalahar and Port Hope.
translated: Passaggi a Edron, Thais, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Yalahar e Port Hope.

en: I'd love to bring you back to Liberty Bay, but as you can see, my ship is ruined. I also hurt my leg and can barely move. Can you help me?
translated: Mi piacerebbe riportarti a Liberty Bay, ma come puoi vedere, la mia nave è rovinata. Mi sono anche fatto male alla gamba e riesco a malapena a muovermi. Mi potete aiutare?

en: Do you want to travel back to Liberty Bay?
translated: Vuoi tornare indietro nel tempo a Liberty Bay?

en: My name is Jack Fate from the Royal Tibia Line.
translated: Mi chiamo Jack Fate della linea Royal Tibia.

en: Greetings! This isn't the {time} to chitchat though.
translated: Поздрав! Ово ипак није {time} за ћаскање.

en: This expedition is here on an important {mission} for the inquisition
translated: Ова експедиција је овде на важном {mission} за инквизицију

en: Are you willing, to bring the fury of the inquisition to that foul place and eradicate all evil you find? Speak, {yes} or {no}?
translated: Да ли сте вољни да доведете бес инквизиције на то зло место и искорените све зло које нађете? Говори, {yes} или {no}?

en: Hear me! Hear me! The mage Wyrdin in the Edron academy is looking for brave adventurers to undertake a task!
translated: Чуј ме! Чуј ме! Чаробњак Вирдин у академији Edron тражи храбре авантуристе да преузму задатак!

en: Hear me! Hear me! The postmaster's guild has open spots for aspiring postmen! Contact Kevin Postner at the post office in the plains south of Kazordoon!
translated: Чуј ме! Чуј ме! Цех управника поште има отворена места за амбициозне поштаре! Контактирајте Кевина Постнера у пошти у равницама јужно од Kazordoon!

en: In Ankrahmun's desert, a storm has revealed the entry to a nightmare that can't be sealed. Horrible creatures there spell instant death to all young adventurers who dare take a breath!
translated: У пустињи Ankrahmun, олуја је открила улаз у ноћну мору која се не може запечатити. Ужасна створења тамо доводе тренутну смрт свим младим авантуристима који се усуде да удахну!

en:
We have located twelve graves that have to be secured: In the old northern Edron graveyard, in the dark cathedral of the plains of havoc, in the ghostlands, on Cormaya, Somewhere in the Femor Hills, on Vengoth, ... \z
	in the graveyard of Darashia, in the old temple north of Thais, at the entrance to the orcland, one is on the southern ice islands, in a mountain on Kilmaresh, one on an island north-east of Ankrahmun.
translated:
Abbiamo individuato dodici tombe che devono essere messe in sicurezza: nel vecchio cimitero settentrionale del Edron, nell'oscura cattedrale delle pianure del caos, nelle terre fantasma, il Cormaya, Da qualche parte nel Femor Hills, il Vengoth, ... \z
	nel cimitero di Darashia, nel vecchio tempio a nord di Thais, all'ingresso dell'orco, uno è sulle isole ghiacciate meridionali, in una montagna su Kilmaresh, uno su un'isola a nord-est di Ankrahmun.

en:
Well, in Rathleton there was an individual at work, looking for some ancient artefact of power. ... \z
	To cover its escape the creature left another creature, known as the ravager to cover his tracks. But there is {more}.
translated:
Ebbene, nel Rathleton c'era un individuo al lavoro, alla ricerca di qualche antico manufatto di potere. ...\z
	Per coprire la sua fuga, la creatura lasciò un'altra creatura, conosciuta come il devastatore, per coprire le sue tracce. Ma c'è {more}.

en:
There is a scheming going on behind the scenes. Powerful good people were corrupted. Evil-doers got backup and resources from a hidden ally. ... \z
	Powerful malignant creatures, gathering their kind under their banner and so much more. These things are not happening by chance. There is a pattern, a guiding {hand}.
translated:
C'è un complotto in corso dietro le quinte. Persone potenti e buone erano corrotte. I malfattori hanno ottenuto sostegno e risorse da un alleato nascosto. ...\z
	Potenti creature maligne, che riuniscono la loro specie sotto il loro stendardo e molto altro ancora. Queste cose non accadono per caso. C'è uno schema, una guida {hand}.

en: Near Darashia's coast, a storm has revealed the entry to a nightmare that can't be sealed. Horrible creatures there spell instant death to all young adventurers who dare take a breath!
translated: Близу обале Darashia, олуја је открила улаз у ноћну мору која се не може запечатити. Ужасна створења тамо доводе тренутну смрт свим младим авантуристима који се усуде да удахну!

en: Near Drefia's mountains, a storm has revealed the entry to a nightmare that can't be sealed. Horrible creatures there spell instant death to all young adventurers who dare take a breath!
translated: Близу планина Drefia, олуја је открила улаз у ноћну мору која се не може запечатити. Ужасна створења тамо доводе тренутну смрт свим младим авантуристима који се усуде да удахну!

en: Hear ye! Hear ye! What a lucky and beautiful day! Visit Carlin, Ankrahmun, or Liberty Bay. Yasir, the oriental trader might be there. Gather your creature products, for this chance is rare.
translated: Чуј! Чуј! Какав срећан и леп дан! Посетите Carlin, Ankrahmun или Liberty Bay. Иасир, оријентални трговац би могао бити тамо. Сакупите своје производе створења, јер је ова шанса ретка.

en: You cannot get this special red claw from any common dragon in Tibia. It requires a special one, a lord among the lords.
translated: Не можете добити ову посебну црвену канџу ни од једног обичног змаја у Tibia. За то је потребан посебан, господар међу господарима.

en: I'm very thankful. Please go to the Druid of Crunor and tell him what you've seen. He might be interested in that.
translated: Sono molto grato. Per favore, vai allo Druid di Crunor e raccontagli cosa hai visto. Potrebbe essere interessato a questo.

en: I see you brought real Zaoan rice balls! That saves us a lot of time as we don't have to cook the rice anymore. Now we just flatten them out nice and medium thick on this baking tray. <squeezes and smoothes the rice piles with his fingers> ...
translated: Vedo che hai portato delle vere polpette di riso Zaoan! Ciò ci fa risparmiare molto tempo poiché non dobbiamo più cuocere il riso. Ora li appiattiamo bene e di medio spessore su questa teglia. <squeezes and smoothes the rice piles with his fingers> ...

issues.message: Tłumaczenie to mix EN/lang (>70% EN): '... dum di dum ... <aspetta> ...' (EN: '... dum di dum ... <waits> ...')

en: So, now for our final dish - a grand dessert from the amazon girls at Carlin! <grates carrots during his explanations> ...
translated: Quindi, ora arriviamo al nostro piatto finale: un grande dessert dalle ragazze amazzoniche a Carlin! <grattugia le carote durante le sue spiegazioni> ...

en: And voilà, we're done! The girls of Carlin swear that it sharpens their eyesight, at least for a while. I'm sure it will somehow aid you in your battles. Enjoy! ...
translated: E voilà, abbiamo finito! Le ragazze di Carlin giurano che acuisce la loro vista, almeno per un po'. Sono sicuro che in qualche modo ti aiuterà nelle tue battaglie. Godere! ...

en: Nicely decorate it on a plate, and voilà, we're done already! Can't tell you much about the effects, but fishermen in Svargrond seem to love it. Enjoy!
translated: Decoralo bene su un piatto e voilà, abbiamo già finito! Non posso dirti molto sugli effetti, ma i pescatori in Svargrond sembrano adorarlo. Godere!

en: Nicely decorate it on a plate, and voilà, we're done already! Can't tell you much about the effects, but fishermen in Svargrond seem to love it. Enjoy!
translated: Decoralo bene su un piatto e voilà, abbiamo già finito! Non posso dirti molto sugli effetti, ma i pescatori in Svargrond sembrano adorarlo. Godere!

en: The people of Darashia say that it has magical abilities and will help you if you feel totally drained. Enjoy!
translated: Le persone di Darashia dicono che abbia abilità magiche e ti aiuterà se ti senti completamente svuotato. Godere!

en: This famous dish from Ankrahmun is quite hot and spicy, so only eat one at a time. It's also possible that you get the urge to run really fast afterwards. Enjoy!
translated: Questo famoso piatto di Ankrahmun è piuttosto piccante e piccante, quindi mangiane solo uno alla volta. È anche possibile che tu abbia voglia di correre molto veloce dopo. Godere!

en: So let's start! <rubs hands together and chops the vegetables> This is a dish especially famous in the area around Ab'Dendriel! Chop the onions into little cubes and sweat them in a pan until they are glassy. ...
translated: Quindi cominciamo! <si strofina le mani e taglia le verdure> Questo è un piatto particolarmente famoso nella zona intorno a Ab'Dendriel! Tagliare le cipolle a cubetti e farle appassire in padella fino a renderle vitree. ...

en: I can teach you {healing spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
translated: Могу да те научим {healing spells} и {support spells}. Коју врсту чаролије желите да научите? Такође ми можете рећи за који ниво желите да научите чаролију, ако то више волите.

en: I can teach you {healing spells}, {attack spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
translated: Могу да те научим {healing spells}, {attack spells} и {support spells}. Коју врсту чаролије желите да научите? Такође ми можете рећи за који ниво желите да научите чаролију, ако то више волите.

en: Hello, dear |PLAYERNAME|. Can I be of any assistance? Just tell me if you'd like to {trade} weapons or armor.
translated: Здраво, драги |PLAYERNAME|. Могу ли бити од било какве помоћи? Само ми реци да ли желиш {trade} оружје или оклоп.

en: This is a recipe right from the jungles of Tiquanda! <grinds and chops during his talk> Grind the stone herb and mix it with the coconut milk, then bathe the chicken in it for a while. ...
translated: Questa è una ricetta direttamente dalla giungla di Tiquanda! <macina e trita durante il suo discorso> Macina l'erba di pietra e mescolala con il latte di cocco, quindi immergi il pollo per un po'. ...

en: Voilà, we're done! This recipe is from the area around Thais and should help you protect yourself in your battles. Enjoy!
translated: Voilà, abbiamo finito! Questa ricetta proviene dall'area intorno a Thais e dovrebbe aiutarti a proteggerti nelle tue battaglie. Godere!

en: Pour it over the salad, and voilà, we're done! This is a Venorean recipe and very tasty. I recommend eating it when you're suffering from some kind of dangerous condition. Enjoy!
translated: Versatelo sull'insalata e voilà, il gioco è fatto! Questa è una ricetta venereana e molto gustosa. Ti consiglio di mangiarlo quando soffri di qualche tipo di condizione pericolosa. Godere!

en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
translated: Добродошли, млади |PLAYERNAME|! Ако сте тешко рањени или отровани, могу вам {heal} бесплатно.

en: After this wonderful and tasty starter we're all set for a special dish I learnt from a brave adventurer who almost starved when he got lost in the mountains between Ankrahmun and Port Hope, or so he told me. ...
translated: Dopo questo meraviglioso e gustoso antipasto siamo pronti per un piatto speciale che ho imparato da un coraggioso avventuriero che quasi morì di fame quando si perse tra le montagne tra Ankrahmun e Port Hope, o almeno così mi ha detto. ...

en: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Не изгледаш тако лоше. Извини, не могу ти помоћи. Али ако тражите додатну заштиту, требало би да одете на {pilgrimage} пепела или набавите заштиту од {twist of fate} овде.

en: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
translated: Кад год задобијете смртоносну рану, ваша витална снага је оштећена и постоји шанса да изгубите део опреме. Са сваким од пет {blessings} које имате, ова штета и шанса за губитак ће се смањити.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Видим да сте примили духовни штит у храму белог цвета јужно од Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Могу да осетим да су вам друиди северно од Carlin пружили Загрљај Tibia.

en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Видим да сте добили благослов два сунца у сунчаном торњу близу Ab'Dendriel.

en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Могу да осетим да су вам искру феникса већ дали патуљасти свештеници земље и ватре у Kazordoon.

en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
translated: Осећам да сте већ разговарали са пустињаком Еремом на острву Cormaya и добили овај благослов.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Можете затражити благослов духовног штита у храму белог цвета јужно од Thais.

en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
translated: Друиди северно од Carlin ће вам пружити загрљај Tibia.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Можете тражити благослов два сунца у сунчаном торњу близу Ab'Dendriel.

en: Well, I'm not a simple cook. I travel the whole Tibian continent for the most artfully seasoned {recipes} and constantly develop new ones.
translated: Beh, non sono un semplice cuoco. Viaggio per tutto il continente tibiano alla ricerca degli {recipes} più stagionati ad arte e ne sviluppo costantemente di nuovi.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Искру феникса дају патуљасти свештеници земље и ватре у Kazordoon.

en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
translated:
Ово је посебан благослов који вам могу дати када добијете барем један од других благослова и који функционише мало другачије. ... \з
	Ради само када вас убију други авантуристи, што значи да су најмање половину штете која је довела до ваше смрти проузроковали други, а не чудовишта или околина. ... \з
	{twist of fate} неће смањити смртну казну као други благослови, већ ће вас уместо тога спречити да изгубите своје друге благослове као и амајлију губитка, ако је носите. Кошта исто као и остали благослови. ... \з
	Да ли би желео да добијеш ту заштиту за жртву од |PVPBLESSCOST| злата, дете?

en: And he is sending a worm like you to us!?! The mighty Efreet!! Tell him that we won't be part in his 'great' plans and now LEAVE!! ...
translated: А он нам шаље црва као што си ти!?! Моћни Ефрит!! Реци му да нећемо бити део његових 'great' планова и сада ОДЛАЗИ!! ...

en: |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
translated: |PLAYERNAME|, то је скоро звучало као реч поздрава. Људи - слатки су!

en: |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
translated: |PLAYERNAME|, то је скоро звучало као реч поздрава. Људи - слатки су!

en: Only the mighty Efreet, the true djinn of Tibia, may enter Mal'ouquah! ...
translated: Само моћни Ефрит, прави џин од Tibia, може ући у Мал'оукуах! ...

en: I'm new here in Edron. I wanted to open up a pet shop. But now I'm ruined, uahahahaha <sniffs>.
translated: Sono nuovo qui in Edron. Volevo aprire un negozio di animali. Ma adesso sono rovinato, uahahahaha <sniffs>.

en: Yesterday I would have said that I like all creatures of Tibia but TODAY my life has changed! When I catch this stinking troll!!
translated: Ieri avrei detto che mi piacciono tutte le creature di Tibia ma OGGI la mia vita è cambiata! Quando prendo questo troll puzzolente!!

en: Only the mighty Efreet, the true djinn of Tibia, may enter Mal'ouquah! ...
translated: Само моћни Ефрит, прави џин од Tibia, може ући у Мал'оукуах! ...

en: Shove off, little one! Humans are not welcome here, |PLAYERNAME|!
translated: Одгурни се, мали! Људи овде нису добродошли, |PLAYERNAME|!

en: What? You know the word, |PLAYERNAME|? All right then - I won't kill you. At least, not now.  What brings you {here}?
translated: Ста? Знате реч, |PLAYERNAME|? У реду онда - нећу те убити. Бар не сада.  Шта вам доноси {here}?

en: I never make profit in Thais and most of the time I get robbed. I stopped visiting Thais for business some years ago.
translated: Non guadagno mai in Thais e la maggior parte delle volte vengo derubato. Ho smesso di visitare Thais per affari alcuni anni fa.

en: I made contact with Svargrond! A guy named Buddel wanted to sell me a three-headed dog. I haven't seen it yet, but imagine how much money I could make by breeding such a pet!!
translated: Ho contattato Svargrond! Un ragazzo di nome Buddel voleva vendermi un cane a tre teste. Non l'ho ancora visto, ma immagina quanti soldi potrei guadagnare allevando un animale del genere!!

en: A hand puppet, a music box, an encyclopedia, a Durin doll, a medusa skull, a newspaper, a bag of spices or an Exhiti imortus. ...
translated: Una marionetta, un carillon, un'enciclopedia, una bambola Durin, un teschio di medusa, un giornale, un sacchetto di spezie o un Exhiti imortus. ...

en: I want you to try and convince someone with a boat to bring you to this island, Vengoth. I'll give you an empty map. Please map the area for me and pay special attention to unusual spots. ...
translated: Voglio che provi a convincere qualcuno con una barca a portarti su quest'isola, Vengoth. Ti darò una mappa vuota. Per favore mappami l'area e presta particolare attenzione ai punti insoliti. ...

en: Mark them on my map and come back once you have found at least five remarkable places on Vengoth. Can you do that for me?
translated: Segnali sulla mia mappa e torna dopo aver trovato almeno cinque luoghi notevoli su Vengoth. Puoi farlo per me?

en: Do Krunus dance for us! Step and dance and turn around! You will know when you do good. Make {Krunus} happy and support our great hunt!
translated: Заплеши Крунус за нас! Закорачи и плеши и окрени се! Знаћете када чините добро. Усрећите {Krunus} и подржите наш велики лов!

en: Our nightly blood-sucking visitors put the inhabitants of Yalahar in constant danger. The worst thing is that anyone in this city could be a vampire. Maybe an outsider like you could help us. Would you try?
translated: I nostri visitatori notturni succhiatori di sangue mettono gli abitanti di Yalahar in costante pericolo. La cosa peggiore è che chiunque in questa città potrebbe essere un vampiro. Forse un estraneo come te potrebbe aiutarci. Ci proveresti?

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione dei due soli nella torre solare vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: La scintilla della fenice è data dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
translated: Parla con l'eremita Eremo sull'isola di Cormaya di questa benedizione.

en: Besides the {enhanced} blessing available from me, I know of one other, granted by a solitary {nomad} far west of Svargrond. There are also five different other blessings available, each in a sacred place. ...\nThese blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
translated: Oltre alla {enhanced} benedizione disponibile da me, ne conosco un'altra, concessa da un solitario {nomad} molto a ovest di Svargrond. Sono disponibili anche cinque diverse altre benedizioni, ciascuna in un luogo sacro. ...\nQueste benedizioni sono: lo scudo {spiritual}, la scintilla del {phoenix}, il {embrace} di Tibia, il fuoco dell'{suns} e la saggezza di {solitude}.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione della protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
translated: |PLAYERNAME|, то је скоро звучало као реч поздрава. Људи - слатки су!

en: |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
translated: |PLAYERNAME|, то је скоро звучало као реч поздрава. Људи - слатки су!

en: Whoa! A human! This is no place for you, |PLAYERNAME|. Go and play somewhere else.
translated: Вау! Човек! Ово није место за тебе, |PLAYERNAME|. Иди и играј се негде другде.

en: The evergreen flower pots are an amusing item that might find some customers here. Do you want a passage to Carlin for 185 gold?
translated: I vasi da fiori sempreverdi sono un oggetto divertente che potrebbe trovare qualche cliente qui. Vuoi un passaggio a Carlin per 185 oro?

en: Of course it is merely superstition that the darashian sand wasp honey brings back youth and vitality, but as long people pay a decent price, I couldn't care less. Do you want a passage to Darashia for 210 gold?
translated: Naturalmente è semplicemente una superstizione che il miele della vespa darashian riporti giovinezza e vitalità, ma finché le persone pagano un prezzo decente, non me ne potrebbe importare di meno. Vuoi un passaggio a Darashia per 210 oro?

en: Do you want a passage to Ab'Dendriel for 160 gold?
translated: Vuoi un passaggio a Ab'Dendriel per 160 oro?

en: An unremarkable town compared to the wonders of Yalahar. Or did you find something interesting there?
translated: Una città insignificante rispetto alle meraviglie di Yalahar. Oppure hai trovato qualcosa di interessante lì?

en: Do you want a passage to Liberty Bay for 275 gold?
translated: Vuoi un passaggio a Liberty Bay per 275 oro?

en: Astonishing enough the royal satin seems to suit the exquisite taste of the Yalahari. Do you want a passage to Thais for 200 gold?
translated: Abbastanza sorprendente, il raso reale sembra adattarsi al gusto squisito degli Yalahari. Vuoi un passaggio a Thais per 200 monete d'oro?

en: Thais must be a hell hole if only half of the stories we hear about it are true. Or did you find something interesting there?
translated: Thais deve essere un inferno se solo la metà delle storie che sentiamo al riguardo sono vere. Oppure hai trovato qualcosa di interessante lì?

en: Ivory is highly prized by the artisans of the Yalahari. Do you want a passage to Port Hope for 260 gold?
translated: L'avorio è molto apprezzato dagli artigiani dello Yalahari. Vuoi un passaggio a Port Hope per 260 oro?

en: The Yalahari seem to be obsessed with conserving their dead, so I guess the embalming fluid will be a great success in Yalahar. Do you want a passage to Ankrahmun for 230 gold?
translated: Gli Yalahari sembrano ossessionati dalla conservazione dei loro morti, quindi immagino che il fluido per l'imbalsamazione avrà un grande successo in Yalahar. Vuoi un passaggio a Ankrahmun per 230 monete d'oro?

en: The swamp spice will turn out very lucrative considering that it helps to make even the most disgusting dish taste good. Do you want a passage to Venore for 185 gold?
translated: La spezia di palude si rivelerà molto redditizia considerando che aiuta a rendere buono anche il piatto più disgustoso. Vuoi un passaggio a Venore per 185 oro?

en: The oppression of Carlin's men by their lunatic women is unbearable to some of our authorities. We see it as our honourable duty to support the male resistance in Carlin ...
translated: Угњетавање мушкараца Carlin од стране њихових лудих жена је неподношљиво за неке од наших власти. Сматрамо да је наша часна дужност да подржимо мушки отпор у Carlin ...

en: I doubt that the esteemed Yalahari will indulge into something profane as rum. But who knows, I'll give it a try.
translated: Dubito che lo stimato Yalahari si abbandonerà a qualcosa di profano come il rum. Ma chi lo sa, ci proverò.

en: I'm Karith. I don't belong to a caste any longer, and only serve the Yalahari.
translated: Sono Karit. Non appartengo più a nessuna casta e servo solo gli Yalahari.

en: So receive my prayer: 'Let there be honour and humility'. Now, bring your stake to Rahkem in Ankrahmun for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
translated: Accogli quindi la mia preghiera: 'Let there be honour and humility'. Ora porta la tua puntata a Rahkem in Ankrahmun per la riga successiva della preghiera. Lo informerò cosa fare.

en: You should visit Rahkem in Ankrahmun now, pilgrim.
translated: Dovresti visitare Rahkem a Ankrahmun adesso, pellegrino.

en: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Ci sono cinque benedizioni disponibili in cinque luoghi sacri: lo scudo {spiritual}, la scintilla del {phoenix}, il {embrace} di Tibia, il fuoco del {suns} e la saggezza di {solitude}. Inoltre, puoi ricevere il {twist of fate} qui.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Sento che i druidi a nord di Carlin ti hanno fornito l'Abbraccio di Tibia.

en: Still, we are in dire need of these information so we are forced to take action on our own. Travel to the Thaian castle and 'find' the documents we need. They have the file name AH-X17L89. ...
translated: Ипак, ове информације су нам преко потребне па смо приморани да сами предузмемо акцију. Путовање до тајландског замка и 'find' документа која су нам потребна. Имају назив датотеке АХ-Кс17Л89. ...

en: Well, well, well! As you might know, we are entrusted by the Venorean tradesmen to ensure the safety of their ventures ...
translated: Добро, добро, добро! Као што можда знате, венорски трговци су нам поверени да обезбедимо сигурност њихових подухвата...

en: The northern barbarians are extremely hostile to us. The ones living in Svargrond are poisoned by the lies of agitators from Carlin. The barbarians that are also known as raiders are another story though ...
translated: Северни варвари су изузетно непријатељски расположени према нама. Они који живе у Svargrond затровани су лажима агитатора из Carlin. Варвари који су такође познати као јуришници су друга прича...

en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Vedo che hai ricevuto la benedizione dei due soli nella torre del sole vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Sento che la scintilla della fenice ti è già stata donata dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
translated: Sento che hai già parlato con l'eremita Eremo sull'isola di Cormaya e hai ricevuto questa benedizione.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione della protezione spirituale nel tempio dei fiori bianchi a sud di Thais.

en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
translated: I druidi a nord di Carlin ti forniranno l'abbraccio di Tibia.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Puoi chiedere la benedizione dei due soli nella torre solare vicino a Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: La scintilla della fenice è data dai sacerdoti nani della terra e del fuoco in Kazordoon.

en: Let's start with a rather simple job. There is a contact in Thais with that we need to get in touch again. Deliver this note to Gamel in Thais. Get an answer from him. If he is a bit reluctant, be 'persuasive'.
translated: Почнимо са прилично једноставним послом. Постоји контакт у Thais са којим морамо поново да ступимо у контакт. Доставите ову белешку Гамелу у Thais. Добијте одговор од њега. Ако је мало невољан, буди 'persuasive'.

en: Life is born by earth and fed by earth.
translated: La vita nasce dalla terra e si nutre della terra.

en: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
translated: Non dimenticare di depositare i tuoi soldi qui alla Tibian Bank prima di partire per l'avventura.

en: Very good. I hope you are able to convince one of the fractions to stand on our side. If you haven't done yet, you should first go and look for old Melchior in Ankrahmun. ...
translated: Molto bene. Spero che riuscirai a convincere una delle frazioni a schierarsi dalla nostra parte. Se non l'avete ancora fatto, dovreste prima andare a cercare il vecchio Melchiorre in Ankrahmun. ...

en: Even if the present has not improved our relations, the weapons will enable the barbarians to put more pressure on Svargrond and Carlin. So in any case we profited from the present.
translated: Чак и ако садашњост није побољшала наше односе, оружје ће омогућити варварима да изврше већи притисак на Svargrond и Carlin. Тако да смо у сваком случају профитирали од садашњости.

en: Greetings hero. I guess you came to {talk}.
translated: Поздрав јуначе. Претпостављам да сте дошли до {talk}.

en: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
translated: Non dimenticare di depositare i tuoi soldi qui alla Tibian Bank prima di partire per l'avventura.

en: Fine, fine. I think that should do it. Tell Hugo that we order those uniforms. The completed dress pattern will soon arrive in Venore. Report to me when you have talked to him.
translated: Bene, bene. Penso che dovrebbe bastare. Di' a Hugo che ordiniamo quelle uniformi. Il cartamodello completo arriverà presto tra Venore. Fatemelo sapere quando gli avrete parlato.

en: Oh yes, where did we get that from ...? Let's see, first ask the great technomancer in Kazordoon for the technical details. Return here afterwards.
