			So if you'd like to change 100 gold into 1 platinum, simply say '{change gold}' and then '1 platinum'.
translated:
Постоје три различите врсте новчића у Tibia: 100 златника једнако је 1 платинастом новчићу, \з
			100 платинастих новчића једнако је 1 кристалном новчићу. \з
			Дакле, ако желите да промените 100 злата у 1 платинасту, једноставно реците '{change gold}', а затим '1 platinum'.

en:
Your bank account will be used automatically when you want to {rent} a house or place an offer \z
			on an item on the {market}. Let me know if you want to know about how either one works.
translated:
Ваш банковни рачун ће се аутоматски користити када желите {rent} кућу или дати понуду \з
			на ставку на {market}. Јавите ми ако желите да знате како било који од њих функционише.

en:
You can check the {balance} of your bank account, {deposit} money or {withdraw} it. \z
			You can also {transfer} money to other characters, provided that they have a vocation.
translated:
Можете да проверите {balance} свог банковног рачуна, {deposit} новца или {withdraw}. \з
			Такође можете {transfer} новац другим ликовима, под условом да имају звање.

en:
You can check the {balance} of your bank account, {deposit} money or {withdraw} it. \z
			You can also {transfer} money to other characters, provided that they have a vocation.
translated:
Можете да проверите {balance} свог банковног рачуна, {deposit} новца или {withdraw}. \з
			Такође можете {transfer} новац другим ликовима, под условом да имају звање.

en: Greetings and Banor be with you, |PLAYERNAME|! May I interest you in a {trade} for weapons, ammunition or armor?
translated: Поздрав и Банор са вама, |PLAYERNAME|! Могу ли да вас заинтересујем за {trade} за оружје, муницију или оклоп?

en: Don't tell Rashid! I really don't want him to know that I forgot his order. Okay?
translated: Не говори Rashid! Заиста не желим да зна да сам заборавио његову наредбу. ОК?

en: Of course, just browse through my wares. If you're only interested in {distance} equipment, let me know.
translated: Наравно, само прегледајте моју робу. Ако сте заинтересовани само за {distance} опрему, јавите ми.

en: I try out old and new {recipes}. You can sell all {food} to me.
translated: Пробам старо и ново {recipes}. Можете ми продати све {food}.

en: I'd love to try a banana pie but I lack the {bananas}. If you get me one, I'll reward you.
translated: Волео бих да пробам питу од банане, али ми недостаје {bananas}. Ако ми набавиш један, наградићу те.

en: My cousin {Billy} cooks rat stew. Yuck! Can you imagine that?
translated: Мој рођак {Billy} кува чорба од пацова. Фуј! Можете ли то замислити?

en: Are you afraid of monsters? I bet even the sight of a {rat} would let your knees tremble. Hahaha.
translated: Да ли се плашите чудовишта? Кладим се да би вам чак и при погледу на {rat} колена задрхтала. Хахаха.

en: Don't ever mention his name again! He can't even {cook}!
translated: Никада више не помињи његово име! Не може ни {cook}!

en: Haven't they taught you anything at school? Ask for a {trade} if you want to trade.
translated: Зар те ништа нису научили у школи? Затражите {trade} ако желите да тргујете.

en: Help yourself. Or ask the other {citizens}, I don't have time for that.
translated: Помози себи. Или питај другог {citizens}, немам времена за то.

en: Me not give key! Key my precious now! \z By old goblin law all that one has in his pockets for two days is family heirloom! \z Me no part with my precious ... hm unless you provide Woblin with some {reward}!
translated: Не дајем кључ! Кључ мој драги сада! \з По старом гоблинском закону све што неко има у џепу два дана је породично наслеђе! \з Не делим се са мојим драгоценим ... хм осим ако Воблину не дате {reward}!

en: Me good angler but one fish eludes me since many many weeks. I call fish ''Old Nasty''. \z You might catch him in this cave, in that pond there. Bring me Old Nasty and I'll give you key!
translated: Добар сам пецарош, али једна риба ми измиче много недеља. Ја зовем рибу ''Old Nasty''. \з Могли бисте га ухватити у овој пећини, у оном рибњаку. Донеси ми Олд Насти и даћу ти кључ!

en: What you on quest for? Go leave Woblin alone with {precious}
translated: Шта тражиш? Оставите Воблина на миру са {precious}

en:
Me not give {key}! Key my precious now! By old goblin law all that one has in his pockets for two days \z
			is family heirloom! Me no part with my precious ... hm unless you provide Woblin with some {reward}!
translated:
Не дајем {key}! Кључ мој драги сада! По старом гоблинском закону све што неко има у џеповима два дана \з
			је породично наслеђе! Не делим се са мојим драгоценим ... хм осим ако Воблину не дате {reward}!

en: Of course we should talk again about your request. What do you say makes Farmine important?
translated: Наравно да треба поново да разговарамо о вашем захтеву. Шта кажете да чини Farmine важним?

en: There is indeed something that needs our attention. In the far north, a new city named Yalahar was discovered. It seems to be incredibly huge. ...
translated: Заиста постоји нешто што захтева нашу пажњу. На крајњем северу откривен је нови град по имену Yalahar. Чини се да је невероватно огроман. ...

en: Please look for the explorer's society's captain Maximilian in Liberty Bay. Ask him for a passage to Yalahar. There visit Timothy of the explorer's society and get his research notes. ...
translated: Потражите капетана друштва истраживача Максимилијана у Liberty Bay. Замолите га за пролаз до Yalahar. Тамо посетите Тимотеја из истраживачког друштва и узмите његове истраживачке белешке. ...

en: I've heard some odd rumours about this new dwarven outpost. But tell me, what has the Edron academy to do with Farmine?
translated: Чуо сам неке чудне гласине о овој новој патуљској испостави. Али реци ми, какве везе има Edron академија са Farmine?

en: <sighs> Okay, sending some trader there won't hurt. I hope it will be worth the effort, though.
translated: <sighs> У реду, слање неког трговца тамо неће шкодити. Надам се да ће ипак бити вредно труда.

en: What do you mean the druids of Carlin could provide the service as well? They are incompetent imposters! I will not allow them to ruin our reputation! I'll send some trader with supplies right away!
translated: Како то мислиш да би друиди са Carlin такође могли да пруже услугу? Они су неспособни преваранти! Нећу дозволити да нам униште углед! Одмах ћу послати неког трговца са залихама!

en: They are quite self-sufficient and the fact that they are actually accepting some help is more than alarming. The gnomes are in real trouble and I am kind of an ambassador to find some people willing to {help}.
translated: Они су сасвим сами себи довољни и чињеница да заправо прихватају неку помоћ је више него алармантна. Гноми су у стварној невољи и ја сам на неки начин амбасадор да пронађем неке људе који су спремни да {help}.

en: If you are interested to {join} the gnomish cause I can arrange a meeting with their recruiter.
translated: Ако сте заинтересовани за {join} гномски циљ, могу договорити састанак са њиховим регрутером.

en: They are quite self-sufficient and the fact that they are actually accepting some help is more than alarming. The gnomes are in real trouble and I am kind of an ambassador to find some people willing to {help}.
translated: Они су сасвим сами себи довољни и чињеница да заправо прихватају неку помоћ је више него алармантна. Гноми су у стварној невољи и ја сам на неки начин амбасадор да пронађем неке људе који су спремни да {help}.

en: Right now I am sort of {recruiting} people.
Ok, so listen. Your help is needed. That is if you're the hero type. Our ... {partners} need some help in urgent matters.
translated: Ок, слушај. Ваша помоћ је потребна. То је ако сте тип хероја. Нашим ... {partners} потребна је помоћ у хитним стварима.

en: I guess the time of secrecy is over now. Well, we have an old alliance with another underground dwelling race, the {gnomes}.
translated: Ваљда је време тајности сада прошло. Па, имамо стари савез са другом расом подземних станова, {gnomes}.

en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME| \z If you need magical equipment such as {runes} or {wands}, just ask me for a {trade}.
translated: Ох, молим вас уђите, |PLAYERNAME| \з Ако вам треба магична опрема као што је {runes} или {wands}, само ме замолите за {trade}.

en: If you want to have some information, you'll just have to find that book. If you need some equipment, go ask Harog. You'll find the library in the north eastern wing of Beregar city.
translated: Ако желите да имате неке информације, мораћете само да пронађете ту књигу. Ако вам треба нека опрема, питајте Харога. Библиотеку ћете пронаћи у североисточном крилу града Beregar.

en: The book about tunnelling is in the library which is located in the north eastern wing of Beregar city.
translated: Књига о тунелирању налази се у библиотеци која се налази у североисточном крилу града Beregar.

en: Only the most prominent Yalahari are allowed to join the festivities. I assume you can imagine what honour it is that you'vebeen invited to join us. Meet us in the inner city's centre. ...
translated: Само најистакнутијим Јалахари је дозвољено да се придруже свечаностима. Претпостављам да можете замислити каква је част што сте позвани да нам се придружите. Упознајте нас у центру града. ...

en: So if you are up for a challenge, ask me for a {mission}.
translated: Дакле, ако сте спремни за изазов, замолите ме за {mission}.

en: So if you are up for a challenge, ask me for a {mission}.
translated: Дакле, ако сте спремни за изазов, замолите ме за {mission}.

en: So do you want to side with me |PLAYERNAME|?
translated: Дакле, да ли желиш да станеш на моју страну |PLAYERNAME|?

en: |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
translated: |PLAYERNAME|, то је скоро звучало као реч поздрава. Људи - слатки су!

en: Shove off, little one! Humans are not welcome here, |PLAYERNAME|!
translated: Одгурни се, мали! Људи овде нису добродошли, |PLAYERNAME|!

en: Be greeted, human |PLAYERNAME|. How can a humble djinn be of service?
translated: Буди поздрављен, човече |PLAYERNAME|. Како скромни џинн може бити од користи?

en: {Tokens} are small objects made of metal or other materials. You can use them to buy superior equipment from token traders like me.
translated: {Tokens} су мали предмети направљени од метала или других материјала. Можете их користити за куповину врхунске опреме од трговаца токенима попут мене.

en: I have creature products for the imbuements {strike}, {vampirism} and {void}. Make your choice, please!
translated: Имам производе створења за инбуементс {strike}, {vampirism} и {void}. Направите свој избор, молим вас!

en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
translated: Добродошли, млади |PLAYERNAME|! Ако сте тешко рањени или отровани, могу вам {heal} бесплатно.

en: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Не изгледаш тако лоше. Извини, не могу ти помоћи. Али ако тражите додатну заштиту, требало би да одете на {pilgrimage} пепела или набавите заштиту од {twist of fate} овде.

en: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
translated: Кад год задобијете смртоносну рану, ваша витална снага је оштећена и постоји шанса да изгубите део опреме. Са сваким од пет {blessings} које имате, ова штета и шанса за губитак ће се смањити.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Видим да сте примили духовни штит у храму белог цвета јужно од Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Могу да осетим да су вам друиди северно од Carlin пружили Загрљај Tibia.

en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Видим да сте добили благослов два сунца у сунчаном торњу близу Ab'Dendriel.

en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Могу да осетим да су вам искру феникса већ дали патуљасти свештеници земље и ватре у Kazordoon.

en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
translated: Осећам да сте већ разговарали са пустињаком Еремом на острву Cormaya и добили овај благослов.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Можете затражити благослов духовног штита у храму белог цвета јужно од Thais.

en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
translated: Друиди северно од Carlin ће вам пружити загрљај Tibia.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Можете тражити благослов два сунца у сунчаном торњу близу Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Искру феникса дају патуљасти свештеници земље и ватре у Kazordoon.

en:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
translated:
Ово је посебан благослов који вам могу дати када добијете барем један од других благослова и који функционише мало другачије. ... \з
	Ради само када вас убију други авантуристи, што значи да су најмање половину штете која је довела до ваше смрти проузроковали други, а не чудовишта или околина. ... \з
	{twist of fate} неће смањити смртну казну као други благослови, већ ће вас уместо тога спречити да изгубите своје друге благослове као и амајлију губитка, ако је носите. Кошта исто као и остали благослови. ... \з
	Да ли би желео да добијеш ту заштиту за жртву од |PVPBLESSCOST| злата, дете?

en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need some equipment for your house?
translated: Здраво |PLAYERNAME|! Да ли вам је потребна опрема за вашу кућу?

en: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
translated: Погледајте. Већина намештаја долази у згодним комплетима. Само их користите у својој кући да саставите намештај. Да ли желите да видите само одређени {type} намештај?

en: A contact of zze rezzizztanzze izz located furzzer in zze norzz of Zao. ...
translated: Контакт ззе реззиззтанззе изз налази се фурззер у ззе норзз из Заоа. ...

en: {Poizzon} izz often uzzed by cowardzz, yet it grantzz great power to zze opprezzed.
translated: {Poizzon} изз често узз од цовардзз, али дајезз велику моћ да ззе оппреззед.

en:
I can teach you {healing spells}, {attack spells} and {support spells}. \z
		What kind of spell do you wish to learn? \z
			You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
translated:
Могу да те научим {healing spells}, {attack spells} и {support spells}. \з
		Коју врсту чаролије желите да научите? \з
			Такође ми можете рећи за који ниво желите да научите чаролију, ако то више волите.

en: Hey, you can't leave, |PLAYERNAME|. Luck is smiling on you. I can feel it!
translated: Хеј, не можеш да одеш, |PLAYERNAME|. Срећа ти се осмехује. Осећам то!

en: Greetings, high roller. So you care for a game, |PLAYERNAME|?
translated: Поздрав, хигх роллер. Па ти је стало до игре, |PLAYERNAME|?

en: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
translated: Добродошли, млади |PLAYERNAME|! Ако сте тешко рањени или отровани, могу вам {heal} бесплатно.

en: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Не изгледаш тако лоше. Извини, не могу ти помоћи. Али ако тражите додатну заштиту, требало би да одете на {pilgrimage} пепела или набавите заштиту од {twist of fate} овде.

translated: Осећам да сте већ разговарали са пустињаком Еремом на острву Cormaya и добили овај благослов.

en: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
translated: Поздрав, |PLAYERNAME|! Изгледаш стварно лоше. Дозволи ми да ти залечим ране.

en: I have to stay here, sorry. But I can {heal} you if you are wounded. I have also valuable information about {monsters}.
translated: Морам да останем овде, извини. Али могу ти {heal} ако си рањен. Такође имам вредне информације о {monsters}.

en: I'm an expert concerning the wildlife and {monsters} on this island.
translated: Ја сам стручњак за дивље животиње и {monsters} на овом острву.

en: I'm not a gossiper, but if you want to know something about a certain Rookgaardian, ask.
translated: Нисам оговарач, али ако желите да знате нешто о извесном Роокгаардиану, питајте.

en: Once you have upgraded your starter {equipment} a little - maybe leather stuff - and got a better weapon as well as a shield, you should be able to kill trolls.
translated: Једном када мало унапредите свој стартер {equipment} - можда кожне ствари - и добијете боље оружје као и штит, требало би да будете у могућности да убијате тролове.

en: You need a stronger weapon than the starter club to kill wolves. Maybe a {sabre} or a short {sword} will do.
translated: Потребно вам је јаче оружје од стартне палице да убијете вукове. Можда ће одговарати {sabre} или кратко {sword}.

en: Minotaurs are very strong. You will need a group of people or at least level 6 and good equipment to be able to kill them.
translated: Minotaurs су веома јаки. Биће вам потребна група људи или најмање ниво 6 и добра опрема да бисте могли да их убијете.

en: Wasp hives exist only behind the north bridge, so ask {Dallheim} for information. I'm glad there are no wasps here. They always make me jump.
translated: Кошнице оса постоје само иза северног моста, па питајте {Dallheim} за информације. Драго ми је што овде нема оса. Увек ме натерају да скочим.

en: I can mark you some dungeons on your map if you ask me about {monsters} suited for your level.
translated: Могу да вам означим неке тамнице на вашој мапи ако ме питате за {monsters} који одговара вашем нивоу.

en: The sewers are crowded with {rats}. They make fine targets for young heroes.
translated: Канализација је препуна {rats}. Праве добре мете за младе хероје.

en: The heavenly warrior! Read {books} to learn about him.
translated: Небески ратник! Прочитајте {books} да бисте сазнали више о њему.

en: In the world of Tibia, many challenges await the brave adventurer.
translated: У свету Tibia, храброг авантуриста чекају многи изазови.

en: The premium side of Rookgaard lies beyond.
There are many books in the {academy}. Theory can be just as important as practice.
translated: У {academy} има много књига. Теорија може бити једнако важна као и пракса.

en: It's my duty to protect this village and its {citizens}.
translated: Моја је дужност да заштитим ово село и његово {citizens}.

en: He sells {weapons}. His shop is south west of town, close to the {temple}.
translated: Он продаје {weapons}. Његова продавница је југозападно од града, близу {temple}.

en: She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}. Her shop is south west of town, close to the temple.
translated: Она је {Obi's} унука и бави се {armors} и {shields}. Њена радња је југозападно од града, близу храма.

en: Gentle girl, but a little to esoteric for my taste. However, her {potions} might come in handy.
translated: Нежна девојка, али мало езотерична за мој укус. Међутим, њен {potions} би могао бити од користи.

en: You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8.
translated: Можете пронаћи пророчиште на горњем спрату {academy}, одмах изнад {Seymour}. Иди тамо када будеш 8.

en: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You're looking really bad. Let me heal your wounds.
translated: Поздрав, |PLAYERNAME|! Изгледаш стварно лоше. Дозволи ми да ти залечим ране.

en: Hmm, |PLAYERNAME|. I really don't know if you should go into the wilderness without a shield. You should earn some money by hunting rats under the village first until you can afford at least a wooden shield.
translated: Хмм, |PLAYERNAME|. Заиста не знам да ли би требало да идете у дивљину без штита. Требало би да зарадите нешто новца тако што ћете прво ловити пацове испод села док не будете могли да приуштите бар дрвени штит.

en: The premium side of Rookgaard lies beyond.
Good bye |PLAYERNAME|, may Uman bless you!.
Oh, heaven must have sent you! Could you please help me with a {quest}?
translated: О, мора да те небо послало! Можете ли ми помоћи са {quest}?

en: Welcome back, darling... so about that firewood, could you please {help} me?
translated: Добродошао назад, драга... па што се тиче тог огрева, можеш ли ме молим те {help}?

en: Welcome back, darling... so about the {dead trees}, let me explain that a little more, {yes}?
translated: Добродошли назад, драга... па у вези са {dead trees}, дозволите ми да објасним то још мало, {yes}?

en: Welcome back, darling... so about the {branches}, let me explain that a little more, {yes}?
translated: Добродошли назад, драга... па у вези са {branches}, дозволите ми да објасним то још мало, {yes}?

en: Welcome back, darling... so about the {pushing}, let me explain that a little more, {yes}?
translated: Добродошли назад, драга... па у вези са {pushing}, дозволите ми да објасним то још мало, {yes}?

en: Welcome back, darling... so about the {cart}, let me explain that a little more, {yes}?
translated: Добродошли назад, драга... па у вези са {cart}, дозволите ми да објасним то још мало, {yes}?

en: Oh, sweetheart, is there a problem with the quest? Should I {explain} it again?
translated: Ох, душо, има ли проблема са потрагом? Да ли да поново {explain}?

en: Right, thank you sweetheart! This will be enough to heat my oven. Oh, and you are probably waiting for your reward, {yes}?
translated: У реду, хвала душо! Ово ће бити довољно да загрејем рерну. Ох, и вероватно чекаш своју награду, {yes}?

en: Oh, welcome back, dear Isleth Eagonst! Are you here for a little chat? Just use the highlighted {keywords} again to choose a {topic}.
translated: Ох, добродошао назад, драги Ислетх Еагонст! Јесте ли овде за мало ћаскање? Само поново користите истакнуто {keywords} да бисте изабрали {topic}.

en: 'Use' a tree to break a dry branch from it. Afterwards, drag and drop the branch back to my cart and select 'Use with', then left-click on my cart. Thanks again for offering your help!
translated: 'Use' дрво да с њега поломи суву грану. Након тога, превуците и отпустите грану назад у моја колица и изаберите 'Use with', а затим кликните левим тастером миша на моја колица. Хвала још једном на понуди помоћи!

en: Please go into the the forest southeast of here. You will find fine old rotten brown trees. Please RIGHT-CLICK in the lower right corner of that tree and choose 'USE'. That way, a branch should appear on the map. ...
translated: Молим вас идите у шуму југоисточно одавде. Наћи ћете фина стара трула смеђа стабла. КЛИКНИТЕ ДЕСНИМ тастером миша у доњем десном углу тог дрвета и изаберите 'USE'. На тај начин би на мапи требало да се појави грана. ...

en: When you are close to my cart, USE the branch WITH the cart: RIGHT-CLICK the branch on the floor and select 'USE WITH', Then LEFT-CLICK on the cart. Don't worry, you will see what I mean on the way. Thanks and {bye} for now!
translated: Када сте близу мојих колица, КОРИСТИ ГРАНУ СА колицима: КЛИКНИТЕ ДЕСНИМ тастером на грану на поду и изаберите 'USE WITH', Затим КЛИКНИТЕ ЛЕВИМ на колица. Не брини, видећеш на шта мислим успут. Хвала и {bye} за сада!

en: By the way, 'quest' is a keyword that many NPCs react to, especially those which have tasks for you. So darling, about that {quest}... are you listening?
translated: Иначе, 'quest' је кључна реч на коју реагују многи НПЦ, посебно они који имају задатке за вас. Па драга, о томе {quest}... слушаш ли?

en: You're such a treasure. In the forest south of here, there are {dead trees} without any leaves. The first thing you have to do is search for one, {okay}?
translated: Ти си право благо. У шуми јужно одавде има {dead trees} без лишћа. Прво што треба да урадите је да га потражите, {okay}?

en: Splendid, once you've found one, 'Use' it to break a branch from it. Did you understand that so far?
translated: Сјајно, када га нађете, 'Use' га да сломите грану. Да ли сте то разумели до сада?

en: Good... so after you broke a branch, please push it here and select 'use with'. That will turn your mouse cursor into crosshairs. Then left-click on my cart. {Alright}?
translated: Добро... па након што сломите грану, гурните је овде и изаберите 'use with'. То ће претворити ваш курсор миша у крстић. Затим кликните левим тастером миша на моја колица. {Alright}?

en: To push the branch, drag and drop it on the grass by holding the left mousebutton and moving the cursor to where you want to throw the branch. Just push it near my cart before you 'Use' it, {alright}?
translated: Да бисте гурнули грану, превуците је и испустите на траву држећи леви тастер миша и померајући курсор тамо где желите да баците грану. Само га гурните близу мојих колица пре него што га 'Use', {alright}?

en: Oh, you deserve it. You really have earned some experience! Also, you may enter my little house now and take what's in that chest beside my bed. Good {bye} for now!
translated: Ох, заслужујеш то. Заиста сте стекли неко искуство! Такође, сада можете ући у моју малу кућицу и узети оно што је у том сандуку поред мог кревета. Добро {bye} за сада!

en: Well then, I hope you find nice and dry branches for me! Good {bye}!
translated: Па онда, надам се да ћеш ми наћи лепе и суве гране! Добро {bye}!

en: Ah, the wind brings in another visitor. Welcome, dear guest. Are you looking for a {passage} with my carpet?
translated: Ах, ветар доводи још једног посетиоца. Добродошли, драги гост. Да ли тражите {passage} са мојим тепихом?

en: Ah our human {alliez} have finally arrived! I've already feared zat ze emperor'z forzez had caught you. Your rezilienze and prowezz are imprezzive.
translated: Ах, наши људски {alliez} су коначно стигли! Већ сам се плашио да те је имперор'з Форзез ухватио. Ваш резилиензе и провезз су импресивни.

en: You will need it. Now go to the north of Sleeping Dragon room, {dont need talk} with he! Good luck.
translated: Требаће ти. Сада идите северно од собе Слеепинг Драгон, {dont need talk} са њим! Срећно.

en: Alzough, for many ziz only provez what a huge zreat you blank-zkinz ztill poze. What do you {want}?
translated: Алзоугх, за многе зиз само провез какав огроман зреат ти бланк-зкинз зтилл позе. Шта ти {want}?

en: Your next {mizzion} will be a ztrike into ze heart of ze empire.
translated: Ваш следећи {mizzion} ће бити зтрике у зе срце зе царства.

en: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
translated: Да? Шта могу учинити за тебе, |PLAYERNAME|? Банкарски послови, можда?

en: Welcome |PLAYERNAME|, student of the arcane arts. I teach the fiercest {spells} available.
translated: Добродошли |PLAYERNAME|, студенту тајанствених уметности. Предајем најжешћи {spells} доступан.

en: I hereby grant you the right to wear a special sign of honour, acknowledged by the academy of Edron. Since you are a woman, I guess you don't want manly stuff. There you go.
translated: Овим вам додељујем право да носите посебан знак части, који признаје академија Edron. Пошто си жена, претпостављам да не желиш мушке ствари. Изволите.

en: I bow to you, player, and hereby grant you the right to wear Ferumbras' hat as accessory. Congratulations!
translated: Клањам ти се, играчу, и овим ти дајем право да носиш шешир Ferumbras' као додатак. Честитамо!

en: Sorry you don't have the Ferumbras' hat.
translated: Жао нам је што немате шешир Ferumbras'.

en: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
translated: Ох, молим вас уђите, |PLAYERNAME|. Шта могу учинити за вас? Ако вам треба авантуристичка опрема, тражите од мене {trade}.

en: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
translated: Наравно, само прегледајте моју робу. {Footballs} се морају купити засебно.

en: I sell equipment for your adventure! Just ask me for a {trade} to see my wares.
translated: Продајем опрему за вашу авантуру! Само ме замолите за {trade} да видим своју робу.

en: Ziz iz not for you to azk. I work for zomeone of immenze power. He haz an {offer} for you.
translated: Зиз из није за тебе да азк. Радим за Зомеоне огромне моћи. Он има {offer} за тебе.

en: You are ztill a captive and your life is forfeit. Zere might be a way for you to ezcape if you agree to {work} for my mazter.
translated: Још увек сте заробљеник и живот вам је одузет. Зере би могао бити начин да побегнеш ако пристанеш на {work} за мој мазтер.

en: Another visitor to this constricted, cosy, calm realm, perfect except for an {exit}. Muhaha.
translated: Још један посетилац овог скученог, пријатног, мирног царства, савршеног осим за {exit}. Мухаха.

en: If you want to go, just ask for an {exit} and I will transform you into a creature small enough to fit through that hole over there.
translated: Ако желите да идете, само тражите {exit} и трансформисаћу вас у створење довољно мало да стане кроз ту рупу.

en: Me zzimple ferryman. I arrange {trip} to Izzle of Zztrife.
translated: Ме Ззимпле Ферриман. Договарам {trip} до Иззле оф Ззтрифе.

en: Me zzimple ferryman. I arrange {trip} to Zzao.
translated: Ме Ззимпле Ферриман. Договарам {trip} за Ззао.

en: A quest? Yeah I got a quest! Go and tell King Tibianus his son tried to kiss me again!
translated: Ett uppdrag? Ja, jag har ett uppdrag! Gå och berätta för kung Tibianus att hans son försökte kyssa mig igen!

en: I was captured and tortured to death by the cultists here. They worship a being that they call Ghazbaran ...
translated: Jag blev tillfångatagen och torterad till döds av sekterna här. De dyrkar en varelse som de kallar Ghazbaran ...

en: No water then? Ah drat - er, don't worry, no problem. So, from the day I received news of the discovery of Zao, I wanted to study its inhabitants, wildlife, plants and geography. ...
translated: Inget vatten då? Ah drat - eh, oroa dig inte, inga problem. Så från den dag jag fick nyheter om upptäckten av Zao ville jag studera dess invånare, vilda djur, växter och geografi. ...

en: The academy instated the 'Edron-Zaoan Exploration Division' shortly after. I was a founding member and head of the 'Draken' research branch. ...
translated: Akademin insatte '⟨0⟩-Zaoan Exploration Division' kort efter. Jag var en av grundarna och chefen för forskningsgrenen 'Draken'. ...

en: Well, besides being a renowned sorcerer and scholar at the magic academy in Edron, I am also the proud father of a beautiful daughter, Ivalisse. My little endeavour here must have troubled the poor thing all the time since I left. ...
translated: Tja, förutom att vara en känd trollkarl och lärd vid magiska akademin i Edron, är jag också stolt far till en vacker dotter, Ivalisse. Min lilla strävan här måste ha besvärat stackaren hela tiden sedan jag gick. ...

en: Tell her I love her and that I will take care. I have to press on! My research is most valuable to the 'Edron-Zaoan Exploration Division'. You don't happen to have some water, do you? Ah nevermind. It's a long {story}.
translated: Säg att jag älskar henne och att jag ska ta hand om henne. Jag måste trycka på! Min forskning är mest värdefull för '⟨0⟩-Zaoan Exploration Division'. Du råkar inte ha lite vatten, eller hur? Ah strunt i. Det är en lång {story}.

en: Brightsteel is. Much art made with it. Sorcerers too lazy and afraid to enchant much.
translated: Brightsteel är. Mycket konst gjort med den. Trollkarlar för lata och rädda för att förtrolla mycket.

en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
translated: Har du någonsin undrat vad det där 'main' folk pratar om? Tja, när du har nått nivå 8 bör du prata med {oracle}. Du kan välja en {profession} efteråt och utforska mycket mer av Tibia.

en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
translated: Blåbär växer på buskar. De är ganska vanliga i Tibia. Bara plocka dem från en buske om du behöver ett mellanmål!

en: The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}. {Seymour} is the teacher there.
translated: Den stora byggnaden i centrum av Rookgaard. De har ett bibliotek, ett träningscenter, en {bank} och rummet för {oracle}. {Seymour} är läraren där.

en: Seymour is a teacher running the {academy}. He has many important {information} about Tibia.
translated: Seymour är en lärare som driver {academy}. Han har många viktiga {information} om Tibia.

en: You may pass this portal if you have 50 fish as offering. Do you have the fish with you?
translated: Du kan passera denna portal om du har 50 fiskar som erbjudande. Har du fisken med dig?

en: Thank you for your offering. You may pass the Portal to the Powers of Ice now.
translated: Tack för ditt erbjudande. Du kan skicka portalen till Ice Powers nu.

en: Thank you for your offering. You may pass the Portal to the Powers of Holy now.
translated: Tack för ditt erbjudande. Du kan skicka portalen till de heliga krafterna nu.

en: Thank you for your offering. You may pass the Portal to the Powers of Energy now.
translated: Tack för ditt erbjudande. Du kan skicka portalen till energins krafter nu.

en: You may pass this portal if you have 50 acorns as offering. Do you have the acorns with you?
translated: Du kan passera denna portal om du har 50 ekollon som offer. Har du ekollonen med dig?

en: Thank you for your offering. You may pass the Portal to the Powers of Earth now.
translated: Tack för ditt erbjudande. Du kan skicka portalen till jordens krafter nu.

en: Thank you for your offering. You may pass the Portal to the Powers of Death now.
translated: Tack för ditt erbjudande. Du kan skicka portalen till dödens makter nu.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Jag ser att du fick den andliga avskärmningen i det vita blomtemplet söder om Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Jag kan ana att druiderna norr om Carlin har försett dig med omfamningen Tibia.

en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Jag kan se att du fick välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.

en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Jag kan ana att gnistan från Fenix ​​redan gavs till dig av dvärgprästerna av jord och eld i Kazordoon.

en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
translated: Jag kan känna att du redan pratade med eremiten Eremo på ön Cormaya och fick denna välsignelse.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Du kan be om välsignelsen av andlig avskärmning i whiteflower-templet söder om Thais.

en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
translated: Druiderna norr om Carlin kommer att förse dig med Tibia.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Du kan be om välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Fenixens gnista ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.

en: She knows more about the wolf. Seek her out in the north-west of Edron, near a circle of standing stones.
translated: Hon vet mer om vargen. Sök upp henne i nordväst om Edron, nära en cirkel av stående stenar.

en: I'm very happy that you could help fae and animals alike. You earned our trust and may now visit our secret realm. I marked you with an arcane fae seal. Hereby you will be able to use the elemental shrines strewn about Tibia. ...
translated: Jag är väldigt glad att du kunde hjälpa både fe och djur. Du fick vårt förtroende och kan nu besöka vårt hemliga rike. Jag märkte dig med en mystisk fae-säl. Härigenom kommer du att kunna använda de elementära helgedomarna som är strödda omkring Tibia. ...

en: There are fire, ice, energy and earth shrines. If you don't know their locations you can also reach them by most temples in this world. The elemental shrines will transport you to Feyrist now that you bear the magical seal.
translated: Det finns eld, is, energi och jordhelgedomar. Om du inte känner till deras platser kan du också nå dem via de flesta tempel i den här världen. De elementära helgedomarna kommer att transportera dig till Feyrist nu när du bär det magiska sigillet.

en: Uhmn.. Maybe Ahmet in Ankrahmun can help we to fake this book.
translated: Uhmn.. Kanske Ahmet i Ankrahmun kan hjälpa oss att fejka den här boken.

en: We call it Feyrist and it is a secret, hidden place. Just few mortals get permission to enter it. A long time ago, we learned how to hide our realm from the outside world. Only if you gain our trust I will tell you how to reach it.
translated: Vi kallar det Feyrist och det är en hemlig, gömd plats. Bara ett fåtal dödliga får tillstånd att komma in i den. För länge sedan lärde vi oss att dölja vårt rike från omvärlden. Bara om du vinner vårt förtroende kommer jag att berätta hur du når det.

en:
Some call us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the term fae. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to protect our home. ... \z
	We tend to be secretive about our true nature, but I guess there was once an elven sage who visited our realm and put his experiences down on paper. There might be a book about the fae in the library of Ab'Dendriel.
translated:
Vissa kallar oss naturandar eller peri men vi föredrar termen fae. De flesta av oss är ganska tillbakadragna och lever fredliga liv i vårt hemliga rike. Vi lämnar det bara för att skydda vårt hem. ... \z
	Vi tenderar att vara hemlighetsfulla om vår sanna natur, men jag antar att det en gång var en alvvise som besökte vårt rike och skrev ner sina upplevelser på papper. Det kan finnas en bok om fae i biblioteket på Ab'Dendriel.

en: So receive my prayer: 'Wicked curses shall be broken'. Now, bring your stake to Kasmir in Darashia for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
translated: Så ta emot min bön: 'Wicked curses shall be broken'. Ta nu din insats till Kasmir på Darashia för nästa rad i bönen. Jag kommer att informera honom vad han ska göra.

en: You should visit Kasmir in Darashia now, my child.
translated: Du borde besöka Kasmir om Darashia nu, mitt barn.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Jag ser att du fick den andliga avskärmningen i det vita blomtemplet söder om Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Jag kan ana att druiderna norr om Carlin har försett dig med omfamningen Tibia.

en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Jag kan se att du fick välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.

en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Jag kan ana att gnistan från Fenix ​​redan gavs till dig av dvärgprästerna av jord och eld i Kazordoon.

en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
translated: Jag kan känna att du redan pratade med eremiten Eremo på ön Cormaya och fick denna välsignelse.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Du kan be om välsignelsen av andlig avskärmning i whiteflower-templet söder om Thais.

en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
translated: Druiderna norr om Carlin kommer att förse dig med Tibia.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Du kan be om välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Fenixens gnista ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.

en: Your mission here on Tibia is to be polite and friendly. The gods will reward you, I promise!
translated: Ditt uppdrag här på Tibia är att vara artig och vänlig. Gudarna kommer att belöna dig, jag lovar!

en: What a beautiful palace. The Kilmareshians are highly skilful architects.
translated: Vilket vackert palats. Kilmareshianerna är mycket skickliga arkitekter.

en: The new treaty of amity and commerce with Kilmaresh is of utmost importance.
translated: Det nya fördraget om vänskap och handel med Kilmaresh är av yttersta vikt.

en: I wish I could eat some salmon right now... best prepared in Liberty Bay style... yummy.
translated: Jag önskar att jag kunde äta lite lax just nu... bäst tillagad i Liberty Bay-stil... mums.

en: I'm trying to explore each spot of Tibia, and one day I'll have seen it all.
translated: Jag försöker utforska varje plats på Tibia, och en dag kommer jag att ha sett allt.

en: If you travel to Thais, you really should visit the marvelous castle there.
translated: Om du reser till Thais borde du verkligen besöka det fantastiska slottet där.

en: What was that word again in Orcish language... hmm.
translated: Vad var det för ord igen på orciska språket... hmm.

en: I speak some Orcish words, not many though, just a few basics like '{yes}' and '{no}'.
translated: Jag talar några orciska ord, dock inte många, bara några grunder som '{yes}' och '{no}'.

en: It's 'mok' in Orcish. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
translated: Det är 'mok' i Orcish. Jag berättar mer om du tar med mig några {food}.

en: In Orcish that's 'burp'. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
translated: I Orcish är det 'burp'. Jag berättar mer om du tar med mig några {food}.

en: Yeah! If you give me some salmon, I'll tell you another Orcish word. Okay?
translated: Ja! Om du ger mig lite lax, ska jag berätta ett annat orchiskt ord. Okej?

en: I wish I could eat some salmon right now... best prepared in Liberty Bay style... yummy.
translated: Jag önskar att jag kunde äta lite lax just nu... bäst tillagad i Liberty Bay-stil... mums.

en: What was that word again in Orcish language... hmm.
translated: Vad var det för ord igen på orciska språket... hmm.

en: Ahoi, young man |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the Nordic Tibia Ferries. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
translated: Ahoi, ung man |PLAYERNAME| och välkommen till de nordiska Tibia-färjorna. Om du behöver en {passage}, låt mig veta.

en: Well, a while ago powerful magic devices were used all around Tibia. These are chargeable compasses. There was but one problem: they offered the possibility to make people rich in a quite easy way. ...
translated: Nåväl, för ett tag sedan användes kraftfulla magiska enheter runt Tibia. Dessa är laddningsbara kompasser. Det fanns bara ett problem: de erbjöd möjligheten att göra människor rika på ett ganska enkelt sätt. ...

en: It was decided to collect all of the compasses, destroy them and throw them in the fiery depths of Tibia. I still have some of them here. I {sell} them for a low price if you want.
translated: Det beslutades att samla alla kompasserna, förstöra dem och kasta dem i det brinnande djupet av Tibia. Jag har fortfarande några av dem här. Jag {sell} dem för ett lågt pris om du vill.

en: This sarcophagus seals the entrance to the caves down there. Only here you can get all the {materials} you need for a working compass of this kind. So no entrance here - no further magic compasses in Tibia. In theory.
translated: Denna sarkofag förseglar ingången till grottorna där nere. Bara här kan du få alla {materials} du behöver för en fungerande kompass av det här slaget. Så ingen ingång här - inga ytterligare magiska kompasser i Tibia. I teorin.

en: Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
translated: Liv och död är viktiga delar av balansen.

en: Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
translated: Liv och död är viktiga delar av balansen.

en: Hunters live a life of freedom and closeness to nature, unlike a simple farmer or bugherder.
translated: Jägare lever ett liv i frihet och närhet till naturen, till skillnad från en enkel bonde eller bugherder.

en: ... over Tibia came to avenge their friends, and they killed nearly all ... <m>
translated: ... över Tibia kom för att hämnas sina vänner, och de dödade nästan alla ... <m>

en: ... the orcs went back to their cities. The city of Carlin was rescued. <m>
translated: ... orcherna gick tillbaka till sina städer. Staden Carlin räddades. <m>

en: ... of our king Tibianus III wanted to build the best CITY in whole of Tibia.
translated: ... av vår kung Tibianus III ville bygga den bästa STADEN i hela Tibia.

en: Since then, a woman has always been ruling over Carlin and this statue ... <m>
translated: Sedan dess har en kvinna alltid styrt över Carlin och denna staty ... <m>

en: ... and the Red Legion. So that was the story of Carlin and these Fields of Glory. I hope you liked it. *He smiles*
translated: ... och Röda legionen. Så det var historien om Carlin och dessa Fields of Glory. Jag hoppas att du gillade det. *han ler*

en: I will tell you a small secret now. My friend Lynda in Thais can create a blessed wand. Greet her from me, maybe she will aid you.
translated: Jag ska berätta en liten hemlighet nu. Min vän Lynda i Thais kan skapa en välsignad trollstav. Hälsa henne från mig, hon kanske hjälper dig.

en: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a {project} that tries to find out more about this new {area}.
translated: Crunors Druid? Han berättade att en ny grotta dök upp här? Det stämmer. Jag är chef för en {project} som försöker ta reda på mer om denna nya {area}.

en: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a project that tries to find out more about this new area.
translated: Druid från Crunor? Han berättade att en ny grotta dök upp här? Det stämmer. Jag är chef för ett projekt som försöker ta reda på mer om detta nya område.

en: MoTA is short for the recently founded Museum of Tibian Arts. We work together in close collaboration. New {results} are communicated to the museum instantly.
translated: MoTA är en förkortning för det nyligen grundade Museum of Tibian Arts. Vi arbetar tillsammans i nära samarbete. Nya {results} kommuniceras till museet omedelbart.

en: The mission should be simple to fulfil. For our excavations we have ordered a sturdy pickaxe in Kazordoon. You would have to seek out this trader Uzgod and get the pickaxe for us ...
translated: Uppdraget ska vara enkelt att uppfylla. Till våra utgrävningar har vi beställt en rejäl hacka i Kazordoon. Du skulle behöva söka upp den här handlaren Uzgod och hämta hackan åt oss ...

en: We would like to study some ancient runes that were used by the lizard race. We suspect some relation of the lizards to the founders of Ankrahmun ...
translated: Vi skulle vilja studera några gamla runor som användes av ödlorasen. Vi misstänker någon relation mellan ödlorna och grundarna av Ankrahmun ...

en: Somewhere under the ape infested city of Banuta, one can find dungeons that were once inhabited by lizards...
translated: Någonstans under den apinfekterade staden Banuta kan man hitta fängelsehålor som en gång beboddes av ödlor...

en: Look there for an atypical structure that would rather fit to Ankrahmun and its Ankrahmun Tombs. Copy the runes you will find on this structure...
translated: Leta där efter en atypisk struktur som hellre skulle passa till Ankrahmun och dess Ankrahmun gravar. Kopiera runorna du hittar på den här strukturen...

en: As far as we know the ruins found in the north-west of Edron were once inhabited by beings who used such stones. Do you have the heart to go there and to get us such a stone?
translated: Såvitt vi vet var ruinerna som hittades i nordvästra Edron en gång bebodda av varelser som använde sådana stenar. Har du hjärta att åka dit och skaffa oss en sådan sten?

en: For sure someone in Ab'Dendriel will own a copy. So you would just have to ask around there. Are you willing to accept this mission?
translated: Säkert kommer någon i Ab'Dendriel att äga en kopia. Så det är bara att fråga runt där. Är du villig att acceptera detta uppdrag?

en: We want to learn more about the ancient race of bonelords. We believe the black pyramid north east of Darashia was originally built by them ...
translated: Vi vill lära oss mer om den urgamla rasen av bonelords. Vi tror att den svarta pyramiden nordost om Darashia ursprungligen byggdes av dem ...

en: And remember: it's a small teleport for you, but a big teleport for all Tibians! Here is a small present for your efforts!
translated: Och kom ihåg: det är en liten teleport för dig, men en stor teleport för alla tibianer! Här är en liten present till din insats!

en: That is quite courageous. We know, it's much we are asking for. The queen of the banshees lives in the so called Ghostlands, south west of Carlin. It is rumoured that her lair is located in the deepest dungeons beneath that cursed place ...
translated: Det är ganska modigt. Vi vet, det är mycket vi efterfrågar. Drottningen av banshees bor i de så kallade Ghostlands, sydväst om Carlin. Det ryktas att hennes lya ligger i de djupaste fängelsehålorna under den förbannade platsen ...

en: Did you get the requested pickaxe from Uzgod in Kazordoon?
translated: Fick du den begärda hackan från Uzgod på Kazordoon?

en: In this mission we require you to get us some plant samples from Tiquandan plants. Would you like to fulfil this mission?
translated: I det här uppdraget kräver vi att du skaffar oss några växtprover från Tiquandan-växter. Skulle du vilja uppfylla detta uppdrag?

en: The explorer society would like to acquire an ancient urn which is some sort of relic to the lizard people of Tiquanda. Would you like to accept this mission?
translated: Upptäckarsällskapet skulle vilja förvärva en gammal urna som är någon slags relik till ödlfolket i Tiquanda. Vill du acceptera detta uppdrag?

en: We will see if you can handle this simple task. Get the pickaxe from Uzgod in Kazordoon and bring it to one of our bases. Report there about the pickaxe.
translated: Vi ska se om du klarar av denna enkla uppgift. Hämta hackan från Uzgod i Kazordoon och ta med den till en av våra baser. Rapportera där om hackan.

en: You have indeed the spirit of an adventurer! In the south-east of Tiquanda is a small settlement of the lizard people ...
translated: Du har verkligen en äventyrares anda! I den sydöstra delen av Tiquanda finns en liten bosättning av ödlfolket ...

en: Excellent! So travel to the city of Darashia and then head north-east for the pyramid ...
translated: Excellent! Så res till staden Darashia och bege dig sedan nordost mot pyramiden ...

en: Excellent. This mission is easy but nonetheless vital. Travel to Ab'Dendriel and get the book.
translated: Excellent. Det här uppdraget är enkelt men inte desto mindre viktigt. Res till Ab'Dendriel och hämta boken.

en: In the ruins of north-western Edron you should be able to find a memory stone. Good luck.
translated: I ruinerna av nordvästra Edron bör du kunna hitta en minnessten. Lycka till.

en: What a strange map. I wonder if any of our explorers recognises this coastal lines. However, you earned yourself another chance to convince me. Why do you think that Farmine would be interesting for us?
translated: Vilken konstig karta. Jag undrar om någon av våra upptäcktsresande känner igen denna kustlinje. Men du fick dig en ny chans att övertyga mig. Varför tror du att Farmine skulle vara intressant för oss?

en: We can bring you to Thais with one of our coaches for 125 gold. Are you interested?
translated: Vi kan ta dig till Thais med en av våra tränare för 125 guld. Är du intresserad?

en: The sailors always tell tales about the famous beer of Carlin. You must know, alcohol is forbidden in that city. ...
translated: Sjömännen berättar alltid om det berömda ölet från Carlin. Du måste veta, alkohol är förbjudet i den staden. ...

en: Did you get a sample of the whisper beer from Carlin?
translated: Fick du ett prov på viskölen från Carlin?

en: He should really sell some stylish gowns or something like that. We Tibians never get some clothing of the latest fashion. It's a shame.
translated: Han borde verkligen sälja några snygga klänningar eller något liknande. Vi Tibianer får aldrig några kläder av det senaste modet. Det är synd.

en: Powerful sorcerers frighten me a little.
Druids seldom visit a town, what do you know about druids?
translated: Druider besöker sällan en stad, vad vet du om druider?

en: But there is a fairy who once told me about it. Perhaps she will share her knowledge. You can find her in a small fairy village in the southwest of Feyrist.
translated: Men det finns en älva som en gång berättade om det för mig. Hon kanske delar med sig av sin kunskap. Du kan hitta henne i en liten älvaby i sydväst om Feyrist.

en: A long time ago a pixie knight of Maelyrra carried it with her. But when she was flying above the waves she accidentally dropped it and it sunk. I found it but now you may take it and use it to help Feyrist.
translated: För länge sedan bar en nisseriddare från Maelyra den med sig. Men när hon flög ovanför vågorna tappade hon den av misstag och den sjönk. Jag hittade den men nu kan du ta den och använda den för att hjälpa Feyrist.

en: There is a fairy who once told me about this spell. Perhaps she will share her knowledge. You can find her in a small fairy village in the southwest of Feyrist.
translated: Det finns en älva som en gång berättade för mig om den här besvärjelsen. Hon kanske delar med sig av sin kunskap. Du kan hitta henne i en liten älvaby i sydväst om Feyrist.

en: I'm tired of all these young unskilled wannabe heroes. Every Tibian can show his skills or actions by wearing a special outfit. To prove oneself worthy of the demon outfit, this is how it goes: ...
translated: Jag är trött på alla dessa unga outbildade wannabe-hjältar. Varje Tibian kan visa sina färdigheter eller handlingar genom att bära en speciell outfit. För att visa sig värdig demonoutfiten går det till så här: ...

en: I grant you three chests - filled to the lid with platinum coins, a house in the city in which you may reside, a set of the finest armor Zao has to offer, and a casket of never-ending mana. ...
translated: Jag ger dig tre kistor - fyllda till locket med platinamynt, ett hus i staden där du kan bo, en uppsättning av de finaste rustningar Zao har att erbjuda och en kista med aldrig sinande mana. ...

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Jag ser att du fick den andliga avskärmningen i det vita blomtemplet söder om Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Jag kan ana att druiderna norr om Carlin har försett dig med omfamningen Tibia.

en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Jag kan se att du fick välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.

en: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Jag kan ana att gnistan från Fenix ​​redan gavs till dig av dvärgprästerna av jord och eld i Kazordoon.

en: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
translated: Jag kan känna att du redan pratade med eremiten Eremo på ön Cormaya och fick denna välsignelse.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Du kan be om välsignelsen av andlig avskärmning i whiteflower-templet söder om Thais.

en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
translated: Druiderna norr om Carlin kommer att förse dig med Tibia.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Du kan be om välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Gnistan från Fenix ​​ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.

en: His identity is still unknown but we have been told that the thief fled to the human settlement called Carlin. I want you to find him and report back to me. Nobody messes with the Efreet and lives to tell the tale! ...
translated: Hans identitet är fortfarande okänd men vi har fått veta att tjuven flydde till den mänskliga bosättningen som heter Carlin. Jag vill att du ska hitta honom och rapportera tillbaka till mig. Ingen bråkar med Efreet och lever för att berätta historien! ...

en: Now go! Travel to the northern city Carlin! Keep your eyes open and look around for something that might give you a clue!
translated: Gå nu! Res till den norra staden Carlin! Håll ögonen öppna och se dig omkring efter något som kan ge dig en ledtråd!

en: Hmmm... I don't think so. Return to Thais and continue your search!
translated: Hmmm... Jag tror inte det. Återgå till Thais och fortsätt din sökning!

en: Then go to Carlin and search for him! Look for something that might give you a clue!
translated: Gå sedan till Carlin och sök efter honom! Leta efter något som kan ge dig en ledtråd!

en: Hmmm... I don't think so. Return to Thais and continue your search!
translated: Hmmm... Jag tror inte det. Återgå till Thais och fortsätt din sökning!

en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
translated: Nej nej nej, jag behöver 15 doser nyskördad pollen! Snälla, skörda de 15 doserna själv, för att vara helt säker på att du har förstklassig kvalitet. Jag är rädd att inget mindre kommer att göra.

en: Welcome to Ab'Dendriel's store for general goods.
translated: Välkommen till Ab'Dendriels butik för allmänna varor.

en: People of Thais, bring honour to your king by fighting in the orc war!
translated: Människor från Thais, ge din kung ära genom att slåss i orckriget!

en: You'll find a lot of dungeons if you look around. One example are the {sewers} below Rookgaard.
translated: Du hittar många fängelsehålor om du ser dig omkring. Ett exempel är {sewers} under Rookgaard.

en: Good! Listen closely. Take this bottle and go to Kazordoon. I need a sample of their very special brown ale. You may find a cask in their brewery. Come back as soon as you got it.
translated: Bra! Lyssna noga. Ta den här flaskan och gå till Kazordoon. Jag behöver ett prov på deras mycket speciella brown ale. Du kan hitta ett fat i deras bryggeri. Kom tillbaka så fort du fått det.

en: The pompous hero Avar Tar in Edron, Simon the greedy beggar on Fibula, the pirate Ariella on the Shattered Isles, the dubious Lorbas next to the ruins of the Dark Cathedral, King Markwin in the underground city Mintwalin ...
translated: Den pompösa hjälten Avar Tar i Edron, Simon den girige tiggaren på Fibula, piraten Ariella på Shattered Isles, den tveksamma Lorbas bredvid ruinerna av den mörka katedralen, kung Markwin i den underjordiska staden Mintwalin ...

en: The shaman Hjaern on the ice island Nibelor, the witch Wyda in the Green Claw Swamp, the ape Hairycles in the jungle city Banuta ...
translated: Shamanen Hjaern på isön Nibelor, häxan Wyda i Gröna Kloträsket, apornas hår i djungelstaden Banuta ...

en: The orc king in the orc fortress Uldrek's Rock and the last one to EITHER Yaman, the green djinn, OR, Nah'Bob, the blue djinn ...
translated: Orkungen i orkfästningen Uldreks klippa och den sista till ANTINGEN Yaman, den gröna djinnen, ELLER, Nah'Bob, den blå djinnen ...

en: I'm making them on my own in my spare time but I need the right material. South of Thais, next to the Whiteflower Temple, you will find the ideal flowers ...
translated: Jag gör dem på egen hand på min fritid men jag behöver rätt material. Söder om Thais, bredvid Whiteflower Temple, hittar du de perfekta blommorna ...

en: Life takes many forms. Plants are a very basic form of life. Its simplicity makes them close to the core of nature.
translated: Livet tar många former. Växter är en mycket grundläggande livsform. Dess enkelhet gör dem nära naturens kärna.

en: Life takes many forms. Plants are a very basic form of life. Its simplicity makes them close to the core of nature.
translated: Livet tar sig många former. Växter är en mycket grundläggande livsform. Dess enkelhet gör dem nära naturens kärna.

en: So receive my prayer: 'Your hand shall be guided - your feet shall walk in <hicks> harmony'. Now, take your stake to Tyrias in <hicks> Liberty Bay for the next line of the prayer. I shall let him know what he is to do.
translated: Så ta emot min bön: 'Din hand ska ledas - dina fötter ska gå i <hicks> harmoni'. Ta nu din insats till Tyrias i <hicks> Liberty Bay för nästa rad i bönen. Jag ska låta honom veta vad han ska göra.

en: You should visit Tyrias in Liberty Bay now.
translated: Du borde besöka Tyrias om Liberty Bay nu.

en: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Jag ser att du fick den andliga avskärmningen i det vita blomtemplet söder om Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Jag kan ana att druiderna norr om Carlin har försett dig med omfamningen Tibia.

translated: Jag kan se att du fick välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.

translated: Jag kan ana att gnistan från Fenix ​​redan gavs till dig av dvärgprästerna av jord och eld i Kazordoon.

translated: Jag kan känna att du redan pratade med eremiten Eremo på ön Cormaya och fick denna välsignelse.

en: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
translated: Du kan be om välsignelsen av andlig avskärmning i whiteflower-templet söder om Thais.

en: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
translated: Druiderna norr om Carlin kommer att förse dig med Tibia.

en: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Du kan be om välsignelsen av de två solarna i soltornet nära Ab'Dendriel.

en: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated: Fenixens gnista ges av jord- och eldens dvärgpräster i Kazordoon.

en: Rashid sent you, I suppose. Before I sell you that vase, one word of advice. ...
translated: Rashid skickade dig, antar jag. Innan jag säljer dig den där vasen, ett råd. ...

en: Come and take a look at the finest gems in the lands of Tibia.
translated: Kom och ta en titt på de finaste pärlorna i Tibia-länderna.

en: Do you want to purchase a weekly ticket for the ore wagons? With it you can travel freely and swiftly through Kazordoon for one week. 250 gold only. Deal?
translated: Vill du köpa en veckobiljett till malmvagnarna? Med den kan du resa fritt och snabbt genom Kazordoon i en vecka. Endast 250 guld. Handla?

en: Passage to Cormaya! Unforgettable steamboat ride!
translated: Övergång till Cormaya! Oförglömlig tur med ångbåt!

en: Would you like to travel to Gnomprona for |TRAVELCOST|?
translated: Vill du resa till Gnomprona för |TRAVELCOST|?

en: Do you seek a ride to Farmine for |TRAVELCOST|?
translated: Söker du skjuts till Farmine för |TRAVELCOST|?

en: Do you seek a ride to Cormaya for |TRAVELCOST|?
translated: Söker du skjuts till Cormaya för |TRAVELCOST|?

en: Passage to Cormaya! Unforgettable steamboat ride!
translated: Övergång till Cormaya! Oförglömlig tur med ångbåt!

en: By all that is holy! You are a truly great warrior! With much patience! I have just found out the location the hideout of The Horned Fox! I have marked the spot on your map so you can find it. Go there and slay him!! ...
translated: Med allt som är heligt! Du är verkligen en stor krigare! Med mycket tålamod! Jag har precis tagit reda på platsen där The Horned Fox! Jag har markerat platsen på din karta så att du kan hitta den. Gå dit och döda honom!! ...

en: I want you to kill 5000 minotaurs - no matter where - for me and all the dwarfs of Kazordoon! Are you willing to do that?
translated: Jag vill att du dödar 5000 minotaurier - oavsett var - för mig och alla dvärgarna i Kazordoon! Är du villig att göra det?

en: I want you to kill 5000 minotaurs - no matter where - for me and all the dwarfs of Kazordoon! Are you willing to do that?
translated: Jag vill att du dödar 5000 minotaurier - oavsett var - för mig och alla dvärgarna i Kazordoon! Är du villig att göra det?

en: Funny that you are asking me for a mission! There is indeed something you can do for me. Ever heard about The Horned Fox? Anyway, yesterday his gang has stolen my mining helmet during a raid. ...
translated: Roligt att du ber mig om ett uppdrag! Det finns verkligen något du kan göra för mig. Har du någonsin hört talas om The Horned Fox? Hur som helst, igår har hans gäng stulit min gruvhjälm under en razzia. ...

en: We presume the hideout of The Horned Fox is somewhere in the south-west near the coast, good luck finding my mining helmet!
translated: Vi antar att gömstället för The Horned Fox är någonstans i sydväst nära kusten, lycka till med att hitta min gruvhjälm!

en: Well, I could need help with that damn Horned Fox and his gang, but I guess since you are rather experienced, killing minotaurs would bore you to death. I'll wait for someone else. But thanks!
translated: Tja, jag skulle kunna behöva hjälp med den där jäkla Horned Fox och hans gäng, men eftersom du är ganska erfaren antar jag att döda minotaurier skulle trötta ihjäl dig. Jag väntar på någon annan. Men tack!

en: I knew you have the guts for that task! We presume the hideout of The Horned Fox somewhere in the south-west near the coast. Good luck!
translated: Jag visste att du hade modet för den uppgiften! Vi antar att The Horned Fox är gömställe någonstans i sydväst nära kusten. Lycka till!

en: The hideout of the Horned Fox is probably a dangerous if not lethal place for inexperienced adventurers. It is the source of all the {trouble} around here.
translated: Horned-rävens gömställe är förmodligen en farlig om inte dödlig plats för oerfarna äventyrare. Det är källan till alla {trouble} här.

en: He is a minotaur who was kicked out of Mintwallin. He must have some kind of {hideout} nearby.
translated: Han är en minotaur som blev utsparkad från Mintwallin. Han måste ha någon form av {hideout} i närheten.

en: I need a courier to deliver a parcel to the watchtower in Femor Hills. You think you can handle that??
translated: Jag behöver en kurir för att leverera ett paket till vakttornet om Femor Hills. Tror du att du klarar det??

en: Our family has been serving the Carlin army since countless generations!
translated: Vår familj har tjänat Carlin armén sedan otaliga generationer!

en: Our family has been serving the Carlin army since countless generations!
translated: Vår familj har tjänat Carlin armén sedan otaliga generationer!

en: She is one of my beloved sisters and serves Carlin as a town guard.
translated: Hon är en av mina älskade systrar och tjänstgör Carlin som stadsvakt.

en: Behave yourself as long as you are in Carlin, commoner!
translated: Uppför dig så länge du är i Carlin, vanligt!

en: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
translated: Hälsningar, |PLAYERNAME|! Du måste ha kommit runt en hel del. Jag är alltid intresserad av att lära mig nya saker om Zao.

en: I think in the past, the lizardmen of this country might have worshipped a snake god or goddess just like their brethren in Tiquanda if we can believe the reports from this area. The dragons replaced the snake worship at some point of history. ...
translated: Jag tror att ödlmännen i det här landet tidigare kan ha dyrkat en ormgud eller gudinna precis som sina bröder i Tiquanda om vi kan tro rapporterna från detta område. Drakarna ersatte ormdyrkan någon gång i historien. ...

en: His name was Zao and his deeds and exploits are immortalised in lizard folklore. Some of the earliest records in the tomes suggest a slightly different story though. ...
translated: Han hette Zao och hans gärningar och bedrifter förevigas i ödlfolklore. Några av de tidigaste uppteckningarna i tomerna antyder dock en något annorlunda historia. ...

en: Many records talk about an early lizard dynasty, but I doubt that Zao was a single person born into that dynasty. ...
translated: Många uppgifter talar om en tidig ödledynasti, men jag tvivlar på att Zao var en enda person som föddes in i den dynastin. ...

en: My guess is that several members of this dynasty are responsible for or connected to the feats that were attributed to the mythical 'Zao'. ...
translated: Min gissning är att flera medlemmar av denna dynasti är ansvariga för eller kopplade till de bedrifter som tillskrevs den mytiska 'Zao'. ...

en: The improbable lifespan of 'Zao' can thus be explained with the time the Zao dynasty reigned. On the other hand, we all know larger-than-life heroes did exist and some of them had an extremely long lifespan. ...
translated: Den osannolika livslängden för 'Zao' kan alltså förklaras med den tid då Zao-dynastin regerade. Å andra sidan vet vi alla att det fanns större hjältar än livet och att några av dem hade en extremt lång livslängd. ...

en: Most likely, he also had children which could explain the mentioning of a Zao family. I think even the lizardmen don't know for sure what happened in such distant past and so this might be one of those riddles that will never be solved. ...
translated: Troligtvis hade han också barn, vilket kunde förklara omnämnandet av en Zao-familj. Jag tror att även ödlmännen inte med säkerhet vet vad som hände i ett så långt förflutet och så det här kan vara en av de gåtor som aldrig kommer att lösas. ...

en: It seems that the origin of the Zao dynasty was somewhere in the Dragonblaze Peaks, or rather under them. Legends tell of a large fortress, once erected up the highest peak, but now buried deep underground. Who knows, maybe you'll find answers there?
translated: Det verkar som om ursprunget till Zao-dynastin var någonstans i Dragonblaze Peaks, eller snarare under dem. Legender berättar om en stor fästning, en gång uppförd på den högsta toppen, men nu begravd djupt under jorden. Vem vet, kanske hittar du svar där?

en: In the parts of the original text that I was able to reconstruct with the help of some alchemy, there were some references to lizard spawns that were sighted in the Tiquanda area and linked to the snake god. ...
translated: I de delar av originaltexten som jag kunde rekonstruera med hjälp av lite alkemi fanns det några hänvisningar till ödlor som iakttogs i Tiquanda-området och kopplade till ormguden. ...

en: Anyway, you know what else was mentioned in this book? A path down to a hidden cave system below the Muggy Plains. ...
translated: Hur som helst, vet du vad mer som nämndes i den här boken? En stig ner till ett gömt grottsystem nedanför Muggy Plains. ...

en: Have you ever seen the towers of the large lizard city south-east of Zao? It's the last one south of the mountains and who knows how long they are able to hold it. ...
translated: Har du någonsin sett tornen i den stora ödlastaden sydost om Zao? Det är den sista söder om bergen och vem vet hur länge de kan hålla den. ...

en: I discovered an interesting recipe in this Tome of Knowledge. Maybe you've seen the large rice terraces in Muggy Plains - that is how the lizardmen apparently call that region. ...
translated: Jag upptäckte ett intressant recept i denna Tome of Knowledge. Kanske har du sett de stora risterrasserna i Muggy Plains - det är så ödlmännen tydligen kallar den regionen. ...

en: Did you know that most of the minotaurs you might have met by now do not originally come from Zao? The original minotaur race stood no chance against the united force of dragons and lizards. ...
translated: Visste du att de flesta av de minotaurier du kanske har träffat vid det här laget inte ursprungligen kommer från Zao? Den ursprungliga minotaurrasen hade ingen chans mot den förenade kraften av drakar och ödlor. ...

en: The Mooh'Tah masters actually found the continent Zao and started to look for their lost brothers, but it doesn't say whether they actually found any survivors. ...
translated: Mooh'Tah-mästarna hittade faktiskt kontinenten Zao och började leta efter sina förlorade bröder, men det står inte om de faktiskt hittade några överlevande. ...

en: Did you know that the lizardmen were among the first races roaming this continent? They were waging war against the orcs, minotaurs and humans on Zao and for a long time it seemed that the forces were even. ...
translated: Visste du att ödlmännen var bland de första raserna som strövade omkring på denna kontinent? De förde krig mot orcherna, minotaurerna och människorna på Zao och under lång tid verkade det som om styrkorna var jämna. ...

en: Dragons are of great symbolism for this land. Even before the dragons came here and took control over Zao, the lizards worshipped the dragons as strong mythical beasts. ...
translated: Dragons är av stor symbolik för detta land. Redan innan drakarna kom hit och tog kontroll över Zao, dyrkade ödlorna drakarna som starka mytiska bestar. ...

en: Oh! That sounds fascinating. Have you found a Tome of Knowledge for me to read?
translated: Åh! Det låter fascinerande. Har du hittat en Tome of Knowledge som jag kan läsa?

en: I've learnt something interesting about the Zao {steppe}.
translated: Jag har lärt mig något intressant om Zao {steppe}.

en: Oh! That sounds fascinating. Have you found a new Tome of Knowledge for me to read?
translated: Åh! Det låter fascinerande. Har du hittat en ny Tome of Knowledge som jag kan läsa?

en: This book actually IS about Zao. Not about the continent, but about the mythical {founder} of the lizard dynasty.
translated: Den här boken handlar faktiskt om Zao. Inte om kontinenten, utan om ödledynastins mytiska {founder}.

en: The last tome contained a lot of information about status symbols and insignia - such as {thrones} - and reveals some of the power structures in Zao.
translated: Den sista boken innehöll mycket information om statussymboler och insignier - som {thrones} - och avslöjar några av maktstrukturerna i Zao.

en: Oh! That sounds fascinating. Have you found a new Tome of Knowledge for me to read?
translated: Åh! Det låter fascinerande. Har du hittat en ny Tome of Knowledge som jag kan läsa?

en: Oh! That sounds fascinating. Have you found a Tome of Knowledge for me to read? I have the feeling though that I can only share some of my experience with you now. Is that alright with you?
translated: Åh! Det låter fascinerande. Har du hittat en Tome of Knowledge som jag kan läsa? Jag har dock en känsla av att jag bara kan dela en del av mina erfarenheter med dig nu. Är det okej med dig?

en: Thank you! I look forward to reading this interesting discovery of yours and learn a few things about {Zao}.
translated: Tack! Jag ser fram emot att läsa denna intressanta upptäckt och lära mig några saker om {Zao}.

en: Thank you! I look forward to reading this interesting discovery of yours and learn a few things about {Zao}.

en: Thank you! I look forward to reading this interesting discovery of yours and learn a few things about {Zao}. Let me share some experience with you.
translated: Tack! Jag ser fram emot att läsa denna intressanta upptäckt och lära mig några saker om {Zao}. Låt mig dela lite erfarenhet med dig.

en: Ah, your lands are quite a sight! I have only visited Thais so far, but I think of navigating to more cities, when the time - and public demand - comes.

en: Passages to Thais and Krailos! Visit the strange lands!
